near_synonyms.difference: 半 is a number-like modifier before measure words (半个苹果); 一半 is a noun meaning 'one half of something' (苹果的一半)

半.meaning: half; semi-; half past (time); one of a pair

examples.hanzi: 我把半个苹果给了妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ bàn ge píngguǒ gěi le mèimei.
examples.english: I gave my little sister half an apple.

对.meaning: to; toward; aimed at (introduces the object of an attitude or action)

examples.hanzi: 他对我说了很多感谢的话。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ shuō le hěn duō gǎnxiè de huà.
examples.english: He said many words of thanks to me.

examples.hanzi: 老师问, 学生对, 问和答都很快。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn, xuéshēng duì, wèn hé dá dōu hěn kuài.
examples.english: The teacher asked, the students answered — questions and answers came fast.

near_synonyms.difference: 对 is colloquial and everyday (对/不对); 正确 is more formal/written and used for serious contexts like 正确答案, 正确的方法

examples.hanzi: 你的答案是对的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de dá'àn shì duì de.
examples.english: Your answer is correct.

对.meaning: measure word for pairs (一对夫妻, 一对花瓶)

examples.hanzi: 桌子上放着一对花瓶。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe yī duì huāpíng.
examples.english: A pair of vases sits on the table.

对.meaning: and (joins two coordinate elements, usually in negative contexts: 对不尊重他人的人, 我们绝不客气)

examples.hanzi: 对不尊重他人的人, 我们绝不客气。
examples.pinyin: Duì bù zūnzhòng tārén de rén, wǒmen jué bù kèqi.
examples.english: Toward people who don't respect others, we are never polite.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is delicious.

好.meaning: so as to; in order to; for the convenience of (请写清楚, 好让我知道)

examples.hanzi: 请把你的名字写在这儿, 好让我认识你。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de míngzi xiě zài zhèr, hǎo ràng wǒ rènshi nǐ.
examples.english: Please write your name here so that I can get to know you.

好.meaning: quite; so; to what an extent (好大的雨!; 好几个人) — often with an exclamation

examples.hanzi: 好大的雨, 我们等一等再走吧。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo dà de yǔ, wǒmen děng yī děng zài zǒu ba.
examples.english: What heavy rain — let's wait a bit before going.

好.meaning: to like; to be fond of (爱好, 好学) — usually in compounds or formal writing

examples.hanzi: 他是个好学的学生。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge hàoxué de xuéshēng.
examples.english: He is a student who loves to study.

叫.meaning: to call; to cry out; to shout

examples.hanzi: 他在门外大声叫我。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài mén wài dàshēng jiào wǒ.
examples.english: He called me loudly outside the door.

near_synonyms.meaning: to be called, to name as
near_synonyms.difference: 叫 is the everyday spoken word (他叫小明); 称为 is formal/written and usually takes a title or term as its name

叫.meaning: to name; to be called (他叫小明)

examples.hanzi: 那个孩子叫小明, 今年七岁。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi jiào Xiǎomíng, jīnnián qī suì.
examples.english: That child is called Xiaoming and is seven this year.

叫.meaning: to be called on or ordered by (被动 marker): 他叫人骗了 he was cheated — colloquial equivalent of 被

examples.hanzi: 我的手机叫人偷走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī jiào rén tōu zǒu le.
examples.english: My phone was stolen.

叫.meaning: to call for; to order (food, a taxi): 叫外卖, 叫车

examples.hanzi: 我们叫了两碗面和一个菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào le liǎng wǎn miàn hé yī ge cài.
examples.english: We ordered two bowls of noodles and one dish.

日.meaning: day (formal/written register): 今日, 明日, 改日; also Japan (中日)

examples.hanzi: 今日天气很好, 我们去公园吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīnrì tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
examples.english: The weather is great today — let's go to the park.

日.meaning: the sun (written): 日光, 日出

examples.hanzi: 太阳从东边升起, 日光照在河面上。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyáng cóng dōngbian shēngqǐ, rìguāng zhào zài hémiàn shang.
examples.english: The sun rises in the east, its light shining on the river.

日.meaning: day as a unit of duration: 三日游 a three-day tour

examples.hanzi: 我们计划了一次三日游。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà le yī cì sān rì yóu.
examples.english: We planned a three-day tour.

一下.meaning: (after a verb) once; briefly; a little — softens or lightens the action: 看一下, 等一下

examples.hanzi: 请等一下, 他马上就来。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng děng yīxià, tā mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.english: Please wait a moment; he'll be right here.

examples.hanzi: 这是真事, 不是我编的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì zhēn shì, bù shì wǒ biān de.
examples.english: This is a true story — I didn't make it up.

真.meaning: really; so (intensifier before adjectives): 真漂亮! 真不好意思

examples.hanzi: 今天的晚会真热闹!
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de wǎnhuì zhēn rènao!
examples.english: Tonight's party is really lively!

从.meaning: from (starting point in time or space): 从北京到上海; 从小

examples.hanzi: 从北京到上海坐高铁要五个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng Běijīng dào Shànghǎi zuò gāotiě yào wǔ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: It takes five hours by high-speed rail from Beijing to Shanghai.

从.meaning: from (source or basis): 从这句话里, 我听出了他的意思

examples.hanzi: 从这句话里, 我听出了他的意思。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè jù huà li, wǒ tīng chū le tā de yìsi.
examples.english: From this sentence I could hear what he meant.

从.meaning: (of a group) to follow; along with: 从众 follow the crowd — literary; modern use is mainly the compound 服从/听从

examples.hanzi: 他没有主见, 凡事从众。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhǔjiàn, fánshì cóngzhòng.
examples.english: He has no views of his own and always follows the crowd.

examples.hanzi: 你在楼下等我, 我五分钟就下来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài lóuxià děng wǒ, wǒ wǔ fēnzhōng jiù xiàlai.
examples.english: Wait for me downstairs; I'll be down in five minutes.

等1.meaning: and so on; etc. (placed after an enumeration)

examples.hanzi: 我们买了水果、饮料等东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le shuǐguǒ, yǐnliào děng dōngxi.
examples.english: We bought fruit, drinks and so on.

等1.meaning: to await (one's turn, an outcome): 等我考虑考虑再说

examples.hanzi: 这件事先等等, 等我考虑考虑再说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xiān děngdeng, děng wǒ kǎolǜ kǎolǜ zài shuō.
examples.english: Let this matter wait until I've had time to think it over.

点2.meaning: point; aspect; item — measure word for abstract points: 优点, 重点, 三点建议

examples.hanzi: 老师指出了我作文里的三个优点。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐ chū le wǒ zuòwén li de sān ge yōudiǎn.
examples.english: The teacher pointed out three strong points in my essay.

点2.meaning: o'clock (time of day): 三点; also a little (一点钱)

examples.hanzi: 我们三点在咖啡馆见面。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen sān diǎn zài kāfēguǎn jiànmiàn.
examples.english: We'll meet at the coffee shop at three o'clock.

点2.meaning: to order (food); to light (a fire, a candle): 点菜, 点蜡烛

examples.hanzi: 服务员来点菜了。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán lái diǎn cài le.
examples.english: The waiter has come to take our order.

点2.meaning: dot; drop; decimal point: 标点, 小数点

examples.hanzi: 他用笔在地图上画了一个点。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng bǐ zài dìtú shang huà le yī ge diǎn.
examples.english: He drew a dot on the map with a pen.

间.meaning: measure word for rooms: 一间卧室, 两间教室

examples.hanzi: 这层楼有五间教室。
examples.pinyin: Zhè céng lóu yǒu wǔ jiān jiàoshì.
examples.english: This floor has five classrooms.

间.meaning: space between; gap; interval (中间, 房间, 时间 — mainly in compounds)

examples.hanzi: 我的房间在客厅和厨房之间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài kètīng hé chúfáng zhījiān.
examples.english: My room is between the living room and the kitchen.

间.meaning: space between; separation (离间, 间谍, 挑拨离间) — literary

examples.hanzi: 有人在两国之间挑拨离间。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài liǎng guó zhījiān tiǎobō líjiàn.
examples.english: Someone is sowing discord between the two countries.

near_synonyms.difference: 绿 is the single-character color word used in compounds and names (绿茶, 绿灯); 绿色 is the two-syllable everyday word for the color and for 'eco-friendly'

绿色.meaning: green (color); green as in environmentally friendly: 绿色食品

examples.hanzi: 春天的山上到处是绿色。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān de shān shang dàochù shì lǜsè.
examples.english: In spring the mountains are green everywhere.

每.meaning: every; each; per — 每 + measure word + noun (每个人); 每逢 whenever

examples.hanzi: 每个人都应该保护环境。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.english: Everyone should protect the environment.

让.meaning: to let; to allow; to permit: 让他说完; 妈妈不让我去

examples.hanzi: 妈妈不让我一个人晚上出门。
examples.pinyin: Māma bù ràng wǒ yī ge rén wǎnshang chūmén.
examples.english: Mom won't let me go out alone at night.

让.meaning: to have someone do something (causative): 我让他帮我买票 — the pattern 让 + person + verb

examples.hanzi: 我让他帮我买了一张票。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ràng tā bāng wǒ mǎi le yī zhāng piào.
examples.english: I had him buy a ticket for me.

让.meaning: passive marker (equivalent to 被): 杯子让他打破了 the cup was broken by him — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 杯子让弟弟打破了。
examples.pinyin: Bēizi ràng dìdi dǎpò le.
examples.english: The cup was broken by my little brother.

关系.meaning: relationship; relation (between people, things, or countries): 朋友关系, 国际关系

examples.hanzi: 他们俩的朋友关系已经十年了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ de péngyou guānxi yǐjīng shí nián le.
examples.english: Their friendship has lasted ten years.

关系.meaning: relevance; bearing; connection (有/没有关系 it matters / it doesn't matter; 和…有关系 to be related to)

examples.hanzi: 迟到和工作能力没有关系。
examples.pinyin: Chídào hé gōngzuò nénglì méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.english: Being late has nothing to do with one's ability at work.

关系.meaning: (guānxi) connections; personal network of favors and influence — culturally loaded sense of using relationships to get things done

examples.hanzi: 在中国做生意, 关系有时比能力更重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó zuò shēngyi, guānxi yǒushí bǐ nénglì gèng zhòngyào.
examples.english: In doing business in China, connections are sometimes more important than ability.

节.meaning: festival; holiday; important day: 春节, 中秋节, 教师节

examples.hanzi: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
examples.english: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

节.meaning: section; segment; joint (of bamboo, the body); item (of a lesson or broadcast): 季节, 一节课, 关节

examples.hanzi: 这节课我们学新的语法点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jié kè wǒmen xué xīn de yǔfǎ diǎn.
examples.english: In this class period we're learning a new grammar point.

节.meaning: measure word for class periods, lessons, chapters, train sections: 三节课

examples.hanzi: 我们每天上午有四节课。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān shàngwǔ yǒu sì jié kè.
examples.english: We have four class periods every morning.

节.meaning: to save; to control; to curb (节约 sense): 节水, 节能, 节制

examples.hanzi: 节约用水, 从我做起。
examples.pinyin: Jiéyuē yòng shuǐ, cóng wǒ zuò qǐ.
examples.english: Save water — start with me.

near_synonyms.difference: 老 is for people and long-standing relationships (老人, 老朋友); 旧 is for objects that are worn or not new (旧衣服, 旧房子)

老.meaning: old (of people or things); aged — does not carry the negative tone of English 'old' in all uses

examples.hanzi: 这位老人每天早上都去公园锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán duànliàn.
examples.english: This old man goes to the park to exercise every morning.

老.meaning: (prefix) longstanding; habitual; very: 老朋友 old friend, 老地方 the usual place, 老远 very far

examples.hanzi: 我们在老地方见吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài lǎo dìfang jiàn ba.
examples.english: Let's meet at the usual place.

老.meaning: always; constantly (老是 always — colloquial): 他老迟到

examples.hanzi: 他老是忘记带钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎoshì wàngjì dài yàoshi.
examples.english: He's always forgetting his keys.

怕.meaning: to fear; to be afraid of (something concrete or a consequence): 怕黑, 不怕累

examples.hanzi: 小女儿怕黑, 睡觉要开灯。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo nǚ'ér pà hēi, shuìjiào yào kāi dēng.
examples.english: My little daughter is afraid of the dark and sleeps with the light on.

怕.meaning: (I'm) afraid that…; I suppose (polite hedge introducing an unwelcome judgment): 怕是不行吧

examples.hanzi: 怕是今天赶不上末班车了。
examples.pinyin: Pà shì jīntiān gǎn bu shàng mòbānchē le.
examples.english: I'm afraid we won't make the last bus today.

像.meaning: to resemble; to be like; to look like: 她像她妈妈

examples.hanzi: 她长得像她妈妈。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de xiàng tā māma.
examples.english: She looks like her mother.

像.meaning: such as; like (introducing examples): 像跑步、游泳这样的运动

examples.hanzi: 像跑步、游泳这样的运动, 他都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng pǎobù, yóuyǒng zhèyàng de yùndòng, tā dōu xǐhuan.
examples.english: He likes sports such as running and swimming.

像.meaning: image; statue; portrait: 画像, 塑像, 菩萨像

examples.hanzi: 墙上挂着一张佛像。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shang guàzhe yī zhāng fóxiàng.
examples.english: A picture of the Buddha hangs on the wall.

啊.meaning: (sentence-final) expressive particle showing exclamation, reminder, or emphasis: 多漂亮啊!; 你可小心啊!

examples.hanzi: 多漂亮的衣服啊!
examples.pinyin: Duō piàoliang de yīfu a!
examples.english: What beautiful clothes!

啊.meaning: ah; oh (exclamation of surprise, realization, or response): 啊, 我想起来了!

examples.hanzi: 啊，我终于想起来了！
examples.pinyin: a, wǒ zhōngyú xiǎng qǐlai le!
examples.english: Ah, I finally remembered!

啊.meaning: (after a question word or subject) interrogative particle softening a question: 什么啊?; 你说什么啊?

examples.hanzi: 你说什么啊? 我没听清。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō shénme a? Wǒ méi tīng qīng.
examples.english: What did you say? I didn't hear clearly.

near_synonyms.difference: 爱 covers love in all senses (爱父母, 爱音乐); 爱情 is specifically romantic love between partners

爱情.meaning: romantic love (between lovers): 爱情故事; 相信爱情

examples.hanzi: 这部电影讲的是两个人的爱情故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì liǎng ge rén de àiqíng gùshi.
examples.english: This film tells the love story of two people.

爱心.meaning: loving heart; compassion; kindness (toward others): 献爱心, 有爱心的人

examples.hanzi: 她是一个很有爱心的人, 常常帮助小动物。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge hěn yǒu àixīn de rén, chángcháng bāngzhù xiǎo dòngwù.
examples.english: She is a kind-hearted person who often helps small animals.

near_synonyms.difference: 按照 is the two-syllable preposition used before nouns (按照计划); 按 alone in this sense is more formal/written

按.meaning: according to; on the basis of: 按理说, 按规定, 按他的意见

examples.hanzi: 按照说明书做就行了。
examples.pinyin: ànzhào shuōmíngshū zuò jiù xíng le.
examples.english: Just follow the manual and it'll be fine.

按.meaning: to press; to push down (a button, a switch): 按门铃, 按电梯

examples.hanzi: 请按门铃, 不要敲门。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng àn ménlíng, bù yào qiāo mén.
examples.english: Please press the doorbell; don't knock.

安检.meaning: security check (at airports, stations): 过安检, 安检人员

examples.hanzi: 进火车站以前要先过安检。
examples.pinyin: Jìn huǒchēzhàn yǐqián yào xiān guò ānjiǎn.
examples.english: Before entering the train station you have to go through security first.

安排.meaning: to arrange; to plan; to schedule: 安排时间, 安排住宿

examples.hanzi: 秘书安排了明天的三个会议。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū ānpái le míngtiān de sān ge huìyì.
examples.english: The secretary scheduled tomorrow's three meetings.

安排.meaning: arrangement; plan; schedule: 学习安排, 会议的安排

examples.hanzi: 这是本次比赛的时间安排。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì běn cì bǐsài de shíjiān ānpái.
examples.english: This is the schedule for this competition.

按时.meaning: on time; on schedule: 按时完成, 按时吃药

examples.hanzi: 他每天都按时吃早饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu ànshí chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: He eats breakfast on time every day.

near_synonyms.difference: 按照 means following a plan/rule/standard (按照计划); 根据 introduces the basis or evidence for a judgment (根据调查结果)

按照.meaning: according to; in accordance with: 按照计划, 按照说明书做

examples.hanzi: 请大家按照顺序上车。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā ànzhào shùnxù shàng chē.
examples.english: Please board the bus in order.

白酒.meaning: baijiu; Chinese distilled liquor (clear and strong, typically 40–60% alcohol)

examples.hanzi: 爸爸喝了一小杯白酒。
examples.pinyin: Bàba hē le yī xiǎo bēi báijiǔ.
examples.english: Dad drank a small cup of baijiu.

棒.meaning: great; excellent; terrific (你真棒!; 这家餐厅的菜很棒) — colloquial term of praise

examples.hanzi: 你真棒! 三天就学会了游泳。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn bàng! Sān tiān jiù xuéhuì le yóuyǒng.
examples.english: You're amazing — you learned to swim in three days.

棒.meaning: stick; club; rod (棒子, 冰棒, 木棒 — mainly in compounds)

examples.hanzi: 爷爷用一根木棒撑着小树。
examples.pinyin: Yéye yòng yī gēn mùbàng chēngzhe xiǎo shù.
examples.english: Grandpa propped up the small tree with a wooden stick.

办公.meaning: to handle official business; to work (in an office): 办公室, 办公时间

examples.hanzi: 这层楼是老师们的办公区。
examples.pinyin: Zhè céng lóu shì lǎoshīmen de bàngōng qū.
examples.english: This floor is the teachers' office area.

办理.meaning: to handle; to process (a procedure, formalities): 办理护照, 办理手续

examples.hanzi: 请带好证件来办理入住手续。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dài hǎo zhèngjiàn lái bànlǐ rùzhù shǒuxù.
examples.english: Please bring your ID to check in.

near_synonyms.difference: 办事 emphasizes handling specific affairs or errands, often through procedures (办手续); 做事 is broader — doing work or things in general

办事.meaning: to handle affairs; to get things done; to run errands: 办事处, 办事效率

examples.hanzi: 他办事很认真, 领导很信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bànshì hěn rènzhēn, lǐngdǎo hěn xìnrèn tā.
examples.english: He handles matters conscientiously, so his boss trusts him.

办事.meaning: (of a person) practical and reliable in handling matters: 他办事很认真 / 办事能力强

examples.hanzi: 他是个办事的人, 交给他没问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge bànshì de rén, jiāo gěi tā méi wèntí.
examples.english: He's a reliable get-things-done person; entrusting it to him is fine.

抱.meaning: to hold in the arms; to embrace; to hug: 抱孩子, 抱在一起

examples.hanzi: 她抱着孩子睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàozhe háizi shuìzháo le.
examples.english: She fell asleep holding the child.

抱.meaning: to harbor (a hope, idea, attitude): 抱希望, 抱着试试看的态度

examples.hanzi: 他对未来抱着很大的希望。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wèilái bàozhe hěn dà de xīwàng.
examples.english: He holds great hope for the future.

保护.meaning: to protect; to safeguard: 保护环境, 保护眼睛

examples.hanzi: 我们要保护环境, 少用塑料袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng, shǎo yòng sùliào dài.
examples.english: We should protect the environment and use fewer plastic bags.

保护.meaning: protection (保护色 protective coloring — mainly in compounds)

examples.hanzi: 北极熊的保护色让它很难被发现。
examples.pinyin: Běijíxióng de bǎohùsè ràng tā hěn nán bèi fāxiàn.
examples.english: The polar bear's protective coloring makes it hard to spot.

报考.meaning: to register for an entrance exam; to apply to sit an examination: 报考大学, 报考研究生

examples.hanzi: 她报考了三所大学。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàokǎo le sān suǒ dàxué.
examples.english: She applied for entrance to three universities.

near_synonyms.difference: 报名 is signing up to join an activity, course or exam (报名参赛); 申请 is a formal application that may be reviewed and approved (申请签证, 申请大学)

报名.meaning: to sign up; to enroll; to enter one's name (for a course, contest, activity): 报名参加比赛, 报名截止日期

examples.hanzi: 想参加比赛的同学请今天报名。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng cānjiā bǐsài de tóngxué qǐng jīntiān bàomíng.
examples.english: Students who want to join the contest please sign up today.

near_synonyms.difference: 抱歉 is slightly more formal and often opens an explanation (很抱歉…); 对不起 is the everyday apology for a concrete fault

抱歉.meaning: sorry; apologetic: 很抱歉, 抱歉让你久等了 — usually with 很/十分

examples.hanzi: 很抱歉, 让您久等了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn bàoqiàn, ràng nín jiǔ děng le.
examples.english: I'm very sorry to have kept you waiting.

保证.meaning: to guarantee; to promise; to assure: 我保证按时到

examples.hanzi: 我保证明天按时到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎozhèng míngtiān ànshí dào.
examples.english: I guarantee I'll arrive on time tomorrow.

保证.meaning: guarantee; assurance: 作出保证, 质量保证

examples.hanzi: 商家对产品质量作出了保证。
examples.pinyin: Shāngjiā duì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng zuòchū le bǎozhèng.
examples.english: The merchant gave a guarantee on product quality.

倍.meaning: measure word for multiples (of an amount): 两倍, 是原来的三倍; 加倍 double

examples.hanzi: 今年的学生人数是去年的两倍。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de xuésheng rénshù shì qùnián de liǎng bèi.
examples.english: This year's student numbers are twice last year's.

倍.meaning: times; -fold (倍数 multiple — mainly in compounds)

examples.hanzi: 三的倍数有六、九、十二等。
examples.pinyin: sān de bèishù yǒu liù, jiǔ, shí'èr děng.
examples.english: Multiples of three include 6, 9, 12 and so on.

背.meaning: to recite from memory; to learn by heart: 背课文, 背单词

examples.hanzi: 每天早上我都背二十个生词。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu bèi èrshí ge shēngcí.
examples.english: Every morning I memorize twenty new words.

背.meaning: to carry on the back; to bear (a burden): 背书包, 背责任

examples.hanzi: 他背着书包走进学校。
examples.pinyin: Tā bēizhe shūbāo zǒu jìn xuéxiào.
examples.english: He walked into school carrying his backpack on his back.

背包.meaning: backpack; rucksack (measure word 个 or 只)

examples.hanzi: 他去旅行时总背着一个大背包。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù lǚxíng shí zǒng bēizhe yī ge dà bēibāo.
examples.english: He always carries a big backpack when he travels.

北部.meaning: the northern part (of a country or region): 中国北部, 城市的北部

examples.hanzi: 冬天的北部常常下雪。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de běibù chángcháng xià xuě.
examples.english: It often snows in the north in winter.

笨.meaning: stupid; slow-witted; clumsy: 笨办法, 我太笨了

examples.hanzi: 这个办法虽然笨, 但是很管用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ suīrán bèn, dànshì hěn guǎnyòng.
examples.english: This method is clumsy, but it works.

笨.meaning: clumsy; unwieldy (of movements or tools): 他动作很笨; 笨重的机器

examples.hanzi: 他动作很笨, 学不会跳舞。
examples.pinyin: Tā dòngzuò hěn bèn, xué bu huì tiàowǔ.
examples.english: His movements are clumsy; he can't learn to dance.

本科.meaning: undergraduate (education); bachelor's degree program: 本科生, 本科毕业

examples.hanzi: 她本科是在北京大学读的。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnkē shì zài Běijīng Dàxué dú de.
examples.english: She did her undergraduate degree at Peking University.

本来.meaning: originally; at first: 他本来不想去

examples.hanzi: 他本来不想去, 后来还是去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnlái bù xiǎng qù, hòulái háishì qù le.
examples.english: Originally he didn't want to go, but went anyway in the end.

本来.meaning: original; inherent (本来面目 one's true colors — mainly in set phrases)

examples.hanzi: 毒品让他露出了本来面目。
examples.pinyin: Dǔpǐn ràng tā lòu chū le běnlái miànmù.
examples.english: The drugs revealed his true colors.

便于.meaning: to be convenient for; to make it easy for (便于 + verb): 便于携带, 便于管理

examples.hanzi: 老师把资料放上网, 便于学生随时查看。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zīliào fàng shàng wǎng, biànyú xuéshēng suíshí chákàn.
examples.english: The teacher put the materials online so students could check them anytime.

表.meaning: watch; clock (wristwatch): 一块表, 手表, 电子表

examples.hanzi: 他看了一眼手表, 站起来走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn le yī yǎn shǒubiǎo, zhàn qǐlai zǒu le.
examples.english: He glanced at his watch, stood up and left.

表.meaning: table; form; chart: 时间表, 课程表, 填表

examples.hanzi: 请先填写这张报名表。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān tiánxiě zhè zhāng bàomíng biǎo.
examples.english: Please first fill in this registration form.

表格.meaning: form; table (with rows and columns to fill in): 填表格, 下载报名表格

examples.hanzi: 请把表格里的空都填上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ biǎogé li de kòng dōu tián shang.
examples.english: Please fill in all the blanks in the form.

表示.meaning: to express; to indicate; to show: 表示感谢, 表示态度

examples.hanzi: 大家用掌声表示感谢。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yòng zhǎngshēng biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
examples.english: Everyone expressed thanks with applause.

表示.meaning: expression; indication; statement: 友好的表示

examples.hanzi: 这是一个友好的表示。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī ge yǒuhǎo de biǎoshì.
examples.english: This is a friendly gesture.

表现.meaning: to behave; to perform; to show (one's ability, character): 表现得很好; 他在比赛中表现突出

examples.hanzi: 他在这次比赛中表现得非常出色。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè cì bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de fēicháng chūsè.
examples.english: He performed outstandingly in this competition.

表现.meaning: performance; behavior; showing: 学习表现, 艺术表现

examples.hanzi: 老师表扬了他这学期的学习表现。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī biǎoyáng le tā zhè xuéqī de xuéxí biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The teacher praised his academic performance this term.

near_synonyms.difference: 表扬 is praise from a superior for concrete good behavior (老师表扬学生); 赞美 is expressing admiration for something beautiful or great (赞美风景)

表扬.meaning: to praise; to commend (typically a superior praising a subordinate, or a teacher praising students): 老师表扬了他

examples.hanzi: 因为他帮助了同学, 老师表扬了他。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā bāngzhù le tóngxué, lǎoshī biǎoyáng le tā.
examples.english: Because he helped a classmate, the teacher praised him.

examples.hanzi: 他受到校长的公开表扬。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòudào xiàozhǎng de gōngkāi biǎoyáng.
examples.english: He received public praise from the principal.

标准.meaning: standard; criterion; norm: 标准 different from 水平 level; 达到标准, 生活标准

examples.hanzi: 这个产品不符合安全标准。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn bù fúhé ānquān biāozhǔn.
examples.english: This product doesn't meet safety standards.

标准.meaning: standard (as adjective): 标准发音, 标准答案; also (colloquial) speaking standard Mandarin: 他普通话说得很标准

examples.hanzi: 他的普通话发音很标准。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Pǔtōnghuà fāyīn hěn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: His Mandarin pronunciation is very standard.

并.meaning: (emphasis before a negative) not at all; by no means: 并不难, 我并没有生气 — reinforces negation

examples.hanzi: 这个问题并不难, 你别担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bìng bù nán, nǐ bié dānxīn.
examples.english: This problem is not difficult at all — don't worry.

并.meaning: side by side; simultaneously (并存, 并肩 — mainly in compounds)

examples.hanzi: 两条铁路在这里并行。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng tiáo tiělù zài zhèlǐ bìngxíng.
examples.english: Two railway lines run side by side here.

并.meaning: the city of Bing (并州, ancient name for Taiyuan) — rare, mainly historical

examples.hanzi: 并州是太原的古称。
examples.pinyin: Bīngzhōu shì Tàiyuán de gǔchēng.
examples.english: Bingzhou is the ancient name of Taiyuan.

饼干.meaning: biscuit; cookie; cracker (measure word 块 or 包)

examples.hanzi: 他喝牛奶的时候喜欢吃几块饼干。
examples.pinyin: Tā hē niúnǎi de shíhou xǐhuan chī jǐ kuài bǐnggān.
examples.english: He likes to eat a few biscuits with his milk.

并且.meaning: and; moreover; and also (joins verbs or clauses): 他会说法语, 并且说得很流利

examples.hanzi: 她会说法语, 并且说得很流利。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì shuō Fǎyǔ, bìngqiě shuō de hěn liúlì.
examples.english: She speaks French, and speaks it fluently.

笔试.meaning: written examination (as opposed to 口试 oral exam): 笔试成绩, 参加笔试

examples.hanzi: 笔试通过了才能参加面试。
examples.pinyin: Bǐshì tōngguò le cái néng cānjiā miànshì.
examples.english: Only after passing the written exam can you take the interview.

毕业.meaning: to graduate: 大学毕业, 毕业以后; 离合词-like: 毕了业 (from a school: 从/在 + school + 毕业)

examples.hanzi: 他大学毕业后就工作了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu jiù gōngzuò le.
examples.english: He started working right after graduating from university.

毕业生.meaning: graduate (person who has finished school): 应届毕业生 this year's graduates

examples.hanzi: 今年我们学校有两千个毕业生。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu liǎng qiān ge bìyèshēng.
examples.english: Our school has two thousand graduates this year.

鼻子.meaning: nose (measure word 个 or only in idioms 一鼻子灰): 我的鼻子不通气

examples.hanzi: 他的鼻子长得像他爸爸。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bízi zhǎng de xiàng tā bàba.
examples.english: His nose looks like his father's.

播放.meaning: to broadcast; to play (audio or video): 播放音乐, 播放新闻

examples.hanzi: 广播里正在播放新闻。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngbō li zhèngzài bōfàng xīnwén.
examples.english: The radio is broadcasting the news.

博士.meaning: doctor (academic degree); PhD: 博士学位, 读博士

examples.hanzi: 她是一位计算机科学博士。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi jìsuànjī kēxué bóshì.
examples.english: She is a PhD in computer science.

步.meaning: step; pace (in walking): 散步, 跑步, 走一步

examples.hanzi: 我每天晚饭后都去散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān wǎnfàn hòu dōu qù sànbù.
examples.english: I go for a walk after dinner every day.

步.meaning: step; stage (in a process): 下一步, 一步一步来

examples.hanzi: 下一步我们应该先做市场调查。
examples.pinyin: Xià yī bù wǒmen yīnggāi xiān zuò shìchǎng diàochá.
examples.english: The next step is to do market research first.

步.meaning: measure word for steps in a process: 第一步, 前两步

examples.hanzi: 解决这个问题要分三步。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhège wèntí yào fēn sān bù.
examples.english: Solving this problem takes three steps.

部.meaning: part; section (of a whole): 内部, 外部, 部分

examples.hanzi: 这个问题属于学校的内部问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shǔyú xuéxiào de nèibù wèntí.
examples.english: This problem is an internal matter of the school.

部.meaning: ministry; department (of government): 教育部, 文化部

examples.hanzi: 教育部发布了新的规定。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyùbù fābù le xīn de guīdìng.
examples.english: The Ministry of Education issued new regulations.

部.meaning: measure word for machines, vehicles, films, phones: 一部电影, 两部手机, 一部车

examples.hanzi: 他昨天买了一部新手机。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān mǎi le yī bù xīn shǒujī.
examples.english: He bought a new phone yesterday.

near_synonyms.difference: 不必 is slightly more formal/written; 不用 is the everyday colloquial 'no need' (不用去了). Largely interchangeable.

不必.meaning: need not; not necessary: 不必担心, 您不必客气

examples.hanzi: 只是帮个小忙, 您不必客气。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐ shì bāng ge xiǎo máng, nín búbì kèqi.
examples.english: It's just a small favor — you needn't be so polite.

不便.meaning: inconvenient: 交通不便; 有点儿不便

examples.hanzi: 山区交通不便, 孩子们上学要走很远。
examples.pinyin: Shānqū jiāotōng bùbiàn, háizimen shàngxué yào zǒu hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: Transport is inconvenient in the mountains; children walk far to school.

不便.meaning: to be inconvenient for (someone);不方便: 不便说, 不便打扰 — polite hedge

examples.hanzi: 这个问题涉及个人隐私, 我不便多说。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shèjí gèrén yǐnsī, wǒ bùbiàn duō shuō.
examples.english: This matter involves personal privacy, so it's not convenient for me to say more.

near_synonyms.difference: 不得不 stresses being forced against one's wishes (不得不加班); 只能 states the only remaining option without the reluctance nuance

不得不.meaning: to have no choice but to; cannot but; be forced to: 不得不加班

examples.hanzi: 雨下得太大, 我们不得不取消比赛。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ xià de tài dà, wǒmen bùdébù qǔxiāo bǐsài.
examples.english: The rain was too heavy; we had no choice but to cancel the match.

不断.meaning: continuously; unceasingly: 不断发展, 不断地学习

examples.hanzi: 这些年城市在不断地发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián chéngshì zài bùduàn de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: These years the city has been developing continuously.

部分.meaning: part; portion; section: 大部分, 一部分, 组成部分

examples.hanzi: 这本书的大部分内容我都看懂了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de dà bùfen nèiróng wǒ dōu kàn dǒng le.
examples.english: I understood most of this book.

部分.meaning: department; unit (of an organization) — variant reading bùfèn used in military/organizational contexts

examples.hanzi: 请把这份部分文件发给各部门。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn bùfen wénjiàn fā gěi gè bùmén.
examples.english: Please distribute this portion of the documents to each department.

不够.meaning: not enough; insufficient: 钱不够, 不够好 (falls short of a standard)

examples.hanzi: 我们的时间不够, 得抓紧一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de shíjiān bùgòu, déi zhuājǐn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: We don't have enough time; we need to hurry.

不够.meaning: not quite; rather… (understated criticism): 不够礼貌 rather impolite, 不够聪明 not too bright

examples.hanzi: 他这样说话不够礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng shuōhuà bùgòu lǐmào.
examples.english: Talking like that is rather impolite.

不管.meaning: no matter (how, what, who): 不管多忙, 我都会去; 不管下雨还是下雪 — must pair with 都/也 in the main clause

examples.hanzi: 不管多累, 他每天都坚持锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn duō lèi, tā měitiān dōu jiānchí duànliàn.
examples.english: No matter how tired, he exercises every day.

不管.meaning: to ignore; to disregard (a person or obligation): 不管孩子 — less common than sense 1

examples.hanzi: 父母不能什么都不管孩子。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng shénme dōu bùguǎn háizi.
examples.english: Parents can't leave their children to do whatever they like.

不光.meaning: not only; not just (colloquial equivalent of 不仅): 不光会说英语, 还会说法语

examples.hanzi: 他不光会说英语, 还会说日语。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùguāng huì shuō Yīngyǔ, hái huì shuō Rìyǔ.
examples.english: He not only speaks English but also Japanese.

不过.meaning: but; however; only (mild contrastive): 不错是不错, 不过太贵了

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服不错, 不过有点儿贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu búcuò, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: This clothing is nice, but a bit expensive.

不过.meaning: only; merely (最多不过…): 他不过开了个玩笑

examples.hanzi: 我不过开了个玩笑, 你别生气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búguò kāi le ge wánxiào, nǐ bié shēngqì.
examples.english: I was only joking — don't be angry.

不仅.meaning: not only… (but also) — 不仅…而且/还: 他不仅是老师, 而且是作家

examples.hanzi: 他不仅是我的老师, 也是我的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì wǒ de lǎoshī, yě shì wǒ de péngyou.
examples.english: He is not only my teacher but also my friend.

不论.meaning: no matter; regardless of (不论…都/也): 不论刮风下雨, 他都坚持跑步 — slightly more formal than 不管

examples.hanzi: 不论刮风下雨, 他都六点起床。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn guāfēng xiàyǔ, tā dōu liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: Rain or shine, he gets up at six.

不满.meaning: dissatisfied; discontented: 对服务很不满, 表示不满

examples.hanzi: 顾客对服务员的态度表示不满。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè duì fúwùyuán de tàidù biǎoshì bùmǎn.
examples.english: The customer expressed dissatisfaction with the waiter's attitude.

部门.meaning: department; section (of an organization): 销售部门, 政府部门

examples.hanzi: 这个问题请找销售部门解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí qǐng zhǎo xiāoshòu bùmén jiějué.
examples.english: For this problem please contact the sales department.

不如.meaning: to be inferior to; not as good as: 他不如我高; 手写信不如电子邮件快 (A 不如 B + adjective)

examples.hanzi: 我的水平不如他, 还得好好练习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shuǐpíng bùrú tā, hái děi hǎohao liànxí.
examples.english: My level is not as good as his; I still need to practice.

不如.meaning: it would be better to (suggesting an alternative): 不如我们打车去吧

examples.hanzi: 打车太贵, 不如我们坐地铁去吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎchē tài guì, bùrú wǒmen zuò dìtiě qù ba.
examples.english: A taxi is too expensive — why don't we just take the metro.

擦.meaning: to wipe; to rub; to scrub: 擦桌子, 擦玻璃

examples.hanzi: 他一边擦桌子一边听音乐。
examples.pinyin: Tā yībiān cā zhuōzi yībiān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: He wiped the table while listening to music.

擦.meaning: to apply (cream, oil) by rubbing: 擦防晒霜, 擦药

examples.hanzi: 出门前她擦了一点儿防晒霜。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā cā le yīdiǎnr fángshàishuāng.
examples.english: She put on a little sunscreen before going out.

猜.meaning: to guess: 猜谜语, 你猜猜看; 猜对了/猜错了

examples.hanzi: 你猜猜今天谁来我们家了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cāicai jīntiān shéi lái wǒmen jiā le.
examples.english: Guess who came to our house today.

材料.meaning: material; stuff (something is made from): 建筑材料, 原材料

examples.hanzi: 这种建筑材料又轻又结实。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiànzhù cáiliào yòu qīng yòu jiēshi.
examples.english: This building material is both light and sturdy.

材料.meaning: materials; documents; data (for a task or application): 准备材料, 报名材料

examples.hanzi: 申请学校要准备很多材料。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng xuéxiào yào zhǔnbèi hěn duō cáiliào.
examples.english: Applying to schools requires preparing many documents.

near_synonyms.difference: 看 is the general word for looking/watching (看电影); 参观 is specifically a formal look around a place like a museum or factory (参观工厂)

参观.meaning: to visit and look around (a place, not a person): 参观博物馆, 参观工厂

examples.hanzi: 我们下午去参观博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù cānguān bówùguǎn.
examples.english: We're going to visit the museum this afternoon.

参赛.meaning: to take part in a competition or match: 参赛作品, 参赛选手

examples.hanzi: 她准备参赛的作品是一幅画。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi cānsài de zuòpǐn shì yī fú huà.
examples.english: The work she prepared for the contest is a painting.

餐厅.meaning: dining hall; restaurant: 学校餐厅, 中餐厅

examples.hanzi: 学校餐厅的饭又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng de fàn yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: The school cafeteria food is cheap and tasty.

操场.meaning: sports ground; playground (at a school): 在操场上跑步

examples.hanzi: 下课以后, 操场上到处都是学生。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐhòu, cāochǎng shang dàochù dōu shì xuéshēng.
examples.english: After class the playground is full of students everywhere.

厕所.meaning: toilet; restroom; washroom (colloquial; formal is 洗手间 or 卫生间): 上厕所

examples.hanzi: 请问附近的厕所在哪儿?
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn fùjìn de cèsuǒ zài nǎr?
examples.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom nearby?

查看.meaning: to look over; to check; to examine (details, records): 查看邮件, 查看地图

examples.hanzi: 请查看您的邮箱, 我们发了确认信。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng chákàn nín de yóuxiāng, wǒmen fā le quèrèn xìn.
examples.english: Please check your email; we've sent a confirmation.

厂.meaning: factory; plant (mainly as a bound form in compounds: 工厂, 厂长, 出厂): 在厂里工作 — standalone use is colloquial/regional

examples.hanzi: 他爸爸在钢厂工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàba zài gāngchǎng gōngzuò.
examples.english: His dad works at a steel plant.

场.meaning: measure word for events, activities, performances: 一场比赛, 一场电影, 一场大雨

examples.hanzi: 昨晚下了一场大雨。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn xià le yī cháng dà yǔ.
examples.english: It rained heavily last night.

场.meaning: field; ground; venue (sports or performance): 操场, 市场, 机场, 广场

examples.hanzi: 飞机十点在机场起飞。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī shí diǎn zài jīchǎng qǐfēi.
examples.english: The plane takes off at ten at the airport.

场.meaning: measure word for a complete course/run of an event: 一场大病, 闹了一场笑话

examples.hanzi: 他生了一场大病, 瘦了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēng le yī cháng dà bìng, shòu le hěn duō.
examples.english: He had a serious illness and lost a lot of weight.

产生.meaning: to produce; to give rise to; to bring about (an effect, feeling, idea): 产生兴趣, 产生影响

examples.hanzi: 这部电影在年轻人中产生了很大的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài niánqīngrén zhōng chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This film had a big impact among young people.

near_synonyms.difference: 超过 is surpassing a number or level in everyday use (超过限速); 超越 is more abstract/literary — transcending limits or oneself (超越自我)

超过.meaning: to exceed; to surpass; to overtake: 超过限速, 超过一万人

examples.hanzi: 考试人数超过了一万人。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì rénshù chāoguò le yī wàn rén.
examples.english: The number of exam takers exceeded ten thousand.

茶叶.meaning: tea leaves; tea (as a commodity): 买茶叶, 茶叶店

examples.hanzi: 这罐茶叶是朋友从杭州带来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè guàn cháyè shì péngyou cóng Hángzhōu dài lái de.
examples.english: This jar of tea leaves was brought from Hangzhou by a friend.

差（一）点儿.meaning: almost; nearly (something undesirable almost happened) (一点儿 optional, may be inserted after 差): 差点儿迟到, 差点儿摔倒了 — negation flips meaning: 差点儿没赶上 nearly failed to catch it

examples.hanzi: 我今天早上差点儿迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang chà diǎnr chídào le.
examples.english: I was almost late this morning.

差（一）点儿.meaning: (falling) short of; a little less than (一点儿 optional): 分数差点儿 just short of the cutoff; 还差点儿 not quite there yet

examples.hanzi: 他的分数离及格线还差一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fēnshù lí jígé xiàn hái chà yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: His score is still a little short of the passing line.

查找.meaning: to look up; to search for (information, an error): 查找资料, 查找错误

examples.hanzi: 我在网上查找这个问题的答案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎngshang cházhǎo zhège wèntí de dá'àn.
examples.english: I searched online for the answer to this question.

城.meaning: city; town (bound or semi-bound form: 城市, 长城, 进城): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 周末我们进城买东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen jìn chéng mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: We're going into the city to shop this weekend.

城.meaning: city wall (ancient): 城墙, 城门 — historical

examples.hanzi: 西安的古城墙有六百多年了。
examples.pinyin: Xī'ān de gǔ chéngqiáng yǒu liùbǎi duō nián le.
examples.english: Xi'an's ancient city wall is over six hundred years old.

乘1.meaning: to ride; to take (a vehicle): 乘地铁, 乘飞机 — formal equivalent of 坐/搭

examples.hanzi: 乘客请从二号门乘机场大巴。
examples.pinyin: Chéngkè qǐng cóng èr hào mén chéng jīchǎng dàbā.
examples.english: Passengers please take the airport shuttle from Gate 2.

乘1.meaning: to multiply (arithmetic): 乘以三 multiply by three — mathematical term

examples.hanzi: 三乘以五等于十五。
examples.pinyin: Sān chéng yǐ wǔ děngyú shíwǔ.
examples.english: Three times five equals fifteen.

成功.meaning: to succeed: 实验成功了, 他终于成功了

examples.hanzi: 经过三年努力, 实验终于成功了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián nǔlì, shíyàn zhōngyú chénggōng le.
examples.english: After three years of effort, the experiment finally succeeded.

成功.meaning: successful: 很成功的演出, 成功的经验

examples.hanzi: 那是一次很成功的演出。
examples.pinyin: Nà shì yī cì hěn chénggōng de yǎnchū.
examples.english: That was a very successful performance.

examples.hanzi: 请乘客们系好安全带。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng chéngkèmen jì hǎo ānquándài.
examples.english: Passengers, please fasten your seatbelts.

near_synonyms.difference: 诚实 is about telling the truth (诚实的孩子); 老实 adds the sense of being well-behaved or simple, and can mean docile (老实人, 别太老实了)

诚实.meaning: honest; truthful: 诚实的孩子, 为人诚实

examples.hanzi: 诚实是做人的基本原则。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshí shì zuò rén de jīběn yuánzé.
examples.english: Honesty is a basic principle of being a person.

成为.meaning: to become; to turn into: 成为一名医生, 成为朋友

examples.hanzi: 他毕业后成为一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìyè hòu chéngwéi yī míng yīshēng.
examples.english: After graduating he became a doctor.

乘坐.meaning: to ride; to take (a vehicle) — formal: 乘坐高铁, 乘坐飞机

examples.hanzi: 欢迎乘坐本次航班。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng chéngzuò běn cì hángbān.
examples.english: Welcome aboard this flight.

车速.meaning: vehicle speed; speed of a car: 车速太快, 降低车速

examples.hanzi: 下雪了, 请降低车速。
examples.pinyin: Xià xuě le, qǐng jiàngdī chēsù.
examples.english: It's snowing — please slow down.

车位.meaning: parking space; parking spot: 找车位, 一个车位

examples.hanzi: 商场地下停车场还有很多车位。
examples.pinyin: Shāngchǎng dìxià tíngchēchǎng hái yǒu hěn duō chēwèi.
examples.english: The mall's underground parking lot still has many spaces.

迟.meaning: late (formal; colloquial is 晚): 迟到, 来迟了

examples.hanzi: 他迟到了十分钟, 向大家道歉。
examples.pinyin: Tā chídào le shí fēnzhōng, xiàng dàjiā dàoqiàn.
examples.english: He was ten minutes late and apologized to everyone.

吃惊.meaning: to be surprised; amazed: 很吃惊, 吃惊地看着他 — usually with 很/十分

examples.hanzi: 听到这个消息, 大家都很吃惊。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu hěn chījīng.
examples.english: Hearing this news, everyone was surprised.

examples.hanzi: 这个箱子太重了, 我搬不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng le, wǒ bān bu dòng.
examples.english: This box is too heavy; I can't move it.

重.meaning: serious; severe; major (of illness, mistakes): 病得很重, 重感冒

examples.hanzi: 他感冒很重, 在家休息了一个星期。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǎnmào hěn zhòng, zài jiā xiūxi le yī ge xīngqī.
examples.english: His cold was severe and he rested at home for a week.

重.meaning: to attach importance to; to value (重视 sense): 重人才, 重感情 — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这家公司最重人才。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zuì zhòng réncái.
examples.english: This company values talent above all.

重.meaning: again; once more; re-: 重新, 重来一次, 重修

examples.hanzi: 文件丢了，只好重新写一遍。
examples.pinyin: Wénjiàn diū le, zhǐhǎo chóngxīn xiě yī biàn.
examples.english: The file was lost, so I had to rewrite it all over again.

重.meaning: layer (in classical/counting use: 万重山 — literary)

examples.hanzi: 远处的万重山看不清。
examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù de wàn chóng shān kàn bu qīng.
examples.english: The many layers of mountains in the distance are hard to see.

重新.meaning: again; anew; afresh (do something over): 重新开始, 重新考虑

examples.hanzi: 让我们重新开始, 好好谈一谈。
examples.pinyin: Ràng wǒmen chóngxiān kāishǐ, hǎohao tán yī tán.
examples.english: Let's start over and have a good talk.

窗.meaning: window (bound form: 窗户, 窗口, 窗帘): standalone use is literary/dialectal

examples.hanzi: 冬天窗上的冰花很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān chuāng shang de bīnghuā hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The frost flowers on the window in winter are beautiful.

窗户.meaning: window: 开窗户, 关窗户, 窗户开着

examples.hanzi: 教室的窗户都开着, 里面很凉快。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì de chuānghu dōu kāizhe, lǐmiàn hěn liángkuai.
examples.english: The classroom windows are all open; it's cool inside.

出差.meaning: to go on a business trip (离合词-like: 出了三次差): 他这周出差去了上海

examples.hanzi: 他这个月出差去了两次上海。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè chūchāi qù le liǎng cì Shànghǎi.
examples.english: He's been to Shanghai on business twice this month.

厨房.meaning: kitchen: 在厨房做饭, 厨房里

examples.hanzi: 妈妈在厨房里忙着做晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Māma zài chúfáng li mángzhe zuò wǎnfàn.
examples.english: Mom is busy cooking dinner in the kitchen.

吹.meaning: to blow (wind, air): 风吹着, 吹气球

examples.hanzi: 外面吹着大风, 树都弯了。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn chuīzhe dà fēng, shù dōu wān le.
examples.english: A strong wind is blowing outside; the trees are bent.

吹.meaning: to play (a wind instrument): 吹笛子, 吹号

examples.hanzi: 他会吹笛子, 也弹钢琴。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chuī dízi, yě tán gāngqín.
examples.english: He can play the flute and also the piano.

吹.meaning: to boast; to brag (吹牛): 他就爱吹

examples.hanzi: 他这个人就爱吹, 说的话一半是假的。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège rén jiù ài chuī, shuō de huà yībàn shì jiǎ de.
examples.english: This guy just loves to brag — half of what he says is untrue.

出口.meaning: exit; way out: 安全出口, 找出口

examples.hanzi: 安全出口在走廊的尽头。
examples.pinyin: ānquán chūkǒu zài zǒulàng de jìntóu.
examples.english: The emergency exit is at the end of the corridor.

出口.meaning: to export; export (as trade): 出口商品, 出口贸易

examples.hanzi: 这些商品主要出口到欧洲。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn zhǔyào chūkǒu dào ōuzhōu.
examples.english: These goods are mainly exported to Europe.

厨师.meaning: chef; cook (professional): 一位厨师, 当厨师

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的厨师做菜又快又好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de chúshī zuò cài yòu kuài yòu hǎo.
examples.english: This restaurant's chef cooks fast and well.

出现.meaning: to appear; to arise; to emerge: 问题出现了, 出现了新情况

examples.hanzi: 路上出现了一个大坑, 司机们都很小心。
examples.pinyin: Lù shang chūxiàn le yī ge dà kēng, sījīmen dōu hěn xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: A big pothole appeared on the road; drivers are all being careful.

出行.meaning: to go on a trip; to travel (formal, often in announcements about transport): 出行高峰, 绿色出行

examples.hanzi: 节假日出行的人特别多。
examples.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì chūxíng de rén tèbié duō.
examples.english: There are especially many people traveling on holidays.

出租.meaning: to rent out; to lease (the owner's side): 出租房子; also in 出租车 taxi

examples.hanzi: 房东想把房子出租给留学生。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng xiǎng bǎ fángzi chūzū gěi liúxuéshēng.
examples.english: The landlord wants to rent the house to international students.

此.meaning: this; these (formal written equivalent of 这): 此次, 此地, 从此, 因此

examples.hanzi: 此次会议讨论了三个问题。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ cì huìyì tǎolùn le sān ge wèntí.
examples.english: This meeting discussed three questions.

此次.meaning: this time; on this occasion (formal): 此次访问, 此次比赛

examples.hanzi: 此次比赛共有二十个队参加。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ cì bǐsài gòng yǒu èrshí ge duì cānjiā.
examples.english: Twenty teams took part in this competition.

此外.meaning: besides; in addition; moreover (formal): 此外, 还要注意安全

examples.hanzi: 他会唱歌; 此外, 他还会画画儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng gē; cǐwài, tā hái huì huà huàr.
examples.english: He can sing; besides that, he can also draw.

词语.meaning: words and phrases; vocabulary items: 新词语, 词语搭配

examples.hanzi: 老师让我们用新学的词语造句。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen yòng xīn xué de cíyǔ zào jù.
examples.english: The teacher had us make sentences with the new words we learned.

从此.meaning: from then on; from this point on: 从此以后, 从此他再也不迟到了

examples.hanzi: 大学毕业后, 他从此留在了北京。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, tā cóngcǐ liú zài le Běijīng.
examples.english: After graduating from university, he stayed in Beijing from then on.

从来.meaning: always; at all times (with negation: never): 他从来不迟到; 从来没见过

examples.hanzi: 他从来不喝咖啡, 只喝茶。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù hē kāfēi, zhǐ hē chá.
examples.english: He never drinks coffee; he only drinks tea.

从中.meaning: from it; out of this (formal): 从中选择, 从中学习, 从中受益

examples.hanzi: 多读好书, 你会从中得到很多乐趣。
examples.pinyin: Duō dú hǎo shū, nǐ huì cóngzhōng dédào hěn duō lèqù.
examples.english: Read good books and you'll get much enjoyment out of them.

粗.meaning: thick (in diameter or cross-section; opposite of 细): 这棵树很粗, 粗线条

examples.hanzi: 这棵树很粗, 两个人才抱得过来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē shù hěn cū, liǎng ge rén cái bào de guòlái.
examples.english: This tree is so thick it takes two people to reach around it.

粗.meaning: rough; coarse; crude: 皮肤粗, 粗布

examples.hanzi: 他的手很粗, 都是干活的痕迹。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒu hěn cū, dōu shì gànhuó de hénjì.
examples.english: His hands are rough — all traces of labor.

粗.meaning: rough; careless (of behavior or manners): 粗鲁, 动作粗

examples.hanzi: 说话别这么粗鲁。
examples.pinyin: Shuōhuà bié zhème cūlǔ.
examples.english: Don't speak so rudely.

存.meaning: to deposit; to store; to save (money, data): 存钱, 存文件

examples.hanzi: 他每个月都往银行里存两千块钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu wǎng yínháng li cún liǎng qiān kuài qián.
examples.english: He deposits 2,000 yuan in the bank every month.

存.meaning: to keep; to preserve (存在, 保存, 存货 — mainly in compounds): 好好保存

examples.hanzi: 这些老照片保存了三十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǎo zhàopiàn bǎocún le sānshí nián.
examples.english: These old photos have been kept for thirty years.

存.meaning: to be left over; to remain (存货, 结存) — commercial register

examples.hanzi: 仓库里存着很多货。
examples.pinyin: Cāngkù li cúnzhe hěn duō huò.
examples.english: A lot of goods are stored in the warehouse.

村.meaning: village (bound or semi-bound: 村子, 农村, 村里): 我们村 — semi-standalone in northern colloquial use

examples.hanzi: 我们村今年通了新公路。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cūn jīnnián tōng le xīn gōnglù.
examples.english: Our village got a new road this year.

near_synonyms.difference: 错过 is missing a chance or bus because you were late or inattentive (错过机会); 失去 is losing something you already had (失去信心, 失去朋友)

错过.meaning: to miss (a chance, bus, appointment): 错过末班车, 错过机会

examples.hanzi: 路上堵车, 我错过了开会的时间。
examples.pinyin: Lù shang dǔchē, wǒ cuòguò le kāihuì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Traffic was jammed and I missed the meeting time.

错误.meaning: mistake; error: 犯错误, 改正错误

examples.hanzi: 他勇敢地承认了自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒnggǎn de chéngrèn le zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: He bravely admitted his mistake.

错误.meaning: wrong; incorrect (formal): 错误的想法, 错误地认为

examples.hanzi: 这种想法是完全错误的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ shì wánquán cuòwù de.
examples.english: This way of thinking is completely wrong.

near_synonyms.difference: 粗心 emphasizes not paying attention (粗心大意); 马虎 emphasizes doing things in a slapdash way. Both colloquial; 粗心 is slightly more neutral.

粗心.meaning: careless; absent-minded: 粗心大意, 他很粗心

examples.hanzi: 他太粗心了, 考试忘写了名字。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài cūxīn le, kǎoshì wàng xiě le míngzi.
examples.english: He was so careless he forgot to write his name on the exam.

答.meaning: to answer; to reply: 回答 problem/questions (答题, 答应 agree — mainly in compounds): 答对了

examples.hanzi: 老师提问, 他第一个举手答。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíwèn, tā dì yī ge jǔshǒu dá.
examples.english: The teacher asked a question and he was first to raise his hand to answer.

打招呼.meaning: to greet; to say hello (离合词: 打了个招呼): 和邻居打招呼

examples.hanzi: 他在楼道里和邻居打招呼。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lóudào li hé línjū dǎ zhāohu.
examples.english: He greeted the neighbors in the corridor.

答案.meaning: answer; solution: 标准答案, 找到答案

examples.hanzi: 这个问题的答案有很多种。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de dá'àn yǒu hěn duō zhǒng.
examples.english: This question has many possible answers.

大巴.meaning: coach; large bus (colloquial, from 'bus'): 坐大巴去

examples.hanzi: 我们坐大巴去机场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò dàbā qù jīchǎng.
examples.english: We took the coach to the airport.

打败.meaning: to defeat; to beat: 打败对手, 打败了敌人

examples.hanzi: 我们队打败了去年的冠军。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duì dǎbài le qùnián de guànjūn.
examples.english: Our team defeated last year's champions.

大大.meaning: greatly; considerably (before verbs, formal-leaning): 大大提高, 大大改善 — or 大大咧咧 careless in manner

examples.hanzi: 新方法大大提高了工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Xīn fāngfǎ dàdà tígāo le gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The new method greatly improved work efficiency.

near_synonyms.difference: 达到 is reaching a level, goal or standard (达到目的); 到达 is physically arriving at a place (到达北京)

达到.meaning: to reach; to attain (a level, goal, standard): 达到目的, 达到标准

examples.hanzi: 他的汉语水平已经达到了六级。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yǐjīng dádào le liù jí.
examples.english: His Chinese has already reached Level 6.

打工.meaning: to work (a part-time or wage job, often temporarily or abroad) (离合词: 打了三年工): 在餐厅打工

examples.hanzi: 他在餐厅打工, 一个月挣三千块。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài cāntīng dǎgōng, yī ge yuè zhèng sān qiān kuài.
examples.english: He works at a restaurant, earning 3,000 yuan a month.

near_synonyms.difference: 戴 is for accessories — hat, glasses, watch (戴帽子); 穿 is for clothing and shoes (穿衣服, 穿鞋)

戴.meaning: to wear (accessories: glasses, hat, watch, gloves): 戴眼镜, 戴帽子, 戴手表

examples.hanzi: 她戴着帽子和眼镜。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàizhe màozi hé yǎnjìng.
examples.english: She was wearing a hat and glasses.

待.meaning: to stay (colloquial, = 待在): 我在北京待了三年 — often written 待 in the Mainland

examples.hanzi: 我在北京待了三年。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng dāi le sān nián.
examples.english: I stayed in Beijing for three years.

待.meaning: to treat; to deal with (对待 sense): 待人很好 — formal

examples.hanzi: 这家公司待员工很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dài yuángōng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This company treats its employees well.

待.meaning: to wait (等待 sense): 待售, 待机 — formal compounds

examples.hanzi: 这些问题还有待解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí hái yǒu dài jiějué.
examples.english: These problems still await solving.

大夫.meaning: doctor; physician (colloquial; formal is 医生): 看大夫

examples.hanzi: 王大夫的号很难挂。
examples.pinyin: Wáng dàifu de hào hěn nán guà.
examples.english: It's hard to get an appointment with Dr. Wang.

袋子.meaning: bag; sack; pouch: 塑料袋子, 一个袋子

examples.hanzi: 请给我一个袋子, 我要装东西。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī ge dàizi, wǒ yào zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Please give me a bag; I need to carry things.

大量.meaning: a large amount/number of: 大量的事实, 消耗大量能源

examples.hanzi: 做研究需要阅读大量的资料。
examples.pinyin: Zuò yánjiū xūyào yuèdú dàliàng de zīliào.
examples.english: Doing research requires reading a large amount of material.

当.meaning: at (a time); right when (当…时/的时候, formal): 当他进来的时候

examples.hanzi: 当他进门的时候, 大家都站了起来。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tā jìn mén de shíhou, dàjiā dōu zhàn le qǐlai.
examples.english: When he entered, everyone stood up.

当.meaning: to serve as; to work as; to be (a role): 当老师, 当选, 当班长

examples.hanzi: 毕业后他想当一名老师。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu tā xiǎng dāng yī míng lǎoshī.
examples.english: After graduating he wants to be a teacher.

当.meaning: to regard as; to treat as: 把他当朋友

examples.hanzi: 我一直把他当好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí bǎ tā dāng hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: I've always regarded him as a good friend.

当.meaning: clang; ding (sound of a bell or metal): 当当响 — written form

examples.hanzi: 远处传来当当的钟声。
examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù chuán lái dāngdāng de zhōngshēng.
examples.english: The ding-dong of a bell came from afar.

当.meaning: to pawn; to mortgage: 当掉手表

examples.hanzi: 他困难的时候当掉了手表。
examples.pinyin: Tā kùnnan de shíhou dàngdiào le shǒubiǎo.
examples.english: When he was hard up he pawned his watch.

当.meaning: appropriate; proper (恰当 sense, in 恰当/妥当/适当 compounds): 处理得当 — formal

examples.hanzi: 这篇课文处理得很得当。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén chǔlǐ de hěn dédàng.
examples.english: This passage has been handled appropriately.

当时.meaning: at that time; at the moment in question: 当时我在场, 当时没想到

examples.hanzi: 当时我就在现场, 看得很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Dāngshí wǒ jiù zài xiànchǎng, kàn de hěn qīngchu.
examples.english: I was right there at the time and saw it clearly.

单位.meaning: work unit; organization one works for: 工作单位, 在单位吃饭 — Mainland usage

examples.hanzi: 请填写您的工作单位。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng tiánxiě nín de gōngzuò dānwèi.
examples.english: Please fill in your work unit.

单位.meaning: unit (of measurement, organization): 计量单位, 基本单位

examples.hanzi: 米是长度的基本单位。
examples.pinyin: Mǐ shì chángdù de jīběn dānwèi.
examples.english: The meter is the basic unit of length.

倒.meaning: to fall over; to topple; to collapse: 摔倒了, 倒了下来

examples.hanzi: 老人在浴室里滑倒了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén zài yùshì li huá dǎo le.
examples.english: The old man slipped and fell in the bathroom.

倒.meaning: to close down (a business); to fail (银行倒了) — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 那家小公司去年就倒了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā xiǎo gōngsī qùnián jiù dǎo le.
examples.english: That small company went under last year.

倒.meaning: to pour; to tip (liquid): 倒水, 倒垃圾 (garbage sense is colloquial extension)

examples.hanzi: 请帮我倒一杯热水。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ dào yī bēi rè shuǐ.
examples.english: Please pour me a cup of hot water.

倒.meaning: contrary to expectation; actually; on the contrary (surprise/contrast marker): 你倒挺快!; 想不到他倒先走了

examples.hanzi: 我们让他先走, 他倒先看起手机来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen ràng tā xiān zǒu, tā dào xiān kàn qǐ shǒujī lái le.
examples.english: We told him to go first — instead he started looking at his phone.

道.meaning: measure word for problems, questions, dishes, rays, lines: 一道题, 一道菜, 一道光

examples.hanzi: 今晚还有两道题没做完。
examples.pinyin: Jīn wǎn hái yǒu liǎng dào tí méi zuò wán.
examples.english: There are still two problems left unfinished tonight.

道.meaning: road; path; line (bound: 道路, 楼道, 河道): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这条河道又深又宽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hédào yòu shēn yòu kuān.
examples.english: This river channel is deep and wide.

道.meaning: way; principle; doctrine (道理, 道德): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他是个讲道理的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge jiǎng dàolǐ de rén.
examples.english: He is a reasonable person.

刀.meaning: knife; blade (measure word 把): 一把刀, 菜刀, 水果刀

examples.hanzi: 这把刀不快了, 该磨一磨。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo bù kuài le, gāi mó yī mó.
examples.english: This knife is dull; it needs sharpening.

到底.meaning: (in questions) exactly; on earth; after all: 你到底去不去?; 到底怎么回事

examples.hanzi: 你到底想吃什么? 快决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Kuài juédìng ba.
examples.english: What on earth do you want to eat? Decide already.

到底.meaning: in the end; finally (after everything): 到底还是赢了 — stress on final outcome

examples.hanzi: 经过多次失败, 他到底还是成功了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì shībài, tā dàodǐ háishì chénggōng le.
examples.english: After many failures, he succeeded in the end.

到来.meaning: (of a time, season, event) to arrive; advent: 春天的到来, 新年到来之际

examples.hanzi: 随着冬天的到来, 天气越来越冷。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe dōngtiān de dàolái, tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng.
examples.english: With the arrival of winter, the weather is getting colder.

near_synonyms.difference: 路 is the everyday word for a road or street (一条路); 道路 is more formal and is also used figuratively for a path of development (发展道路)

道路.meaning: road; path (literal); way, path (figurative): 修道路, 发展道路

examples.hanzi: 门前的新道路修好了。
examples.pinyin: Mén qián de xīn dàolù xiū hǎo le.
examples.english: The new road in front of the house has been finished.

道歉.meaning: to apologize (离合词: 道了个歉): 向他道歉, 公开道歉

examples.hanzi: 他为迟到向大家道歉。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi chídào xiàng dàjiā dàoqiàn.
examples.english: He apologized to everyone for being late.

导游.meaning: tour guide: 跟着导游走, 一位导游

examples.hanzi: 导游带我们参观了老城区。
examples.pinyin: Dǎoyóu dài wǒmen cānguān le lǎo chéngqū.
examples.english: The guide took us around the old town.

导游.meaning: to act as a tour guide: 他在旅行社导游

examples.hanzi: 她在旅行社做导游。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lǚxíngshè zuò dǎoyóu.
examples.english: She works as a tour guide at a travel agency.

打扰.meaning: to disturb; to bother; to interrupt: 打扰一下, 抱歉打扰了 — polite formula

examples.hanzi: 打扰一下, 请问办公室怎么走?
examples.pinyin: Dǎrǎo yīxià, qǐngwèn bàngōngshì zěnme zǒu?
examples.english: Sorry to bother you — how do I get to the office?

大赛.meaning: major competition; grand contest: 歌唱大赛, 举办大赛

examples.hanzi: 他参加了全国的唱歌大赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le quánguó de chàng gē dàsài.
examples.english: He took part in the national singing contest.

大厅.meaning: hall; lobby; foyer: 酒店大厅, 候机大厅

examples.hanzi: 请在大厅等候, 我们马上安排。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài dàtīng děnghòu, wǒmen mǎshàng ānpái.
examples.english: Please wait in the lobby; we'll arrange things right away.

打印.meaning: to print (documents): 打印文件, 打印机

examples.hanzi: 帮我把这份文件打印两份。
examples.pinyin: Bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn dǎyìn liǎng fèn.
examples.english: Print two copies of this document for me.

near_synonyms.difference: 答应 is agreeing to a request from someone (答应帮我); 同意 is expressing approval of an opinion or plan (同意这个方案)

examples.hanzi: 他答应了, 就一定会做到。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying le, jiù yīdìng huì zuò dào.
examples.english: If he has agreed, he will certainly do it.

答应.meaning: to agree to; to promise (a request): 他答应了帮我, 答应了两件事

examples.hanzi: 妈妈答应给我买一辆新自行车。
examples.pinyin: Māma dāying gěi wǒ mǎi yī liàng xīn zìxíngchē.
examples.english: Mom agreed to buy me a new bicycle.

examples.hanzi: 办公室的打印机坏了。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōngshì de dǎyìnjī huài le.
examples.english: The office printer is broken.

大约.meaning: approximately; about; roughly: 大约二十人, 大约需要三天

examples.hanzi: 从家到学校大约要二十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jiā dào xuéxiào dàyuē yào èrshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: It takes about twenty minutes from home to school.

打折.meaning: to give a discount (离合词: 打了八折 sell at 80%): 这家店打折, 打折促销

examples.hanzi: 这条裙子打折, 只要一百块。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi dǎ zhé, zhǐyào yībǎi kuài.
examples.english: This skirt is on sale — only 100 yuan.

打针.meaning: to give/receive an injection; to get a shot (离合词: 打了一针): 去医院打针

examples.hanzi: 孩子生病了, 妈妈带他去打针。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shēngbìng le, māma dài tā qù dǎzhēn.
examples.english: The child got sick and Mom took him for an injection.

大自然.meaning: nature; the natural world: 大自然的美, 回归大自然

examples.hanzi: 周末我们全家去山里亲近大自然。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen quán jiā qù shān li qīnjìn dàzìrán.
examples.english: This weekend our whole family went to the mountains to be close to nature.

等2.meaning: class; rank; grade (等待 sense belongs to 等1; this is 等级): 同等, 平等, 优等 — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这两件事性质不同, 不能同等对待。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì xìngzhì bùtóng, bù néng tóngděng duìdài.
examples.english: These two matters differ in nature and can't be treated as equal.

等2.meaning: kind; sort: 此等事情 this kind of thing — formal/literary

examples.hanzi: 此等小事, 不必麻烦领导。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ děng xiǎo shì, búbì máfan lǐngdǎo.
examples.english: Such a small matter — no need to trouble the boss.

等到.meaning: by the time; when (a future point is reached): 等到他来, 我们再开始; 等到明年

examples.hanzi: 等到孩子睡着, 她才开始工作。
examples.pinyin: Děngdào háizi shuìzháo, tā cái kāishǐ gōngzuò.
examples.english: Only after the child fell asleep did she start working.

登机.meaning: to board a plane (登机牌 boarding pass): 开始登机了, 登机口

examples.hanzi: 飞往上海的航班开始登机了。
examples.pinyin: Fēiwǎng Shànghǎi de hángbān kāishǐ dēngjī le.
examples.english: Boarding has begun for the flight to Shanghai.

得意.connotation: positive-to-smug, can be mildly negative when excessive
得意.meaning: pleased with oneself; triumphant; smug: 得意地说, 得意的样子

examples.hanzi: 他得意地给大家看自己的奖杯。
examples.pinyin: Tā déyì de gěi dàjiā kàn zìjǐ de jiǎngbēi.
examples.english: He smugly showed everyone his trophy.

底.meaning: bottom; base; foot (of something): 井底, 湖底, 底下

examples.hanzi: 河底有很多漂亮的石头。
examples.pinyin: Hé dǐ yǒu hěn duō piàoliang de shítou.
examples.english: There are many beautiful stones at the bottom of the river.

底.meaning: grounding; background; basis (功底, 家底): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这个演员的功底很深。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǎnyuán de gōngdǐ hěn shēn.
examples.english: This actor has a very solid foundation.

底.meaning: (as in 到底, 月底, 年底) end; last part: 月底 end of the month — bound use

examples.hanzi: 月底我要还信用卡。
examples.pinyin: Yuèdǐ wǒ yào huán xìnyòngkǎ.
examples.english: I have to pay off my credit card at the end of the month.

低.meaning: low (height, level, degree); opposite of 高: 价格很低, 水平低, 低着头

examples.hanzi: 这家的价格比别家低得多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā de jiàgé bǐ bié jiā dī de duō.
examples.english: This shop's prices are much lower than others'.

低.meaning: to lower; to bend down: 低着头, 低头认错

examples.hanzi: 他低着头走进教室。
examples.pinyin: Tā dīzhe tóu zǒu jìn jiàoshì.
examples.english: He entered the classroom with his head down.

电动车.meaning: electric bike/scooter; electric vehicle: 骑电动车, 电动车充电

examples.hanzi: 爸爸每天骑电动车上班。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān qí diàndòngchē shàngbān.
examples.english: Dad rides his e-bike to work every day.

点名.meaning: to roll call; to call the roll (离合词: 点了名): 老师点名了

examples.hanzi: 老师每天上课都先点名。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī měitiān shàng kè dōu xiān diǎn míng.
examples.english: The teacher takes attendance first every class.

点名.meaning: to name (someone) specifically; to appoint (点名批评 name and criticize, 点名要我去做)

examples.hanzi: 校长在会上点名表扬了三位老师。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài huì shang diǎn míng biǎoyáng le sān wèi lǎoshī.
examples.english: The principal named and praised three teachers at the meeting.

电视剧.meaning: TV series; TV drama: 一部电视剧, 看电视剧

examples.hanzi: 她最近迷上了这部电视剧。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn mí shàng le zhè bù diànshìjù.
examples.english: She's recently become hooked on this TV series.

点头.meaning: to nod (离合词: 点了点头): 他点了点头, 点头同意

examples.hanzi: 他听懂了, 轻轻地点了点头。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīng dǒng le, qīngqīng de diǎn le diǎn tóu.
examples.english: He understood and gave a slight nod.

掉.meaning: to fall; to drop; to fall off: 手机掉地上了, 头发掉了很多

examples.hanzi: 手机从桌子上掉下来, 屏幕碎了。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī cóng zhuōzi shang diào xiàlai, píngmù suì le.
examples.english: The phone fell off the table and the screen shattered.

掉.meaning: to lose; to be missing: 钱包掉了, 别把钥匙掉 了

examples.hanzi: 我的钥匙掉了, 进不了家门。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi diào le, jìn bù liǎo jiāmén.
examples.english: I lost my keys and can't get into the house.

掉.meaning: (result complement after verbs) away; off; indicating removal: 忘掉了, 扔掉, 卖掉, 擦掉

examples.hanzi: 旧沙发太占地方, 我们把它扔掉了。
examples.pinyin: Jiù shāfā tài zhàn dìfang, wǒmen bǎ tā rēng diào le.
examples.english: The old sofa took up too much room, so we threw it away.

掉.meaning: to fall behind (掉队); to swap/exchange (掉换) — mainly compounds

examples.hanzi: 他跑得太慢, 掉队了。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de tài màn, diào duì le.
examples.english: He ran too slowly and fell behind the group.

调查.meaning: to investigate; to look into: 调查原因, 进行调查

examples.hanzi: 警方正在调查事故的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài diàochá shìgù de yuányīn.
examples.english: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

调查.meaning: investigation; survey: 一项调查, 调查报告, 问卷调查

examples.hanzi: 根据这项调查, 大多数人支持新规定。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhè xiàng diàochá, dàduōshù rén zhīchí xīn guīdìng.
examples.english: According to this survey, most people support the new regulation.

低价.meaning: low price; at a low price: 低价买入, 低价销售

examples.hanzi: 这家店以低价吸引了很多顾客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yǐ dījià xīyǐn le hěn duō gùkè.
examples.english: This shop has attracted many customers with low prices.

订.meaning: to book; to reserve; to order; to subscribe: 订机票, 订房间, 订报纸

examples.hanzi: 我们订了明天早上的机票。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dìng le míngtiān zǎoshang de jīpiào.
examples.english: We booked tomorrow morning's flight tickets.

定.meaning: to decide; to fix; to set: 定计划, 定时间, 定下来

examples.hanzi: 开会的时间定在周五下午三点。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíjiān dìng zài zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ sān diǎn.
examples.english: The meeting time has been set for Friday at 3 p.m.

定.meaning: to book; to reserve (= 订): 定了机票

examples.hanzi: 我定了一间海景房。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìng le yī jiān hǎijǐng fáng.
examples.english: I reserved a room with an ocean view.

定.meaning: calm; stable (定性, 定量): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他的性格很定, 不容易紧张。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xìnggé hěn dìng, bù róngyì jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: He has a steady temperament and doesn't get nervous easily.

地球.meaning: the Earth: 地球上, 保护地球

examples.hanzi: 我们要保护地球的环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù dìqiú de huánjìng.
examples.english: We should protect the Earth's environment.

低温.meaning: low temperature: 低温天气, 低温保存

examples.hanzi: 这几天有低温, 出门多穿点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān yǒu dīwēn, chūmén duō chuān diǎn.
examples.english: It's been cold these days — dress warmly when going out.

底下.meaning: underneath; below (colloquial): 桌子底下, 话说到底下 — also 'under' figuratively

examples.hanzi: 猫躲在沙发底下。
examples.pinyin: Māo duǒ zài shāfā dǐxia.
examples.english: The cat is hiding under the sofa.

低于.meaning: to be lower than; below (a level or number): 低于零度, 价格低于成本

examples.hanzi: 今天的气温低于零度。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de qìwēn dīyú líng dù.
examples.english: Today's temperature is below zero.

地址.meaning: address: 写地址, 电子邮件地址

examples.hanzi: 请把新地址发给我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xīn dìzhǐ fā gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Please send me the new address.

东部.meaning: the eastern part (of a country or region): 中国东部, 东部地区

examples.hanzi: 德国东部和西部发展差别很大。
examples.pinyin: Déguó dōngbù hé xībù fāzhǎn chābié hěn dà.
examples.english: There's a big development gap between eastern and western Germany.

动车.meaning: D-train; high-speed EMU train (bullet train) — Mainland rail terminology: 坐动车去北京

examples.hanzi: 动车比普通火车快, 比高铁慢。
examples.pinyin: Dòngchē bǐ pǔtōng huǒchē kuài, bǐ gāotiě màn.
examples.english: D-trains are faster than regular trains but slower than high-speed rail.

动作.meaning: movement; motion; action: 动作很快, 电影动作片, 做动作

examples.hanzi: 他的动作很慢, 请等他一下。
examples.pinyin: Tā de dòngzuò hěn màn, qǐng děng tā yīxià.
examples.english: His movements are slow — please give him a moment.

短信.meaning: text message; SMS: 发短信, 收到短信

examples.hanzi: 我给你发了短信, 你看到了吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ fā le duǎnxìn, nǐ kàn dào le ma?
examples.english: I sent you a text — did you see it?

堵车.meaning: (of traffic) to be jammed; traffic jam: 路上堵车了, 堵车严重

examples.hanzi: 早上七点半是堵车的高峰。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn shì dǔchē de gāofēng.
examples.english: 7:30 a.m. is the height of the traffic jam.

队.meaning: line; queue (also written 排队): 站队, 排队 — colloquial short form of 队伍 in this sense

examples.hanzi: 买票的队排得很长。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi piào de duì pái de hěn cháng.
examples.english: The ticket line is very long.

队.meaning: team; band: 球队, 国家队, 乐队的队

examples.hanzi: 他是国家队的主力队员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì guójiā duì de zhǔlì duìyuán.
examples.english: He is a key player on the national team.

对方.meaning: the other side; the other party (in an exchange, negotiation, game): 对方同意了, 对方的意见

examples.hanzi: 对方还没接电话, 可能不在。
examples.pinyin: Duìfāng hái méi jiē diànhuà, kěnéng bù zài.
examples.english: The other party hasn't answered the phone — maybe they're not in.

对面.meaning: the opposite side; across from; facing: 在对面, 学校对面有家书店, 对面的那个人

examples.hanzi: 银行就在学校对面, 很好找。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng jiù zài xuéxiào duìmiàn, hěn hǎo zhǎo.
examples.english: The bank is right across from the school — easy to find.

near_synonyms.difference: 对 introduces the target of an action or attitude and is more flexible (对他说); 对于 marks a topic of discussion or judgment, is more formal, and usually begins the sentence (对于这个问题)

对于.meaning: with regard to; concerning; as to (introduces the object of an attitude/judgment, broader than 对): 对于这个问题, 我有不同的看法

examples.hanzi: 对于这个问题, 我有不同的看法。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí, wǒ yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.
examples.english: On this question I have a different view.

队员.meaning: team member (bound-form 员 with 队): 球队队员, 每个队员

examples.hanzi: 每个队员都必须遵守纪律。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge duìyuán dōu bìxū zūnshǒu jìlǜ.
examples.english: Every team member must follow the rules.

队长.meaning: team captain; team leader: 当队长, 队长带领大家

examples.hanzi: 队长带领队员们每天早上训练。
examples.pinyin: Duìzhǎng dàilǐng duìyuánmen měitiān zǎoshang xùnliàn.
examples.english: The captain leads the team in training every morning.

度假.meaning: to spend a holiday; to take a vacation: 去海边度假, 度假村

examples.hanzi: 他们全家去海边度假一周。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen quán jiā qù hǎibiān dùjià yī zhōu.
examples.english: Their whole family went to the seaside for a week's holiday.

顿.meaning: measure word for meals, scoldings, beatings: 一顿饭, 说了一顿, 打了一顿

examples.hanzi: 我们中午吃了一顿丰盛的饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngwǔ chī le yī dùn fēngshèng de fàn.
examples.english: We had a lavish meal at noon.

顿.meaning: to pause (顿了顿); to arrange; to stamp (foot): 顿了顿脚 — literary

examples.hanzi: 他停下来, 顿了顿, 又接着说。
examples.pinyin: Tā tíng xiàlai, dùn le dùn, yòu jiēzhe shuō.
examples.english: He paused a moment, then went on speaking.

多么.meaning: how; what a…! (exclamatory intensifier): 多么美啊!; 多么不容易

examples.hanzi: 这里的风景多么美啊!
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng duōme měi a!
examples.english: How beautiful the scenery here is!

多数.meaning: most; the majority: 大多数人, 多数同意, 占多数

examples.hanzi: 班里的多数同学都同意这个计划。
examples.pinyin: Bān li de duōshù tóngxué dōu tóngyì zhège jìhuà.
examples.english: Most students in the class agree with this plan.

多样.meaning: varied; diverse; manifold: 多样化, 种类多样, 形式多样

examples.hanzi: 食堂的菜品种多样, 很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Shítáng de cài pǐnzhǒng duōyàng, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The cafeteria offers varied dishes and is very popular.

读者.meaning: reader (of a book, newspaper): 读者来信, 广大读者

examples.hanzi: 这位作家的读者遍布全国。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de dúzhě biànbù quánguó.
examples.english: This writer's readers are all over the country.

肚子.meaning: belly; abdomen; stomach: 肚子疼, 肚子饿了

examples.hanzi: 他中午没吃饭, 现在肚子很饿。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngwǔ méi chī fàn, xiànzài dùzi hěn è.
examples.english: He didn't eat lunch and his stomach is very hungry now.

肚子.meaning: tripe (food, as in 猪肚子) — kitchen register

examples.hanzi: 这家店的猪肚子做得很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de zhū dǔzi zuò de hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This shop's pork tripe is delicious.

而.meaning: and; but (joins coordinate verbs/adjectives in writing): 美而实用; 从南而北

examples.hanzi: 这个房间小而实用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān xiǎo ér shíyòng.
examples.english: This room is small but practical.

而.meaning: (in 而已, 而且, 从而 etc.) — bound conjunction in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他不但没道歉, 反而更生气了。
examples.pinyin: Tā búdàn méi dàoqiàn, fǎn'ér gèng shēngqì le.
examples.english: He didn't apologize; on the contrary, he got angrier.

儿童.meaning: child; children (formal term, vs colloquial 孩子): 儿童节, 儿童医院

examples.hanzi: 儿童节那天, 公园里到处是孩子。
examples.pinyin: értóngjié nà tiān, gōngyuán li dàochù shì háizi.
examples.english: On Children's Day the park was full of children.

法.meaning: law (bound in 法律, 法规; also France 法国): 执法, 立法

examples.hanzi: 每个人都要遵守法律。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yào zūnshǒu fǎlǜ.
examples.english: Everyone must obey the law.

法.meaning: method; way (bound in 方法, 办法, 想法): 没法做 — colloquial contraction of 没办法

examples.hanzi: 实在想不出办法, 只好请别人帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Shízài xiǎng bu chū bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén bāngmáng.
examples.english: I really can't think of a way, so I have to ask others for help.

发出.meaning: to send out; to issue (a sound, light, document, invitation): 发出声音, 发出通知

examples.hanzi: 手机发出了低电量提醒。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī fā chū le dī diànliàng tíxǐng.
examples.english: The phone issued a low-battery alert.

法律.meaning: law (body of laws); statute: 遵守法律, 法律面前人人平等

examples.hanzi: 不懂法律, 就容易吃亏。
examples.pinyin: Bù dǒng fǎlǜ, jiù róngyì chīkuī.
examples.english: Not knowing the law makes it easy to be taken advantage of.

烦.meaning: annoyed; irritated; vexed: 心里很烦, 别烦我

examples.hanzi: 外面太吵了, 我心里很烦。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài chǎo le, wǒ xīnli hěn fán.
examples.english: It's too noisy outside; I feel really irritated.

烦.meaning: complicated; superfluous (烦琐 =繁琐): 程序太烦了 — formal-leaning

examples.hanzi: 办手续的流程太烦了。
examples.pinyin: Bàn shǒuxù de liúchéng tài fán le.
examples.english: The processing procedures are too convoluted.

反对.meaning: to oppose; to be against: 反对这个计划, 我反对

examples.hanzi: 父母反对他一个人出国。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā yī ge rén chūguó.
examples.english: His parents oppose him going abroad alone.

examples.hanzi: 这个建议遭到了很多人的反对。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiànyì zāodào le hěn duō rén de fǎnduì.
examples.english: This proposal met with opposition from many people.

房东.meaning: landlord; landlady (owner of rented property): 房东很好, 问房东

examples.hanzi: 房东说这个月房租要涨两百块。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng shuō zhège yuè fángzū yào zhǎng liǎngbǎi kuài.
examples.english: The landlord says the rent is going up 200 yuan this month.

方面.meaning: aspect; respect; side: 在这方面, 各个方面, 一方面…一方面…

examples.hanzi: 他在数学方面很有天分。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shùxué fāngmiàn hěn yǒu tiānfèn.
examples.english: He is very gifted in mathematics.

near_synonyms.difference: 放弃 is giving up a plan, right or chance (放弃机会); 抛弃 is abandoning a person or thing you should care for (抛弃家庭) — much stronger and negative

放弃.meaning: to give up; to abandon (a plan, right, chance): 放弃机会, 放弃比赛

examples.hanzi: 他受伤了, 只好放弃这次比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòushāng le, zhǐhǎo fàngqì zhège bǐsài.
examples.english: He got injured and had to give up this competition.

near_synonyms.difference: 方式 is the manner or mode of doing something (生活方式, 支付方式); 方法 is a concrete method or technique for achieving something (学习方法)

方式.meaning: way; manner; mode: 教学方式, 生活方式, 这种方式

examples.hanzi: 每个人的学习方式都不一样。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de xuéxí fāngshì dōu bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Everyone studies in a different way.

放松.meaning: to relax; to loosen up: 放松一下, 放松心情

examples.hanzi: 周末我喜欢听音乐放松一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè fàngsōng yīxià.
examples.english: On weekends I like to relax by listening to music.

放松.meaning: to loosen (control, restrictions): 放松要求, 不能放松警惕

examples.hanzi: 考试结束了, 也不要放松学习。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù le, yě bùyào fàngsōng xuéxí.
examples.english: The exam is over, but don't slack off on studying.

房租.meaning: rent (money paid for housing): 付房租, 房租很贵

examples.hanzi: 市中心的房租越来越贵。
examples.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn de fángzū yuè lái yuè guì.
examples.english: Rent downtown is getting more and more expensive.

烦恼.meaning: worries; vexation: 增添烦恼, 我的烦恼

examples.hanzi: 孩子的成绩是家长最大的烦恼。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de chéngjì shì jiāzhǎng zuì dà de fánnǎo.
examples.english: The kids' grades are parents' biggest worry.

烦恼.meaning: vexed; worried: 为这件事烦恼

examples.hanzi: 他为找工作的事烦恼了很久。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhǎo gōngzuò de shì fánnǎo le hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: He was vexed about finding a job for a long time.

翻译.meaning: to translate; to interpret: 翻译成英文, 帮我翻译一下

examples.hanzi: 请帮我把这句话翻译成英语。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè jù huà fānyì chéng Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into English for me.

翻译.meaning: translator; interpreter: 一位翻译, 当翻译

examples.hanzi: 会议请了一位中文翻译。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì qǐng le yī wèi Zhōngwén fānyì.
examples.english: The conference hired a Chinese interpreter.

发送.meaning: to send; to transmit (a message, signal): 发送邮件, 发送信息

examples.hanzi: 文件太大, 发送失败了。
examples.pinyin: Wénjiàn tài dà, fāsòng shībài le.
examples.english: The file was too big and the send failed.

费.meaning: fee; cost; expenses (bound in 学费, 费用, 水费): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这学期我的学费是六千块。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī wǒ de xuéfèi shì liù qiān kuài.
examples.english: My tuition this term is 6,000 yuan.

费.meaning: to cost; to expend (费心, 费力, 浪费): 费了很大劲儿

examples.hanzi: 为了找他, 我费了不少劲儿。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhǎo tā, wǒ fèi le bùshǎo jìnr.
examples.english: I went to a lot of trouble to find him.

费用.meaning: cost; expense; fee: 费用很高, 支付费用, 生活费用

examples.hanzi: 旅行费用一共三千块钱。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng fèiyòng yīgòng sān qiān kuài qián.
examples.english: The trip cost 3,000 yuan in total.

份.meaning: measure word for portions (of food), copies (of documents), gifts: 一份报纸, 一份礼物, 一份炒饭

examples.hanzi: 中午我只吃了一份炒饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ wǒ zhǐ chī le yī fèn chǎofàn.
examples.english: At noon I only ate one portion of fried rice.

份.meaning: share; portion (股份, 份内) — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他在公司里有一定的股份。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī li yǒu yīdìng de gǔfèn.
examples.english: He holds a certain share of stock in the company.

丰富.meaning: rich; abundant; plentiful: 经验丰富, 内容丰富, 资源丰富

examples.hanzi: 这位老师的教学经验很丰富。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de jiàoxué jīngyàn hěn fēngfù.
examples.english: This teacher has rich teaching experience.

丰富.meaning: to enrich (使…丰富): 丰富业余生活

examples.hanzi: 多读书可以丰富我们的知识。
examples.pinyin: Duō dú shū kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de zhīshi.
examples.english: Reading more can enrich our knowledge.
