near_synonyms.difference: 风景 is scenery as a general setting (风景名胜); 景色 is the view you see at a given moment (湖上的景色), slightly more literary

风景.meaning: scenery; landscape: 风景很美, 风景名胜, 拍风景

examples.hanzi: 火车沿着河边开, 风景美极了。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē yánzhe hé biān kāi, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: The train runs along the river — the scenery is gorgeous.

分数.meaning: score; mark (on a test): 考试分数, 分数不高

examples.hanzi: 他的考试分数是全班最高的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de kǎoshì fēnshù shì quán bān zuì gāo de.
examples.english: His exam score was the highest in the class.

examples.hanzi: 三分之一和四分之一都是分数。
examples.pinyin: Sān fēn zhī yī hé sì fēn zhī yī dōu shì fēnshù.
examples.english: One third and one quarter are both fractions.

分为.meaning: to be divided into; to divide into: 分为三部分, 分为两类

examples.hanzi: 这篇课文分为三个部分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén fēnwéi sān ge bùfen.
examples.english: This text is divided into three parts.

否则.meaning: otherwise; if not: 快点儿, 否则赶不上车了

examples.hanzi: 你得快点出发, 否则赶不上火车了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi kuài diǎn chūfā, fǒuzé gǎn bu shàng huǒchē le.
examples.english: You'd better set off quickly, otherwise you'll miss the train.

幅.meaning: measure word for paintings, pictures, scrolls: 一幅画, 一幅地图

examples.hanzi: 墙上挂着两幅中国画。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shang guàzhe liǎng fú Zhōngguó huà.
examples.english: Two Chinese paintings hang on the wall.

near_synonyms.difference: 付 is the everyday word (付钱); 支付 is formal/written and fixed in compounds like 支付宝, 网上支付

付.meaning: to pay; to hand over (money): 付钱, 付房租, 用手机付款

examples.hanzi: 我在超市付了两百块钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chāoshì fù le liǎngbǎi kuài qián.
examples.english: I paid 200 yuan at the supermarket.

符合.meaning: to accord with; to conform to; to meet (a standard, requirement): 符合标准, 符合条件

examples.hanzi: 你的条件完全符合我们的要求。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de tiáojiàn wánquán fúhé wǒmen de yāoqiú.
examples.english: Your qualifications fully meet our requirements.

父母.meaning: parents (father and mother; formal vs 爸爸妈妈): 父母亲, 孝敬父母

examples.hanzi: 父母总是为孩子着想。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì wèi háizi zhuóxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents always think of their children first.

父女.meaning: father and daughter: 父女俩, 父女关系

examples.hanzi: 公园里散步的父女俩有说有笑。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán li sànbù de fùnǚ liǎ yǒu shuō yǒu xiào.
examples.english: The father and daughter walking in the park chat and laugh.

父亲.meaning: father (formal, vs colloquial 爸爸): 我的父亲

examples.hanzi: 父亲从小就教我要诚实。
examples.pinyin: Fùqīn cóng xiǎo jiù jiào wǒ yào chéngshí.
examples.english: Father taught me to be honest from an early age.

复印.meaning: to photocopy; to make a copy: 复印一份, 复印身份证

examples.hanzi: 请帮我把这份表格复印三份。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn biǎogé fùyìn sān fèn.
examples.english: Please photocopy this form three times for me.

复杂.meaning: complicated; complex: 问题很复杂, 复杂的关系

examples.hanzi: 这道题的步骤很复杂, 别做错了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de bùzhòu hěn fùzá, bié zuò cuò le.
examples.english: This problem's steps are complicated — don't slip up.

负责.meaning: to be responsible for; to be in charge of: 负责销售, 他负责这个项目

examples.hanzi: 他负责公司的销售工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā fùzé gōngsī de xiāoshòu gōngzuò.
examples.english: He is in charge of the company's sales.

负责.meaning: responsible; conscientious: 他工作很负责, 一个负责任的人

examples.hanzi: 她是个很负责的老师, 学生都喜欢她。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge hěn fùzé de lǎoshī, xuéshēng dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.english: She is a very responsible teacher; all the students like her.

负责人.meaning: person in charge; the responsible party: 项目负责人, 找负责人

examples.hanzi: 有问题请直接找项目负责人。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí qǐng zhíjiē zhǎo xiàngmù fùzérén.
examples.english: If there are problems, go directly to the project manager.

父子.meaning: father and son: 父子俩, 父子关系

examples.hanzi: 父子俩长得一模一样。
examples.pinyin: Fùzǐ liǎ zhǎng de yīmú yīyàng.
examples.english: The father and son look exactly alike.

改.meaning: to change; to alter: 改计划, 改时间

examples.hanzi: 情况变了, 计划也要改一改。
examples.pinyin: Qíngkuàng biàn le, jìhuà yě yào gǎi yī gǎi.
examples.english: Things have changed, so the plan needs adjusting too.

改.meaning: to correct; to revise (text, homework): 改错, 老师改作业

examples.hanzi: 老师帮我改了作文里的错误。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bāng wǒ gǎi le zuòwén li de cuòwù.
examples.english: The teacher corrected the mistakes in my essay.

改.meaning: to convert; to remodel (改装修, 改建): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这条街的老房子都改成了咖啡馆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē de lǎo fángzi dōu gǎi chéng le kāfēiguǎn.
examples.english: The old houses on this street have all been converted into cafés.

near_synonyms.difference: 改变 is a transitive change someone causes (改变主意); 变化 is an intransitive change that happens (情况发生了变化)

改变.meaning: to change; to alter (something): 改变主意, 改变生活

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行彻底改变了他对生活的看法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng chèdǐ gǎibiàn le tā duì shēnghuó de kànfǎ.
examples.english: This trip completely changed his view of life.

改变.meaning: change (in conditions): 发生了很大的改变

examples.hanzi: 十年过去, 家乡发生了很大的改变。
examples.pinyin: Shí nián guòqù, jiāxiāng fāshēng le hěn dà de gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Ten years on, my hometown has changed a lot.

赶.meaning: to hurry; to rush; to make it in time: 赶时间, 赶不上车, 赶快

examples.hanzi: 来不及了, 我们赶紧行动吧。
examples.pinyin: Láibuji le, wǒmen gǎnjǐn xíngdòng ba.
examples.english: There's no time — let's act fast.

赶.meaning: to drive out; to chase away (赶走): 把苍蝇赶走

examples.hanzi: 他把房间里的蚊子赶出去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ fángjiān li de wénzi gǎn chūqu le.
examples.english: He chased the mosquitoes out of the room.

赶.meaning: to catch (a bus, train) by hurrying: 赶三点的大巴

examples.hanzi: 我们得赶三点的大巴去机场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen děi gǎn sān diǎn de dàbā qù jīchǎng.
examples.english: We have to catch the 3 p.m. coach to the airport.

near_synonyms.difference: 敢 is the everyday modal (不敢说); 敢于 is a formal compound used before two-syllable verbs of bold action (敢于创新, 敢于承认)

敢.meaning: to dare to: 你敢不敢?; 不敢说, 敢于尝试 (敢于 is formal)

examples.hanzi: 你敢不敢一个人走夜路?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gǎn bu gǎn yī ge rén zǒu yèlù?
examples.english: Do you dare walk alone at night?

感.meaning: feeling; sense (bound in 感觉, 情感, 幽默感, 责任感): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他对音乐有一种特别的感觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè yǒu yī zhǒng tèbié de gǎnjué.
examples.english: He has a special feeling for music.

感.meaning: to feel; to be moved (感激, 感动, 感谢) — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 大家都很感激他的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn gǎnjī tā de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Everyone is grateful for his help.

干.meaning: to do; to work (colloquial): 干活儿, 干什么, 好好干

examples.hanzi: 别光说, 动手干吧!
examples.pinyin: Bié guāng shuō, dòngshǒu gàn ba!
examples.english: Stop just talking — get to work!

干.meaning: to serve as; to hold a job (干了一辈子老师)

examples.hanzi: 他在村里干了一辈子农活。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài cūn li gàn le yībèizi nónghuó.
examples.english: He did farm work in the village his whole life.

干.meaning: dry: 衣服干了, 干杯, 干旱

examples.hanzi: 衣服在太阳底下晒干了。
examples.pinyin: Yīfu zài tàiyáng dǐxia shài gān le.
examples.english: The clothes dried in the sun.

干.meaning: empty-handed; for nothing (干着急 anxious but helpless)

examples.hanzi: 钥匙锁在屋里, 他只能在外面干着急。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi suǒ zài wū li, tā zhǐ néng zài wàimiàn gān zháojí.
examples.english: With the keys locked inside, he could only worry helplessly outside.

干杯.meaning: cheers!; to drink a toast (empty the glass): 来, 干杯!

examples.hanzi: 来, 为我们的友谊干杯!
examples.pinyin: Lái, wèi wǒmen de yǒuyì gānbēi!
examples.english: Come, let's toast to our friendship!

感动.meaning: to be moved (emotionally); to touch: 被他感动了, 感动得流眼泪

examples.hanzi: 这个故事感动了在场的每一个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi gǎndòng le zài chǎng de měi yī ge rén.
examples.english: This story moved everyone present.

感动.meaning: moved; touching: 感人的故事 — see 感人

examples.hanzi: 看到孩子们的努力, 她很受感动。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào háizimen de nǔlì, tā hěn shòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Seeing the children's efforts, she was deeply moved.

钢琴.meaning: piano (measure word 架 or 台): 弹钢琴, 一架钢琴

examples.hanzi: 她从五岁开始学钢琴。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng wǔ suì kāishǐ xué gāngqín.
examples.english: She started learning piano at five.

干活儿.meaning: to work; to do a job (manual labor) (离合词: 干了很多活儿): 在地里干活儿

examples.hanzi: 爸爸在地里干活儿, 中午才回来。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài dì li gànhuór, zhōngwǔ cái huílai.
examples.english: Dad was working in the fields and came back only at noon.

near_synonyms.difference: 赶紧 and 赶快 are near-interchangeable; 赶紧 slightly stresses seizing the moment, 赶快 urging speed, and 连忙 reacting to something already done

赶紧.meaning: hurriedly; at once (colloquial): 赶紧走, 赶紧告诉他

examples.hanzi: 要下雨了, 赶紧把衣服收进来。
examples.pinyin: Yào xià yǔ le, gǎnjǐn bǎ yīfu shōu jìnlai.
examples.english: It's about to rain — quickly bring the laundry in.

感觉.meaning: feeling; sensation; perception: 很好的感觉, 感觉不太好 (noun use)

examples.hanzi: 第一次坐飞机的感觉很奇妙。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì zuò fēijī de gǎnjué hěn qímiào.
examples.english: The feeling of flying for the first time is wonderful.

感觉.meaning: to feel; to sense: 感觉累了, 我感觉他会来

examples.hanzi: 我感觉今天会下雨, 出门带把伞吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué jīntiān huì xià yǔ, chūmén dài bǎ sǎn ba.
examples.english: I feel it'll rain today — take an umbrella.

赶快.meaning: quickly; at once; without delay: 赶快起床, 赶快回家

examples.hanzi: 孩子发烧了, 赶快送医院!
examples.pinyin: Háizi fāshāo le, gǎnkuài sòng yīyuàn!
examples.english: The child has a fever — rush him to the hospital!

感情.meaning: emotion; feeling; affection: 感情很深, 对家乡的感情

examples.hanzi: 他们兄弟感情很深。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xiōngdì gǎnqíng hěn shēn.
examples.english: The brothers have a deep bond.

感情.meaning: love relationship (colloquial): 两个人有感情, 谈感情

examples.hanzi: 两个人在一起久了就有了感情。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén zài yīqǐ jiǔ le jiù yǒu le gǎnqíng.
examples.english: After being together long, the two developed feelings.

感人.meaning: moving; touching: 感人的故事, 十分感人

examples.hanzi: 这部电影的结尾特别感人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéwěi tèbié gǎnrén.
examples.english: The ending of this film is especially moving.

赶上.meaning: to catch (a bus, train, opportunity): 赶上末班车, 赶上好时候

examples.hanzi: 快点跑, 还能赶上末班车。
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎn pǎo, hái néng gǎnshàng mòbānchē.
examples.english: Run — you can still catch the last bus.

赶上.meaning: to catch up with; to keep pace with: 赶上同学们的水平

examples.hanzi: 他努力学习, 终于赶上了同学们。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, zhōngyú gǎnshàng le tóngxuémen.
examples.english: He studied hard and finally caught up with his classmates.

感受.meaning: to feel; to experience: 感受到温暖

examples.hanzi: 在新学校生活了一周, 他谈了谈自己的感受。
examples.pinyin: Zài xīn xuéxiào shēnghuó le yī zhōu, tā tán le tán zìjǐ de gǎnshòu.
examples.english: After a week at the new school, he talked about how it felt.

感受.meaning: feeling; impression: 谈谈感受, 我的亲身感受

examples.hanzi: 你能感受到大家对你的支持吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng gǎnshòu dào dàjiā duì nǐ de zhīchí ma?
examples.english: Can you feel everyone's support for you?

感谢.meaning: to thank; to be grateful (slightly more formal than 谢谢): 感谢大家的帮助

examples.hanzi: 感谢大家来参加今天的活动。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè dàjiā lái cānjiā jīntiān de huódòng.
examples.english: Thank you all for coming to today's event.

高价.meaning: high price: 高价买入, 高价出售

examples.hanzi: 他高价买下了那幅画。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāojià mǎi xià le nà fú huà.
examples.english: He bought that painting at a high price.

高考.meaning: gaokao; the National College Entrance Examination (Mainland): 参加高考, 高考成绩

examples.hanzi: 高考那几天, 全城的车都不按喇叭。
examples.pinyin: Gāokǎo nà jǐ tiān, quán chéng de chē dōu bù àn lǎba.
examples.english: During the gaokao days, no car in the city honked.

高速.meaning: high-speed: 高速列车, 高速发展

examples.hanzi: 中国经济高速发展了三十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó jīngjì gāosù fāzhǎn le sānshí nián.
examples.english: China's economy developed at high speed for thirty years.

高速.meaning: expressway (short for 高速公路): 上高速, 高速堵车

examples.hanzi: 节日免过路费, 高速上堵满了车。
examples.pinyin: Jiérì miǎn guòlùfèi, gāosù shang dǔ mǎn le chē.
examples.english: Holidays are toll-free, and the expressway is jammed with cars.

高温.meaning: high temperature: 高温天气, 高温作业

examples.hanzi: 连续一周高温, 大家都待在空调房里。
examples.pinyin: Liánxù yī zhōu gāowēn, dàjiā dōu dāi zài kōngtiáo fáng li.
examples.english: After a week of high temperatures, everyone stays in air-conditioned rooms.

高于.meaning: to be higher than; above (a level or number): 高于平均, 价格高于去年

examples.hanzi: 今年的产量高于去年。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de chǎnliàng gāoyú qùnián.
examples.english: This year's output is higher than last year's.

各.meaning: each; every (distributive, before measure words or directly before some nouns): 各国, 各位, 各种各样, 各自

examples.hanzi: 各国都有自己的文化和习惯。
examples.pinyin: Gè guó dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà hé xíguàn.
examples.english: Every country has its own culture and customs.

胳膊.meaning: arm: 胳膊上, 挥胳膊

examples.hanzi: 他的胳膊让门夹了一下, 疼得直叫。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gēbo ràng mén jiá le yīxià, téng de zhí jiào.
examples.english: His arm got caught in the door and he cried out in pain.

各地.meaning: various places; all over the country: 全国各地, 来自各地

examples.hanzi: 展销会上聚集了各地的商人。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎnxiāohuì shang jùjí le gèdì de shāngrén.
examples.english: Merchants from all over gathered at the trade fair.

各个.meaning: each and every; every: 各个方面, 各个部门

examples.hanzi: 这个问题在各个方面都要考虑到。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zài gè ge fāngmiàn dōu yào kǎolǜ dào.
examples.english: This issue must be considered in every respect.

near_synonyms.difference: 更 is the single-character adverb, everyday and flexible (更好); 更加 is slightly more formal/emphatic and mainly before two-syllable words (更加努力)

更加.meaning: even more; still more (modifies adjectives/verbs): 更加努力, 更加重要

examples.hanzi: 下雨以后, 山上的空气更加清新了。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐhòu, shān shang de kōngqì gèngjiā qīngxīn le.
examples.english: After the rain the mountain air is even fresher.

歌声.meaning: singing voice; sound of singing: 传来歌声, 歌声优美

examples.hanzi: 远处传来孩子们的歌声。
examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù chuán lái háizimen de gēshēng.
examples.english: The sound of children singing drifts from afar.

歌手.meaning: singer (professional/popular): 一位歌手, 著名歌手

examples.hanzi: 她最喜欢的歌手下个月来开演唱会。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuan de gēshǒu xià ge yuè lái kāi yǎnchànghuì.
examples.english: Her favorite singer is coming to give a concert next month.

各位.meaning: everyone; ladies and gentlemen (polite address to a group): 各位好, 各位来宾

examples.hanzi: 各位乘客, 欢迎乘坐本次列车。
examples.pinyin: Gè wèi chéngkè, huānyíng chéngzuò běn cì lièchē.
examples.english: Dear passengers, welcome aboard this train.

各种.meaning: all kinds of; various (各种各样): 各种原因, 各种各样的人

examples.hanzi: 商店里有各种各样的纪念品。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn li yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: The shop has all kinds of souvenirs.

共.meaning: in total; altogether: 共计, 一共 — 共 is formal/short form in lists: 全书共十章

examples.hanzi: 全书共二十章, 三十万字。
examples.pinyin: Quán shū gòng èrshí zhāng, sānshí wàn zì.
examples.english: The book has twenty chapters and 300,000 characters in total.

共.meaning: together; shared (共同, 总共, 公共) — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 同学们共住一个宿舍, 相处得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen gòng zhù yī ge sùshè, xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The classmates share one dorm and get along well.

工厂.meaning: factory; plant: 在工厂工作, 一家工厂

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂生产自行车零件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn zìxíngchē língjiàn.
examples.english: This factory produces bicycle parts.

功夫.meaning: time; spare time ( colloquial: 有功夫没? = 有空吗)

examples.hanzi: 有功夫再聊, 我现在得走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu gōngfu zài liáo, wǒ xiànzài děi zǒu le.
examples.english: Let's chat when there's time — I have to go now.

功夫.meaning: kung fu; Chinese martial arts: 中国功夫, 练功夫

examples.hanzi: 他在少林寺学过三年功夫。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Shàolín sì xué guo sān nián gōngfu.
examples.english: He studied kung fu at Shaolin Temple for three years.

功夫.meaning: skill; mastery acquired through effort (下功夫 work hard at): 功夫不负有心人

examples.hanzi: 只要肯下功夫, 汉语一定能学好。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào kěn xià gōngfu, Hànyǔ yīdìng néng xué hǎo.
examples.english: As long as you put in the effort, you can definitely master Chinese.

公共.meaning: public; common; communal: 公共汽车, 公共场所, 公共交通

examples.hanzi: 请不要在公共场所大声打电话。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ dàshēng dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: Please don't talk loudly on the phone in public places.

功课.meaning: homework; school assignment: 做功课, 功课很多

examples.hanzi: 他每天做完功课才出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zuò wán gōngkè cái chūqù wán.
examples.english: He only goes out to play after finishing his homework.

功课.meaning: one's studies (formal/literary: 做好功课 also figurative: be well prepared)

examples.hanzi: 去谈判以前, 他做足了功课。
examples.pinyin: Qù tánpàn yǐqián, tā zuò zú le gōngkè.
examples.english: Before the negotiation he did his homework thoroughly.

公里.meaning: kilometer (measure word): 十公里, 跑五公里

examples.hanzi: 从我家到公司有三公里远。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngsī yǒu sān gōnglǐ yuǎn.
examples.english: It's three kilometers from my home to the office.

公路.meaning: road; highway (ordinary, not expressway): 一条公路, 公路两旁

examples.hanzi: 新公路通车以后, 进城快多了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn gōnglù tōngchē yǐhòu, jìn chéng kuài duō le.
examples.english: Since the new highway opened, getting into the city is much faster.

工人.meaning: worker; laborer: 一位工人, 工人们

examples.hanzi: 建筑工人们冒着高温在施工。
examples.pinyin: Jiànzhù gōngrénmen màozhe gāowēn zài shīgōng.
examples.english: Construction workers toil on despite the heat.

共同.meaning: common; joint; shared: 共同的兴趣, 共同的目标

examples.hanzi: 保护环境是我们共同的责任。
examples.pinyin: Bǎohù huánjìng shì wǒmen gòngtóng de zérèn.
examples.english: Protecting the environment is our shared responsibility.

共同.meaning: together; jointly: 共同努力, 共同发展

examples.hanzi: 两国科学家共同开展了这项研究。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó kēxuéjiā gòngtóng kāizhǎn le zhè xiàng yánjiū.
examples.english: Scientists of both countries jointly carried out this research.

工资.meaning: wages; salary (typically blue-collar or monthly pay): 发工资, 涨工资

examples.hanzi: 他的工资不高, 但是工作很稳定。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzī bù gāo, dànshì gōngzuò hěn wěndìng.
examples.english: His salary isn't high, but the job is stable.

够.meaning: enough; sufficient: 钱够了, 够吃吗

examples.hanzi: 锅里的饭够了, 大家随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Guō li de fàn gòu le, dàjiā suíbiàn chī.
examples.english: There's enough rice in the pot — everyone help themselves.

够.meaning: quite; really (intensifier, colloquial): 今天够冷的, 够朋友 (a true friend)

examples.hanzi: 今天可真够冷的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kě zhēn gòu lěng de.
examples.english: Today is really quite cold.

够.meaning: to reach (by hand or stretch): 够不着, 够得到

examples.hanzi: 书架太高了, 我够不着上面的书。
examples.pinyin: Shūjià tài gāo le, wǒ gòu bu zháo shàngmiàn de shū.
examples.english: The shelf is too high; I can't reach the books on top.

购买.meaning: to purchase (formal): 购买力, 购买商品

examples.hanzi: 越来越多的老人学会了网上购买。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō de lǎorén xuéhuì le wǎngshang gòumǎi.
examples.english: More and more elderly people have learned to shop online.

购物.meaning: to shop; shopping: 购物中心, 网上购物

examples.hanzi: 周末她和朋友一起去购物中心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā hé péngyou yīqǐ qù gòuwù zhōngxīn.
examples.english: On weekends she goes to the shopping mall with friends.

挂.meaning: to hang; to put up: 挂衣服, 挂在墙上, 挂了一幅画

examples.hanzi: 春节前, 家家户户都挂上了红灯笼。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, jiājiā hùhù dōu guà shang le hóng dēnglong.
examples.english: Before Spring Festival every household hangs red lanterns.

挂.meaning: to hang up (a phone call): 别挂电话, 挂了

examples.hanzi: 有什么事留言, 别急着挂电话。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme shì liúyán, bié jízhe guà diànhuà.
examples.english: Leave a message — don't hang up in a hurry.

挂.meaning: to register (at a hospital): 挂号, 挂个专家号

examples.hanzi: 看病要先挂号, 再等着叫号。
examples.pinyin: Kàn bìng yào xiān guàhào, zài děngzhe jiào hào.
examples.english: To see a doctor you first register, then wait for your number.

管.meaning: to be in charge of; to manage: 管事, 他管财务

examples.hanzi: 家里的事都是妈妈管。
examples.pinyin: Jiā li de shì dōu shì māma guǎn.
examples.english: Mom manages everything at home.

管.meaning: to mind; to concern oneself with: 别管我, 不管三七二十一

examples.hanzi: 你走你的, 别管我怎么想。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒu nǐ de, bié guǎn wǒ zěnme xiǎng.
examples.english: You go your way — don't mind what I think.

管.meaning: (dialect/colloquial) 'to' introducing the addressee: 管他叫老师 to call him teacher — 管…叫 pattern

examples.hanzi: 小时候大家都管他叫小胖。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou dàjiā dōu guǎn tā jiào Xiǎopàng.
examples.english: When he was little everyone called him Xiaopang.

逛.meaning: to stroll around; to browse (shops, streets): 逛街, 逛超市

examples.hanzi: 周末她喜欢和朋友逛街。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā xǐhuan hé péngyou guàng jiē.
examples.english: On weekends she likes to go window-shopping with friends.

光.meaning: light: 阳光, 灯光, 月光 — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 阳光透过窗户照进房间。
examples.pinyin: Yángguāng tòuguò chuānghù zhào jìn fángjiān.
examples.english: Sunlight shines into the room through the window.

光.meaning: only; alone (colloquial): 光说不做 all talk no action; 光他一个人就…

examples.hanzi: 他光说不做, 谁也不信他了。
examples.pinyin: Tā guāng shuō bù zuò, shéi yě bù xìn tā le.
examples.english: He's all talk and no action; nobody believes him anymore.

光.meaning: bare; used up: 用光了 all used up — result use

examples.hanzi: 一个月的工资很快就花光了。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge yuè de gōngzī hěn kuài jiù huā guāng le.
examples.english: A month's salary was soon all spent.

广播.meaning: broadcast; radio: 听广播, 广播电台, 收音机广播

examples.hanzi: 他每天早上边吃早饭边听广播。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang biān chī zǎofàn biān tīng guǎngbō.
examples.english: Every morning he listens to the radio while eating breakfast.

广播.meaning: to broadcast: 广播通知, 广播新闻

examples.hanzi: 车站广播了列车晚点的消息。
examples.pinyin: Chēzhàn guǎngbō le lièchē wǎndiǎn de xiāoxi.
examples.english: The station broadcast news of the train delay.

广告.meaning: advertisement; commercial: 电视广告, 做广告, 广告牌

examples.hanzi: 电视里的广告时间越来越长了。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì li de guǎnggào shíjiān yuè lái yuè cháng le.
examples.english: TV advertising time is getting longer and longer.

关键.meaning: key; crux; the crucial point: 问题的关键, 抓住关键

examples.hanzi: 问题的关键在于缺少资金。
examples.pinyin: Wèntí de guānjiàn zàiyú quēshǎo zījīn.
examples.english: The crux of the problem is a lack of funds.

关键.meaning: crucial; key: 关键时刻, 关键问题

examples.hanzi: 比赛进行到了关键时刻。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jìnxíng dào le guānjiàn shíkè.
examples.english: The match has reached the critical moment.

观看.meaning: to watch; to view (a performance, game, show — formal): 观看比赛, 观看演出

examples.hanzi: 成千上万的观众观看了这场比赛。
examples.pinyin: Chéng qiān shàng wàn de guānzhòng guānkàn le zhè chǎng bǐsài.
examples.english: Tens of thousands of spectators watched this match.

管理.meaning: to manage; to run; to administer: 管理公司, 管理得很好

examples.hanzi: 这家公司管理得很规范。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī guǎnlǐ de hěn guīfàn.
examples.english: This company is managed very professionally.

管理.meaning: management; administration: 科学管理, 管理专业

examples.hanzi: 他学的是酒店管理。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué de shì jiǔdiàn guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: He studied hotel management.

观众.meaning: audience; spectators: 观众们, 观众鼓掌

examples.hanzi: 演出结束时, 观众站起来鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchū jiéshù shí, guānzhòng zhàn qǐlai gǔzhǎng.
examples.english: When the show ended, the audience stood up and applauded.

规定.meaning: to stipulate; to prescribe; to set (a rule): 法律规定, 规定时间

examples.hanzi: 学校规定学生晚上十一点前必须回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng wǎnshang shíyī diǎn qián bìxū huí sùshè.
examples.english: The school stipulates that students must return to the dorm by 11 p.m.

规定.meaning: regulation; rule; stipulation: 按照规定, 违反规定

examples.hanzi: 按照规定，图书馆的书只能借一个月。
examples.pinyin: ànzhào guīdìng, túshūguǎn de shū zhǐ néng jiè yī ge yuè.
examples.english: By the rules, library books can only be borrowed for a month.

估计.meaning: to estimate; to reckon: 估计要下雨了, 我估计他不会来

examples.hanzi: 我估计他已经在路上了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūjì tā yǐjīng zài lù shang le.
examples.english: I reckon he's already on the way.

估计.meaning: estimate: 根据估计, 一个大概的估计

examples.hanzi: 据估计, 参加人数会超过五千。
examples.pinyin: Jù gūjì, cānjiā rénshù huì chāoguò wǔ qiān.
examples.english: By estimate, participation will exceed five thousand.

near_synonyms.difference: 顾客 is a walk-in customer of a shop (顾客至上); 客户 is a business client with an ongoing relationship (公司的客户)

顾客.meaning: customer; shopper (in a store): 顾客至上, 吸引顾客

examples.hanzi: 商店以优质的服务吸引了大量顾客。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn yǐ yōuzhì de fúwù xīyǐn le dàliàng gùkè.
examples.english: The store attracts many customers with excellent service.

鼓励.meaning: to encourage: 鼓励学生, 受到鼓励

examples.hanzi: 老师鼓励学生大胆提出问题。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuéshēng dàdǎn tí chū wèntí.
examples.english: The teacher encourages students to boldly raise questions.

examples.hanzi: 谢谢你对我的鼓励。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ duì wǒ de gǔlì.
examples.english: Thank you for your encouragement.

姑娘.meaning: girl; young lady (unmarried): 一位姑娘, 好姑娘

examples.hanzi: 那个姑娘一边走一边听音乐。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gūniang yībiān zǒu yībiān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: That girl walks along listening to music.

过程.meaning: process; course (of events): 学习过程, 在…的过程中

examples.hanzi: 学习是一个漫长的过程。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí shì yī ge màncháng de guòchéng.
examples.english: Learning is a long process.

国籍.meaning: nationality; citizenship: 中国国籍, 双重国籍

examples.hanzi: 他入了美国国籍, 但还说着流利的中文。
examples.pinyin: Tā rù le Měiguó guójí, dàn hái shuōzhe liúlì de Zhōngwén.
examples.english: He took American citizenship but still speaks fluent Chinese.

国际.meaning: international: 国际会议, 国际关系, 走向国际

examples.hanzi: 这是一次重要的国际会议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī cì zhòngyào de guójì huìyì.
examples.english: This is an important international conference.

果汁.meaning: fruit juice: 一杯果汁, 鲜榨果汁

examples.hanzi: 早饭他习惯喝一杯鲜榨果汁。
examples.pinyin: Zǎofàn tā xíguàn hē yī bēi xiān zhà guǒzhī.
examples.english: He habitually drinks a glass of fresh-squeezed juice at breakfast.

near_synonyms.difference: 故意 usually implies blame — doing something you shouldn't on purpose (故意捣乱); 有意 is neutral 'intentionally' and also means 'to be inclined to' (有意帮忙)

故意.meaning: deliberately; on purpose: 故意捣乱, 不是故意的

examples.hanzi: 他故意把闹钟关了, 想多睡一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā gùyì bǎ nào zhōng guān le, xiǎng duō shuì yīhuìr.
examples.english: He deliberately turned off the alarm, wanting to sleep a bit more.

害羞.meaning: shy; bashful: 很害羞, 害羞得脸都红了

examples.hanzi: 她很害羞, 见到生人就脸红。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn hàixiū, jiàn dào shēngrén jiù liǎn hóng.
examples.english: She is shy and blushes at the sight of strangers.

海洋.meaning: ocean; sea: 海洋生物, 保护海洋

examples.hanzi: 海洋覆盖了地球表面的百分之七十。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiyáng fùgài le dìqiú biǎomiàn de bǎi fēn zhī qīshí.
examples.english: Oceans cover seventy percent of the Earth's surface.

汗.meaning: sweat; perspiration: 出汗, 满头大汗, 汗水

examples.hanzi: 跑完五公里, 他满头是汗。
examples.pinyin: Pǎo wán wǔ gōnglǐ, tā mǎn tóu shì hàn.
examples.english: After running five kilometers, he was covered in sweat.

喊.meaning: to shout; to yell; to call out (to someone): 大声喊, 喊他的名字

examples.hanzi: 他在楼下喊了我的名字十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lóuxià hǎn le wǒ de míngzi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: He shouted my name downstairs for ten minutes.

examples.hanzi: 妈, 你喊哥哥来吃饭!
examples.pinyin: Mā, nǐ hǎn gēge lái chī fàn!
examples.english: Mom, call big brother to come eat!

航班.meaning: flight (scheduled): 航班号, 航班延误, 搭乘航班

examples.hanzi: 因为大雾, 二十多个航班延误了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi dà wù, èrshí duō ge hángbān yánwù le.
examples.english: Because of heavy fog, more than twenty flights were delayed.

寒假.meaning: winter vacation (school break): 放寒假, 寒假作业

examples.hanzi: 寒假我想去北方看雪。
examples.pinyin: Hánjià wǒ xiǎng qù běifāng kàn xuě.
examples.english: I want to go north to see snow this winter vacation.

near_synonyms.difference: 冷 is the everyday adjective for cold weather or objects (今天很冷); 寒冷 is a formal/literary intensifier for severe cold (寒冷的冬天)

寒冷.meaning: cold (weather/climate; formal vs 冷): 寒冷的冬天

examples.hanzi: 寒冷的冬天, 他坚持在户外跑步。
examples.pinyin: Hánlěng de dōngtiān, tā jiānchí zài hùwài pǎobù.
examples.english: In the cold winter he keeps running outdoors.

好处.meaning: benefit; advantage; good point: 锻炼的好处, 有很多好处

examples.hanzi: 坚持锻炼对身体有很多好处。
examples.pinyin: Jiānchí duànliàn duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎochù.
examples.english: Exercising regularly has many benefits for the body.

好好.meaning: properly; carefully; to one's heart's content (好好 + verb): 好好学习, 好好休息

examples.hanzi: 你要好好学习, 别总想着玩。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào hǎohao xuéxí, bié zǒng xiǎngzhe wán.
examples.english: You should study hard and stop thinking about playing.

好笑.meaning: funny; laughable; amusing: 好笑的故事, 觉得好笑

examples.hanzi: 他讲的笑话真好笑, 大家都笑了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de xiàohua zhēn hǎoxiào, dàjiā dōu xiào le.
examples.english: The joke he told was so funny that everyone laughed.

合格.meaning: qualified; up to standard: 合格产品, 考试合格

examples.hanzi: 只有合格的产品才能出厂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu hé gé de chǎnpǐn cái néng chū chǎng.
examples.english: Only qualified products may leave the factory.

盒子.meaning: box; case: 一个盒子, 鞋盒子

examples.hanzi: 她把项链放回小盒子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ xiàngliàn fàng huí xiǎo hézi li.
examples.english: She put the necklace back in the little box.

红包.meaning: red envelope (gift of money): 发红包, 收红包, 抢红包

examples.hanzi: 过年的时候, 长辈给孩子们发红包。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de shíhou, zhǎngbèi gěi háizimen fā hóngbāo.
examples.english: At New Year, elders give children red envelopes.

厚.meaning: thick (of flat things): 这本书很厚, 厚衣服

examples.hanzi: 冬天的羽绒服又厚又暖和。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de yǔróngfú yòu hòu yòu nuǎnhuo.
examples.english: Winter down jackets are thick and warm.

厚.meaning: deep; generous (kindness, favor): 情深意厚, 厚礼 — literary

examples.hanzi: 这份礼轻, 情意却很厚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn lǐ qīng, qíngyì què hěn hòu.
examples.english: This gift is light, yet the kindness is deep.

后悔.meaning: to regret; regretful: 后悔来不及了, 我很后悔

examples.hanzi: 不好好复习, 考完试他就后悔了。
examples.pinyin: Bù hǎohao fùxí, kǎo wán shì tā jiù hòuhuǐ le.
examples.english: Not having reviewed well, he regretted it right after the exam.

坏处.meaning: harm; disadvantage; bad effect: 抽烟的坏处, 有坏处也有好处

examples.hanzi: 熬夜对身体有很多坏处。
examples.pinyin: áoyè duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō huàichù.
examples.english: Staying up late does the body a lot of harm.

怀疑.meaning: to doubt; to suspect: 我怀疑他说的话; 怀疑对象

examples.hanzi: 他说的话让人怀疑。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà ràng rén huáiyí.
examples.english: What he says makes people doubt him.

怀疑.meaning: to suspect (that something is the case): 我怀疑他病了 = I suspect he's ill

examples.hanzi: 天这么黑, 我怀疑要下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān zhème hēi, wǒ huáiyí yào xià yǔ le.
examples.english: The sky's so dark — I suspect it's going to rain.

话剧.meaning: stage play; drama (spoken, not opera): 看话剧, 一场话剧

examples.hanzi: 我们晚上去看了一场话剧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎnshang qù kàn le yī chǎng huàjù.
examples.english: We went to see a stage play in the evening.

环保.meaning: environmental protection; eco-friendly: 环保袋, 重视环保

examples.hanzi: 超市鼓励顾客自带环保袋。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshì gǔlì gùkè zì dài huánbǎo dài.
examples.english: The supermarket encourages customers to bring their own eco-bags.

换乘.meaning: to transfer (between trains/buses lines): 换乘地铁, 换乘站

examples.hanzi: 坐二号线到站后换乘十号线。
examples.pinyin: Zuò èr hào xiàn dào zhàn hòu huànchéng shí hào xiàn.
examples.english: Take Line 2 and transfer to Line 10 at the station.

回复.meaning: to reply (to a message): 尽快回复, 回复邮件

examples.hanzi: 我给他发了两封邮件, 他都没回复。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā fā le liǎng fēng yóujiàn, tā dōu méi huífù.
examples.english: I sent him two emails and he hasn't replied to either.

回复.meaning: to restore; to recover (formal): 恢复原样

examples.hanzi: 医生们全力抢救, 病人终于回复了意识。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēngmen quánlì qiǎngjiù, bìngrén zhōngyú huífù le yìshi.
examples.english: The doctors fought to save him and the patient finally regained consciousness.

回信.meaning: to write back; to reply (by letter): 给他回信

examples.hanzi: 他收到信后马上回信了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shōudào xìn hòu mǎshang huí xìn le.
examples.english: He wrote back as soon as he received the letter.

回信.meaning: a reply letter: 收到回信

examples.hanzi: 我还在等他的回信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái zài děng tā de huíxìn.
examples.english: I'm still waiting for his reply letter.

回忆.meaning: to recall; to reminisce: 回忆过去, 回忆起童年

examples.hanzi: 爷爷常常回忆年轻时候的事。
examples.pinyin: Yéye chángcháng huíyì niánqīng shíhou de shì.
examples.english: Grandpa often reminisces about his younger days.

回忆.meaning: memory; recollection: 美好的回忆, 童年的回忆

examples.hanzi: 这张照片留下了美好的回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn liú xià le měihǎo de huíyì.
examples.english: This photo preserves a beautiful memory.

会员.meaning: member (of a club, association): 会员卡, 成为会员

examples.hanzi: 办了会员卡, 买东西可以打折。
examples.pinyin: Bàn le huìyuán kǎ, mǎi dōngxi kěyǐ dǎ zhé.
examples.english: With a membership card, purchases get a discount.

互联网.meaning: the Internet: 互联网时代, 上互联网

examples.hanzi: 互联网改变了人们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng gǎibiàn le rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: The Internet has changed people's way of life.

活.meaning: alive; living: 活鱼, 活着

examples.hanzi: 池塘里养着活鱼。
examples.pinyin: Chítáng li yǎngzhe huó yú.
examples.english: Live fish are raised in the pond.

活.meaning: to live; to survive: 活下来了, 活到八十岁

examples.hanzi: 他在那次事故中活了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nà cì shìgù zhōng huó le xiàlai.
examples.english: He survived that accident.

活.meaning: work; job (manual): 干活儿, 找活儿

examples.hanzi: 爸爸退休后又找了个活儿干。
examples.pinyin: Bàba tuìxiū hòu yòu zhǎo le ge huór gàn.
examples.english: After retiring, Dad found another job to do.

活.meaning: lively; flexible; movable: 活水, 活页, 心眼儿活

examples.hanzi: 他脑子活, 什么问题都难不倒他。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǎozi huó, shénme wèntí dōu nán bu dǎo tā.
examples.english: His mind is quick — no problem stumps him.

货.meaning: goods; commodity (semi-bound: 货物, 百货, 送货, 进货): 这家店货很全

examples.hanzi: 这家店的货很全, 什么都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de huò hěn quán, shénme dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This shop's stock is comprehensive — it has everything.

火.meaning: fire; flame: 着火了, 生火, 火灾

examples.hanzi: 厨房着火了，快打一一九！
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng zháohuǒ le, kuài dǎ yāo yāo jiǔ!
examples.english: The kitchen's on fire — call 119 quick!

火.meaning: popular; hot (colloquial): 这家店最近很火; 他火了

examples.hanzi: 这家奶茶店最近特别火, 天天排队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā nǎichá diàn zuìjìn tèbié huǒ, tiāntiān páiduì.
examples.english: This bubble tea shop has been really hot lately — lines every day.

examples.hanzi: 他工作不顺, 回家就发火。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò bù shùn, huí jiā jiù fā huǒ.
examples.english: Work isn't going well, so he loses his temper as soon as he gets home.

获得.meaning: to obtain; to gain; to win (an award, qualification, support) (formal): 获得冠军, 获得批准

examples.hanzi: 她获得了今年的最佳演员奖。
examples.pinyin: Tā huòdé le jīnnián de zuìjiā yǎnyuán jiǎng.
examples.english: She won this year's best actress award.

活动.meaning: activity; event: 课外活动, 举办活动

examples.hanzi: 学校组织了一次植树活动。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zǔzhī le yī cì zhíshù huódòng.
examples.english: The school organized a tree-planting activity.

活动.meaning: to move about; (of joints) to be flexible: 活动一下, 活动活动

examples.hanzi: 坐久了站起来活动一下。
examples.pinyin: Zuò jiǔ le zhàn qǐlai huódòng yīxià.
examples.english: After sitting long, stand up and move around a bit.

获奖.meaning: to win an award/prize: 获奖作品, 获奖名单

examples.hanzi: 这幅画在比赛中获奖了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà zài bǐsài zhōng huòjiǎng le.
examples.english: This painting won a prize in the competition.

活泼.meaning: lively; vivacious: 性格活泼, 活泼的孩子

examples.hanzi: 妹妹性格活泼, 谁见了都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei xìnggé huópō, shéi jiàn le dōu xǐhuan.
examples.english: My little sister is lively — everyone who meets her likes her.

获取.meaning: to acquire; to obtain (information, data, knowledge) (formal): 获取信息, 获取能量

examples.hanzi: 上网的目的主要是获取信息。
examples.pinyin: Shàng wǎng de mùdì zhǔyào shì huòqǔ xìnxī.
examples.english: The main purpose of going online is to obtain information.

忽然.meaning: suddenly; unexpectedly: 忽然下雨了, 忽然想起一件事

examples.hanzi: 他正走着, 忽然停了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèng zǒuzhe, hūrán tíng le xiàlai.
examples.english: He was walking along when he suddenly stopped.

护士.meaning: nurse (hospital): 一位护士, 护士站

examples.hanzi: 护士每天都要照顾很多病人。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi měitiān dōu yào zhàogù hěn duō bìngrén.
examples.english: Nurses care for many patients every day.

near_synonyms.difference: 互相 and 相互 are interchangeable before two-syllable verbs (互相/相互尊重); 相互 additionally works attributively (相互关系) and is more formal

互相.meaning: each other; mutually (before two-syllable verbs): 互相帮助, 互相了解; also attributive 互相尊重的关系

examples.hanzi: 同学之间要互相帮助。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxué zhījiān yào hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: Classmates should help each other.

既.meaning: both… and… (既…又/也…): 既聪明又努力 — links two parallel qualities/clauses

examples.hanzi: 这个房间既干净又安静。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān jì gānjìng yòu ānjìng.
examples.english: This room is both clean and quiet.

既.meaning: already (既然 since already — mainly in the compound 既然)

examples.hanzi: 既然大家都到了, 咱们就开始吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā dōu dào le, zánmen jiù kāishǐ ba.
examples.english: Since everyone is here, let's begin.

寄.meaning: to mail; to send (by post); to deposit (hope in): 寄信, 寄包裹, 寄希望于…

examples.hanzi: 他把包裹寄给了外地的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ bāoguǒ jì gěi le wàidì de péngyou.
examples.english: He mailed the package to a friend in another city.

假.meaning: holiday; vacation; leave (of absence): 放假, 请假, 寒假暑假

examples.hanzi: 他向公司请了三天假。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng gōngsī qǐng le sān tiān jià.
examples.english: He took three days of leave from the company.

假.meaning: fake; false; counterfeit: 假钱, 假话, 假货

examples.hanzi: 这张一百块是假钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yībǎi kuài shì jiǎ qián.
examples.english: This 100-yuan note is counterfeit.

假.meaning: if; supposing (formal, 假如/假设): 假使 — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 假如明天放假, 我们就去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú míngtiān fàngjià, wǒmen jiù qù pá shān.
examples.english: If tomorrow is a holiday, we'll go hiking.

加班.meaning: to work overtime (离合词: 加了两天班): 经常加班, 加班费

examples.hanzi: 项目快结束了, 他天天加班。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngmù kuài jiéshù le, tā tiāntiān jiābān.
examples.english: The project is nearly done and he works overtime daily.

价格.meaning: price: 价格便宜, 价格上涨, 合理的价格

examples.hanzi: 同样的东西, 网上的价格便宜一些。
examples.pinyin: Tóngyàng de dōngxi, wǎng shang de jiàgé piányi yīxiē.
examples.english: The same items are a bit cheaper online.

家具.meaning: furniture (no plural, measure word 件/套): 买家具, 一套家具

examples.hanzi: 搬家的时候, 大件家具最麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Bān jiā de shíhou, dà jiàn jiājù zuì máfan.
examples.english: When moving house, big furniture is the biggest hassle.

加快.meaning: to speed up; to accelerate: 加快速度, 加快发展

examples.hanzi: 天快黑了, 我们加快脚步吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān kuài hēi le, wǒmen jiākuài jiǎobù ba.
examples.english: It's getting dark — let's quicken our pace.

减.meaning: to reduce; to decrease; to subtract: 减肥, 减了五公斤, 减价

examples.hanzi: 他靠运动减了五公斤。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào yùndòng jiǎn le wǔ gōngjīn.
examples.english: He lost five kilos through exercise.

减.meaning: to omit; to cut out (删减): 减少环节

examples.hanzi: 这份报告删减了不少内容。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shānjiǎn le bùshǎo nèiróng.
examples.english: Quite a lot of content was cut from this report.

降.meaning: to drop; to fall; to lower: 温度降低了, 降价

examples.hanzi: 气温突然降了十度。
examples.pinyin: Qìwēn tūrán jiàng le shí dù.
examples.english: The temperature suddenly dropped ten degrees.

降.meaning: to concede; to surrender (投降) — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 敌人不肯投降, 战斗继续。
examples.pinyin: Dírén bù kěn tóuxiáng, zhàndòu jìxù.
examples.english: The enemy refused to surrender and the fighting continued.

降.meaning: to surrender; to subdue (投降, 降龙) — classical reading in fixed compounds

examples.hanzi: 敌人投降了。
examples.pinyin: Dírén tóuxiáng le.
examples.english: The enemy surrendered.

奖.meaning: prize; award; bonus: 得奖, 发奖, 一等奖

examples.hanzi: 他第一次参加比赛就得了一等奖。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì cānjiā bǐsài jiù dé le yī děng jiǎng.
examples.english: He won first prize the very first time he entered a competition.

奖.meaning: to reward; to encourage (奖励, 夸奖) — mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 优秀员工受到了公司的奖励。
examples.pinyin: Yōuxiū yuángōng shòudào le gōngsī de jiǎnglì.
examples.english: Outstanding employees received the company's reward.

江.meaning: (large) river (originally the Yangtze; now generic for major rivers, mainly in names): 长江, 黑龙江, 江边

examples.hanzi: 长江是中国最长的江。
examples.pinyin: Cháng Jiāng shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de jiāng.
examples.english: The Yangtze is China's longest river.

将.meaning: will; be going to (formal future marker before verbs, = 将要/要): 会议将于明天召开

examples.hanzi: 会议将于明天上午九点召开。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì jiāng yú míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn zhàokāi.
examples.english: The meeting will convene at nine tomorrow morning.

将.meaning: (formal passive/causative, = 把): 将垃圾进行分类 — formal writing

examples.hanzi: 请将垃圾进行分类。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jiāng lājī jìnxíng fēnlèi.
examples.english: Please sort the garbage.

将.meaning: to take in; to be ready for (将就 to make do; 将军 checkmate): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 条件差就差吧, 咱们将就一晚。
examples.pinyin: Tiáojiàn chà jiù chà ba, zánmen jiāngjiù yī wǎn.
examples.english: The conditions are poor, but let's make do for one night.

降低.meaning: to lower; to reduce (a level, cost, standard): 降低成本, 降低温度

examples.hanzi: 公司想办法降低了生产成本。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiǎng bànfǎ jiàngdī le shēngchǎn chéngběn.
examples.english: The company found ways to lower production costs.

降价.meaning: to lower the price; to cut prices: 降价促销, 大幅度降价

examples.hanzi: 换季的时候, 商场纷纷降价。
examples.pinyin: Huàn jì de shíhou, shāngchǎng fēnfēn jiàngjià.
examples.english: At season changeover, malls cut prices one after another.

奖金.meaning: bonus; prize money: 发奖金, 年终奖金

examples.hanzi: 项目成功后, 每个人都拿到了奖金。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngmù chénggōng hòu, měi ge rén dōu ná dào le jiǎngjīn.
examples.english: After the project succeeded, everyone got a bonus.

near_synonyms.difference: 将来 is a nearer, personal future, used adverbially or as a noun (将来当老师); 未来 is more abstract/distant (未来的城市) and rarely adverbial

将来.meaning: the future; in the future (vs 未来 which is more abstract/written): 将来的计划, 将来我想当医生

examples.hanzi: 将来我想开一家自己的小店。
examples.pinyin: Jiānglái wǒ xiǎng kāi yī jiā zìjǐ de xiǎo diàn.
examples.english: In the future I want to open a small shop of my own.

降落.meaning: to land; to descend (a plane): 飞机降落了, 安全降落

examples.hanzi: 飞机平稳地降落在了机场。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī píngwěn de jiàngluò zài le jīchǎng.
examples.english: The plane landed smoothly at the airport.

降温.meaning: (of weather) for the temperature to drop: 明天降温, 大幅度降温

examples.hanzi: 天气预报说明天大幅降温。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān dà fú jiàngwēn.
examples.english: The forecast says temperatures will drop sharply tomorrow.

降温.meaning: to cool down (a device, a situation): 给机器降温 — technical

examples.hanzi: 机器太热了, 得先降温再干活。
examples.pinyin: Jīqì tài rè le, děi xiān jiàngwēn zài gànhuó.
examples.english: The machine is too hot; cool it down before working.

奖学金.meaning: scholarship: 获得奖学金, 申请奖学金

examples.hanzi: 她成绩优秀, 拿到了全额奖学金。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngjì yōuxiù, ná dào le quán'é jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.english: Her grades are excellent and she got a full scholarship.

将要.meaning: will; be about to (formal future): 火车将要开了, 会议将要结束

examples.hanzi: 火车将要开了, 请抓紧上车。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē jiāngyào kāi le, qǐng zhuājǐn shàng chē.
examples.english: The train is about to leave — hurry aboard.

减轻.meaning: to lighten; to ease (a burden, pain, pressure): 减轻负担, 减轻痛苦

examples.hanzi: 新规定减轻了学生们的作业负担。
examples.pinyin: Xīn guīdìng jiǎnqīng le xuéshēngmen de zuòyè fùdān.
examples.english: The new regulation lightened students' homework burden.

near_synonyms.difference: 减少 is a drop in number or amount (人数减少); 降低 is bringing a level, cost or temperature down (降低成本)

减少.meaning: to reduce; to decrease (in number or amount): 减少污染, 人数减少了

examples.hanzi: 这家店的顾客比去年减少了一半。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de gùkè bǐ qùnián jiǎnshǎo le yī bàn.
examples.english: This shop's customers have halved compared with last year.

健身.meaning: to work out; to keep fit: 健身房, 去健身, 健身器材

examples.hanzi: 他每天下班后都去健身房健身一小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu qù jiànshēnfáng jiànshēn yī xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He works out at the gym for an hour after work every day.

健身房.meaning: gym; fitness center: 一家健身房, 办健身卡

examples.hanzi: 家附近新开了一家健身房。
examples.pinyin: Jiā fùjìn xīn kāi le yī jiā jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: A new gym opened near my home.

near_synonyms.difference: 建议 is a constructive proposal (提建议); 意见 is an opinion or view, and can signal dissatisfaction (对他有意见)

建议.meaning: to suggest; to propose: 建议大家多运动, 他建议我去看看医生

examples.hanzi: 医生建议他多做户外运动。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō zuò hùwài yùndòng.
examples.english: The doctor advised him to do more outdoor exercise.

建议.meaning: suggestion; proposal: 提建议, 采纳这个建议, 三点建议

examples.hanzi: 我提了一个降低成本的建议。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tí le yī ge jiàngdī chéngběn de jiànyì.
examples.english: I made a suggestion to cut costs.

交.meaning: to hand over; to submit; to pay (交作业, 交钱, 交税): 交给老师

examples.hanzi: 明天是交作业的最后一天。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì jiāo zuòyè de zuìhòu yī tiān.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the last day to hand in homework.

交.meaning: to make (friends): 交朋友, 交了个新朋友

examples.hanzi: 他在学校交了很多新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào jiāo le hěn duō xīn péngyou.
examples.english: He made many new friends at school.

交.meaning: to intersect; to meet (交叉, 交界): 两条路在这儿交 — mainly compounds

examples.hanzi: 两条地铁线在市中心交叉。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng tiáo dìtiě xiàn zài shì zhōngxīn jiāochā.
examples.english: Two metro lines intersect downtown.

near_synonyms.difference: 自豪 is purely positive pride in achievement (我为祖国自豪); 骄傲 has both the positive 'proud' and the negative 'arrogant' senses

骄傲.meaning: proud (positive: of accomplishment): 我为你骄傲, 感到骄傲

examples.hanzi: 儿子考上了名牌大学, 妈妈很为他骄傲。
examples.pinyin: érzi kǎoshang le míngpái dàxué, māma hěn wèi tā jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Her son got into a top university, and Mom is very proud of him.

骄傲.meaning: arrogant; conceited: 骄傲自满, 取得成绩不要骄傲

examples.hanzi: 取得一点儿成绩就骄傲, 不会有进步。
examples.pinyin: Qǔdé yīdiǎnr chéngjì jiù jiāo'ào, bù huì yǒu jìnbù.
examples.english: Getting proud over a little success means no further progress.

交警.meaning: traffic police (officer): 交警指挥交通

examples.hanzi: 交警冒着大雨指挥交通。
examples.pinyin: Jiāojǐng màozhe dà yǔ zhǐhuī jiāotōng.
examples.english: Traffic police directed traffic despite the heavy rain.

教练.meaning: coach; instructor: 一位教练, 私人教练

examples.hanzi: 教练每天带着队员们训练。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn měitiān dàizhe duìyuánmen xùnliàn.
examples.english: The coach trains the team members every day.

教练.meaning: to coach; to train: 他教练这支球队 — less common

examples.hanzi: 退休后他在这家俱乐部教练。
examples.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu tā zài zhè jiā jùlèbù jiàoliàn.
examples.english: After retiring he coaches at this club.

交流.meaning: to exchange; to communicate (ideas, experience, culture): 交流经验, 学术交流

examples.hanzi: 两国学生定期交流活动。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó xuéshēng dìngqī jiāoliú huódòng.
examples.english: Students of the two countries hold regular exchange activities.

交流.meaning: exchange; communication: 文化交流, 加强交流

examples.hanzi: 这次会议促进了两国文化交流。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì cùjìn le liǎng guó wénhuà jiāoliú.
examples.english: This conference promoted cultural exchange between the two countries.

郊区.meaning: suburbs; outskirts: 住在郊区, 郊区的房子

examples.hanzi: 他们把家搬到了郊区, 空气好多了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ jiā bān dào le jiāoqū, kōngqì hǎo duō le.
examples.english: They moved their home to the suburbs; the air is much better.

教师.meaning: teacher (formal, vs 老师 colloquial): 一位教师, 教师节

examples.hanzi: 她是一位有二十年经验的老教师。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi yǒu èrshí nián jīngyàn de lǎo jiàoshī.
examples.english: She is a veteran teacher with twenty years of experience.

教授.meaning: professor: 一位教授, 大学教授

examples.hanzi: 王教授下周有一个公开讲座。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu xià zhōu yǒu yī ge gōngkāi jiǎngzuò.
examples.english: Professor Wang is giving a public lecture next week.

examples.hanzi: 老师教授学生基本的知识和技能。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiàoshòu xuéshēng jīběn de zhīshi hé jìnéng.
examples.english: Teachers instruct students in basic knowledge and skills.

交通.meaning: traffic; transportation: 交通堵塞, 交通工具, 交通事故

examples.hanzi: 早高峰时, 市区交通非常拥挤。
examples.pinyin: Zǎo gāofēng shí, shìqū jiāotōng fēicháng yōngjǐ.
examples.english: At morning rush hour, city traffic is very congested.

教学.meaning: teaching; to teach: 教学方法, 教学经验, 教学工作

examples.hanzi: 她热爱教学工作, 一教就是三十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā rè'ài jiàoxué gōngzuò, yī jiào jiù shì sānshí nián.
examples.english: She loves teaching and has taught for thirty years.

教育.meaning: to educate; to teach (a person a lesson): 教育孩子, 父母教育我要诚实

examples.hanzi: 父母从小教育孩子要诚实守信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ cóng xiǎo jiàoyù háizi yào chéngshí shǒuxìn.
examples.english: Parents teach their children from small to be honest and trustworthy.

教育.meaning: education: 接受教育, 教育水平, 高等教育

examples.hanzi: 这个省的教育水平在全国名列前茅。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shěng de jiàoyù shuǐpíng zài quánguó míngliè qiánmáo.
examples.english: This province's education level ranks among the nation's best.

叫作.meaning: to be called; to be named (defines a term): 这种现象叫作惯性 — slightly more formal than 叫做

examples.hanzi: 这种怕黑的心理现象叫作黑暗恐惧症。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng pà hēi de xīnlǐ xiànxiàng jiàozuò hēi'àn kǒngjùzhèng.
examples.english: This fear-of-darkness phenomenon is called nyctophobia.

价钱.meaning: price (colloquial, vs 价格 neutral/written): 价钱便宜, 讲价钱 bargain

examples.hanzi: 同样质量的鞋子, 这家价钱便宜。
examples.pinyin: Tóngyàng zhìliàng de xiézi, zhè jiā jiàqián piányi.
examples.english: For shoes of the same quality, this shop's prices are cheaper.

加强.meaning: to strengthen; to enhance: 加强管理, 加强合作, 加强锻炼

examples.hanzi: 学校加强了校园安全管理。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāqiáng le xiàoyuán ānquán guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: The school strengthened campus safety management.

假日.meaning: holiday; day off (formal): 假日经济, 公共假日

examples.hanzi: 假日里商场的人比平时多一倍。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì li shāngchǎng de rén bǐ píngshí duō yī bèi.
examples.english: On holidays the mall has twice as many people as usual.

加入.meaning: to join (an organization, group): 加入俱乐部, 加入我们

examples.hanzi: 他去年加入了学校的篮球队。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián jiārù le xuéxiào de lánqiú duì.
examples.english: He joined the school basketball team last year.

加入.meaning: to add (an ingredient) into: 加入糖和盐

examples.hanzi: 做汤时加入适量的盐。
examples.pinyin: Zuò tāng shí jiārù shìliàng de yán.
examples.english: Add an appropriate amount of salt when making soup.

加上.meaning: plus; added to; on top of that: 加上房租, 一共一千; 他很聪明, 加上很努力, 所以成功了

examples.hanzi: 房租加上水费, 一个月一共两千。
examples.pinyin: Fángzū jiāshang shuǐfèi, yī ge yuè yīgòng liǎng qiān.
examples.english: Rent plus water, 2,000 yuan a month in all.

near_synonyms.difference: 家 is the physical home or family members (回家, 我家人); 家庭 is the family as a social unit, used with abstract nouns (家庭作业, 家庭收入)

家庭.meaning: family (as a social unit, vs 家 the home): 家庭成员, 家庭作业, 幸福的家庭

examples.hanzi: 一个温暖的家庭对孩子的成长很重要。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge wēnnuǎn de jiātíng duì háizi de chéngzhǎng hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A warm family matters greatly to a child's growth.

near_synonyms.difference: 家乡 is the neutral everyday word (我的家乡); 故乡 is literary/nostalgic and common in writing (回到故乡)

家乡.meaning: hometown: 我的家乡, 回家乡, 家乡菜

examples.hanzi: 他退休后回到家乡养老。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu huídào jiāxiāng yǎnglǎo.
examples.english: After retiring he went back to his hometown.

加油.meaning: to refuel; to fill up (a vehicle): 给汽车加油, 加油站

examples.hanzi: 去加油站之前, 先看看油够不够。
examples.pinyin: Qù jiāyóuzhàn zhīqián, xiān kànkan yóu gòu bu gòu.
examples.english: Before going to the gas station, check whether there's enough fuel.

加油.meaning: go! go for it! (cheering encouragement): 中国队加油!; 考试加油!

examples.hanzi: 比赛快开始了, 我们一起为队员加油!
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, wǒmen yīqǐ wèi duìyuán jiāyóu!
examples.english: The match is about to start — let's cheer the players on!

加油站.meaning: gas station; petrol station: 一个加油站

examples.hanzi: 前面五百米就有一个加油站。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn wǔbǎi mǐ jiù yǒu yī ge jiāyóuzhàn.
examples.english: There's a gas station five hundred meters ahead.

家长.meaning: parents/guardians (of a child, vis-à-vis school): 家长会, 通知家长

examples.hanzi: 开家长会那天, 教室里坐满了家长。
examples.pinyin: Kāi jiāzhǎng huì nà tiān, jiàoshì li zuò mǎn le jiāzhǎng.
examples.english: On parents'-meeting day the classroom was full of parents.

基本.meaning: basic; fundamental: 基本知识, 基本原则

examples.hanzi: 掌握基本发音是学好汉语的基础。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎngwò jīběn fāyīn shì xué hǎo Hànyǔ de jīchǔ.
examples.english: Mastering basic pronunciation is the foundation of learning Chinese well.

基本.meaning: basically; on the whole: 基本完成了, 基本同意

examples.hanzi: 工程基本上完成了, 只剩收尾工作。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéng jīběnshang wánchéng le, zhǐ shèng shōuwěi gōngzuò.
examples.english: The project is basically finished; only wrap-up work remains.

基本上.meaning: basically; in the main; on the whole: 基本上没问题, 基本上同意

examples.hanzi: 他的病基本上好了, 还需要休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bìng jīběnshang hǎo le, hái xūyào xiūxi.
examples.english: His illness is basically cured; he still needs rest.

基础.meaning: foundation; base: 打好基础, 基础知识, 经济基础

examples.hanzi: 学数学要把基础打好。
examples.pinyin: Xué shùxué yào bǎ jīchǔ dǎ hǎo.
examples.english: To learn math you must lay a solid foundation.

基础.meaning: basis (of relations, research) and attributive 'basic/foundational': 基础设施 infrastructure, 基础研究 basic research

examples.hanzi: 国家加大了对基础设施的投入。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā jiādà le duì jīchǔ shèshī de tóurù.
examples.english: The state increased investment in infrastructure.

激动.meaning: excited; emotional; agitated: 激动得说不出话, 不要激动, 心情激动

examples.hanzi: 见到偶像, 她激动得说不出话。
examples.pinyin: Jiàn dào ǒuxiàng, tā jīdòng de shuō bu chū huà.
examples.english: On seeing her idol, she was too excited to speak.

街道.meaning: street (in a town): 一条街道, 街道两旁

examples.hanzi: 这条街道两旁种满了樱花树。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào liǎng páng zhòng mǎn le yīnghuā shù.
examples.english: This street is lined with cherry trees on both sides.

街道.meaning: subdistrict (administrative unit below a district, Mainland): 街道办事处

examples.hanzi: 有问题可以找街道办事处。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ zhǎo jiēdào bànshì chù.
examples.english: If you have problems you can go to the subdistrict office.

结果.meaning: result; outcome: 考试结果, 最终结果, 结果如何

examples.hanzi: 比赛的结果明天公布。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài de jiéguǒ míngtiān gōngbù.
examples.english: The result of the match will be announced tomorrow.

结果.meaning: as a result; consequently (unexpected turn): 他天天玩游戏, 结果考试没及格

examples.hanzi: 他天天玩游戏, 结果考试没及格。
examples.pinyin: Tā tiāntiān wán yóuxì, jiéguǒ kǎoshì méi jígé.
examples.english: He played games every day and as a result failed the exam.

节假日.meaning: holidays and festivals; days off (collective): 节假日出行, 节假日安排

examples.hanzi: 节假日的高速公路上车特别多。
examples.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì de gāosù gōnglù shang chē tèbié duō.
examples.english: On holidays the expressways are especially full of cars.

解释.meaning: to explain; to interpret: 解释一下, 很难解释

examples.hanzi: 他不肯解释, 我只好自己去问。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù kěn jiěshì, wǒ zhǐhǎo zìjǐ qù wèn.
examples.english: He wouldn't explain, so I had to go ask myself.

examples.hanzi: 对于这个现象, 科学家有不同的解释。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhège xiànxiàng, kēxuéjiā yǒu bùtóng de jiěshì.
examples.english: Scientists have different explanations for this phenomenon.

near_synonyms.difference: 接受 is accepting something offered (接受邀请, 接受现实); 接收 is technically receiving signals/items or taking over an organization (接收信号)

接受.meaning: to accept; to receive (something offered): 接受礼物, 接受批评, 接受采访

examples.hanzi: 他很谦虚, 愿意接受别人的批评。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn qiānxū, yuànyì jiēshòu biérén de pīpíng.
examples.english: He is modest and willing to accept criticism.

节约.meaning: to save; to use economically (resources): 节约用水, 节约时间

examples.hanzi: 我们应该节约每一滴水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jiéyuē měi yī dī shuǐ.
examples.english: We should save every drop of water.

结账.meaning: to settle the bill; to check out (离合词: 结了账): 请结账, 超市结账

examples.hanzi: 吃完饭, 他去前台结账。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn, tā qù qiántái jiézhàng.
examples.english: After the meal he went to the front desk to settle the bill.

接着.meaning: then; following that; next: 他先吃了饭, 接着去做作业; 接着说

examples.hanzi: 他先介绍了自己, 接着回答了大家的提问。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiān jièshào le zìjǐ, jiēzhe huídá le dàjiā de tíwèn.
examples.english: He first introduced himself, then answered everyone's questions.

接着.meaning: to continue; to carry on (接 + 着): 接着讲下去

examples.hanzi: 故事讲一半, 他喝口水又接着讲。
examples.pinyin: Gùshi jiǎng yī bàn, tā hē kǒu shuǐ yòu jiēzhe jiǎng.
examples.english: Halfway through the story he took a sip of water and continued.

计划.meaning: plan; project: 学习计划, 按照计划, 五年计划

examples.hanzi: 我们计划秋天去新疆旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà qiūtiān qù Xīnjiāng lǚxíng.
examples.english: We're planning to travel to Xinjiang in autumn.

计划.meaning: to plan; to map out: 计划一下, 计划去旅行

examples.hanzi: 一切都按计划进行。
examples.pinyin: Yīqiè dōu àn jìhuà jìnxíng.
examples.english: Everything is proceeding according to plan.

积极.meaning: active; positive; proactive (attitude, participation): 积极参加, 态度积极, 积极性

examples.hanzi: 他在班会上积极发言。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bānhuì shang jījí fāyán.
examples.english: He spoke up actively at the class meeting.

积累.meaning: to accumulate (experience, wealth, data): 积累经验, 积累了大量资料

examples.hanzi: 他工作十年, 积累了丰富的管理经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò shí nián, jīlěi le fēngfù de guǎnlǐ jīngyàn.
examples.english: Ten years of work have accumulated rich management experience.

examples.hanzi: 知识的积累需要一个过程。
examples.pinyin: Zhīshi de jīlěi xūyào yī ge guòchéng.
examples.english: The accumulation of knowledge takes a process.

仅.meaning: only; merely (formal short form of 仅仅): 仅有一次, 仅供参考

examples.hanzi: 全场仅他一人答对了这道题。
examples.pinyin: Quán chǎng jǐn tā yī rén dá duì le zhè dào tí.
examples.english: He alone in the whole room answered this question correctly.

精彩.meaning: wonderful; brilliant; splendid (performance, speech, match): 精彩的表演, 比赛很精彩

examples.hanzi: 晚会的节目一个比一个精彩。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì de jiémù yī ge bǐ yī ge jīngcǎi.
examples.english: The gala's acts got more and more wonderful one after another.

警察.meaning: police; policeman: 一位警察, 报警, 交通警察

examples.hanzi: 遇到危险要马上找警察。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào wēixiǎn yào mǎshang zhǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: When in danger, immediately find the police.

景点.meaning: tourist sight; scenic spot: 著名景点, 参观景点

examples.hanzi: 长城是北京最有名的景点之一。
examples.pinyin: Chángchéng shì Běijīng zuì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn zhī yī.
examples.english: The Great Wall is one of Beijing's most famous sights.

经济.meaning: economy; economics: 发展经济, 国家经济, 经济学

examples.hanzi: 这个国家的经济正在慢慢恢复。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jīngjì zhèngzài mànmàn huīfù.
examples.english: This country's economy is slowly recovering.

经济.meaning: economical (省钱): 很经济, 经济实惠

examples.hanzi: 拼车上学既经济又环保。
examples.pinyin: Pīnchē shàngxué jì jīngjì yòu huánbǎo.
examples.english: Carpooling to school is both economical and green.

京剧.meaning: Beijing opera: 看京剧, 京剧表演

examples.hanzi: 爷爷是京剧迷, 每周都要去听一场。
examples.pinyin: Yéye shì jīngjù mí, měi zhōu dōu yào qù tīng yī chǎng.
examples.english: Grandpa is a Beijing-opera fan and takes in a show every week.

经历.meaning: to experience; to go through: 经历了很多事, 经历过战争

examples.hanzi: 他年轻时经历过很多困难。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí jīnglì guo hěn duō kùnnan.
examples.english: He went through many hardships when young.

经历.meaning: experience (what one has been through): 亲身经历, 难忘的经历

examples.hanzi: 在国外的两年是他难忘的经历。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài de liǎng nián shì tā nánwàng de jīnglì.
examples.english: The two years abroad were an unforgettable experience.

景区.meaning: scenic area (a managed tourist zone): 旅游景区, 景区门票

examples.hanzi: 节假日的景区里人山人海。
examples.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì de jǐngqū li rén shān rén hǎi.
examples.english: The scenic area is a sea of people on holidays.

竟然.meaning: unexpectedly; to one's surprise (written/stronger than 居然): 他竟然忘了, 竟然会这样

examples.hanzi: 这么难的题, 他竟然做对了。
examples.pinyin: Zhème nán de tí, tā jìngrán zuò duì le.
examples.english: Such a hard problem — he actually got it right.

景色.meaning: scenery; view (natural): 景色优美, 欣赏景色

examples.hanzi: 船在江上慢慢开, 两岸景色美不胜收。
examples.pinyin: Chuán zài jiāng shang mànmàn kāi, liǎng àn jǐngsè měi bù shèng shōu.
examples.english: The boat moves slowly on the river; the scenery on both banks is breathtaking.

尽管.meaning: even though; despite (introduces a concession, main clause often with 还是/仍): 尽管很累, 他还是坚持工作

examples.hanzi: 尽管下着大雨, 他还是准时到了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàzhe dà yǔ, tā háishì zhǔnshí dào le.
examples.english: Despite the heavy rain, he still arrived on time.

尽管.meaning: feel free to (encouragement): 有问题尽管问

examples.hanzi: 有问题尽管问, 别客气。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí jǐnguǎn wèn, bié kèqi.
examples.english: If you have questions, just ask — don't hold back.

经验.meaning: experience (accumulated knowledge/skill): 工作经验, 有经验, 经验丰富

examples.hanzi: 王老师有三十年的教学经验。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī yǒu sānshí nián de jiàoxué jīngyàn.
examples.english: Teacher Wang has thirty years of teaching experience.

竞争.meaning: to compete: 相互竞争, 竞争激烈

examples.hanzi: 这个行业竞争非常激烈。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hángyè jìngzhēng fēicháng jīliè.
examples.english: Competition in this industry is fierce.

竞争.meaning: competition: 激烈的竞争, 竞争力

examples.hanzi: 年轻人要适应社会的竞争。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yào shìyìng shèhuì de jìngzhēng.
examples.english: Young people must adapt to society's competition.

镜子.meaning: mirror: 一面镜子, 照镜子

examples.hanzi: 她出门前照了照镜子。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūmén qián zhào le zhào jìngzi.
examples.english: She took a look in the mirror before going out.

今后.meaning: from now on; in the future (formal vs 以后): 今后努力, 今后的发展

examples.hanzi: 今后我会更加注意交通安全。
examples.pinyin: Jīnhòu wǒ huì gèngjiā zhùyì jiāotōng ānquán.
examples.english: From now on I'll pay more attention to traffic safety.

仅仅.meaning: only; merely (emphatic, formal-leaning): 仅仅一次, 不仅仅是为了钱

examples.hanzi: 仅仅用了三个月, 新楼就盖好了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnjǐn yòng le sān ge yuè, xīn lóu jiù gài hǎo le.
examples.english: In only three months the new building was done.

进入.meaning: to enter; to go into; to enter (a stage/era): 进入房间, 进入决赛, 进入新时代

examples.hanzi: 考试开始了, 学生们进入教室。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ le, xuéshēngmen jìnrù jiàoshì.
examples.english: The exam has begun; students enter the classroom.

进行.meaning: to carry out; to conduct (a formal two-syllable verb; object must be a noun/VP-noun): 进行调查, 进行讨论, 会议正在进行

examples.hanzi: 会议正在进行, 请保持安静。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zhèngzài jìnxíng, qǐng bǎochí ānjìng.
examples.english: The meeting is in progress — please keep quiet.

紧张.meaning: nervous; tense (emotional): 第一次上台很紧张

examples.hanzi: 第一次上台演讲, 他紧张得手都抖了。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì shàng tái yǎnjiǎng, tā jǐnzhāng de shǒu dōu dǒu le.
examples.english: Speaking on stage for the first time, he was so nervous his hands shook.

紧张.meaning: tight; strained (relations, supplies): 关系紧张, 供应紧张

examples.hanzi: 年底了, 人手非常紧张。
examples.pinyin: Niándǐ le, rénshǒu fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: It's year-end and staffing is very tight.

禁止.meaning: to prohibit; to forbid (formal, often on signs): 禁止吸烟, 禁止停车

examples.hanzi: 图书馆内禁止大声喧哗。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn nèi jìnzhǐ dàshēng xuānhuá.
examples.english: Loud noise is forbidden in the library.

既然.meaning: since; as (introduces a known fact, main clause draws a conclusion — 既然…就…): 既然你不想去, 就别去了

examples.hanzi: 既然你不想去, 我们就换个人去吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng qù, wǒmen jiù huàn ge rén qù ba.
examples.english: Since you don't want to go, let's send someone else.

及时.meaning: timely; prompt: 及时的帮助, 非常及时

examples.hanzi: 发现问题要及时解决。
examples.pinyin: Fāxiàn wèntí yào jíshí jiějué.
examples.english: Problems should be solved promptly when found.

及时.meaning: in time; promptly: 及时赶到, 及时处理

examples.hanzi: 谢谢你及时的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ jíshí de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Thank you for your timely help.

即使.meaning: even if; even though (hypothetical concession — sharper than 虽然/尽管): 即使下雨, 我也要去; 即使错了也不要紧

examples.hanzi: 即使明天下雨, 运动会也照常举行。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ míngtiān xià yǔ, yùndònghuì yě zhàocháng jǔxíng.
examples.english: Even if it rains tomorrow, the sports meet will go ahead.

技术.meaning: technology; technique; skill: 科学技术, 技术人员, 网络技术

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的技术是世界一流的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de jìshù shì shìjiè yīliú de.
examples.english: This company's technology is world-class.

究竟.meaning: (in questions) exactly; actually (stronger than 到底): 你究竟想干什么?; 究竟怎么回事

examples.hanzi: 你究竟想说什么, 就直说吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng shuō shénme, jiù zhí shuō ba.
examples.english: What exactly do you want to say — just say it.

究竟.meaning: the truth; the whys and wherefores (书面): 大家都想知道个究竟

examples.hanzi: 大家都想知道个究竟。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiǎng zhī dào ge jiūjìng.
examples.english: Everyone wants to know the whole truth.

就是.meaning: precisely; exactly (emphasis/identification): 这就是我的意思; 他就是小明

examples.hanzi: 我要找的就是这本书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zhǎo de jiùshì zhè běn shū.
examples.english: This is exactly the book I was looking for.

就是.meaning: even if (就是…也…): 就是有困难, 我也要试一试

examples.hanzi: 就是再难, 我也要把汉语学好。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì zài nán, wǒ yě yào bǎ Hànyǔ xué hǎo.
examples.english: Even if it's harder still, I will master Chinese.

就是.meaning: just; simply (softening/limiting): 我就是想帮帮你; 就是有点儿贵 (it's just a bit expensive)

examples.hanzi: 我不是不帮你, 就是没有时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù shì bù bāng nǐ, jiùshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.english: It's not that I won't help — I just don't have time.

就是.meaning: yes (affirming after a negative question): ——你不是学生吧? ——我就是 yes I am

examples.hanzi: ——你不是南方人吧? ——我就是。
examples.pinyin: ——Nǐ bù shì nánfāng rén ba? ——Wǒ jiùshì.
examples.english: —You're not from the south, right? —Actually, I am.

继续.meaning: to continue; to go on (with): 继续工作, 继续说下去

examples.hanzi: 休息了十分钟, 大家继续工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiūxi le shí fēnzhōng, dàjiā jìxù gōngzuò.
examples.english: After a ten-minute break, everyone continued working.

继续.meaning: continuation: 与会人员合影后, 讲话继续 — formal

examples.hanzi: 休息过后, 比赛继续。
examples.pinyin: Xiūxi guòhòu, bǐsài jìxù.
examples.english: After the break, the match continues.

记者.meaning: journalist; reporter: 一位记者, 采访记者, 记者会

examples.hanzi: 记者们围着运动员采访。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhěmen wéizhe yùndòngyuán cǎifǎng.
examples.english: Reporters surrounded the athlete for interviews.

聚.meaning: to gather; to assemble: 聚会, 聚在一起 — mainly in compounds/with 在一起

examples.hanzi: 过年的时候, 一家人聚在一起吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de shíhou, yī jiā rén jù zài yīqǐ chī fàn.
examples.english: At New Year the whole family gathers to eat.

举.meaning: to raise; to lift: 举手, 举起来, 举起杯

examples.hanzi: 谁同意这个建议, 请举手。
examples.pinyin: Shéi tóngyì zhège jiànyì, qǐng jǔ shǒu.
examples.english: Whoever agrees with this proposal, please raise your hand.

举.meaning: to hold (an event) (= 举办, formal): 举办公益活动 — short form mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 学校举办公益活动, 学生们积极参加。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jǔbàn gōngyì huódòng, xuéshēngmen jījí cānjiā.
examples.english: The school holds charity events and students join eagerly.

举办.meaning: to hold; to host (an event): 举办运动会, 举办音乐会

examples.hanzi: 学校每年举办一次运动会。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào měinián jǔbàn yī cì yùndònghuì.
examples.english: The school holds a sports meet every year.

聚餐.meaning: to have a group meal; dine together: 同学聚餐, 一次聚餐

examples.hanzi: 项目结束后, 同事们一起聚餐。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngmù jiéshù hòu, tóngshìmen yīqǐ jùcān.
examples.english: After the project ended, the colleagues had a dinner together.

聚会.meaning: party; gathering: 生日聚会, 参加聚会

examples.hanzi: 周六晚上我们班有个聚会。
examples.pinyin: Zhōuliù wǎnshang wǒmen bān yǒu ge jùhuì.
examples.english: Our class is having a party Saturday night.

聚会.meaning: to gather; to get together: 老朋友聚会

examples.hanzi: 老同学们十年后又聚会了一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo tóngxuémen shí nián hòu yòu jùhuì le yī cì.
examples.english: The old classmates gathered again after ten years.

拒绝.meaning: to refuse; to reject: 拒绝邀请, 被拒绝了

examples.hanzi: 他拒绝了公司的加薪挽留, 还是出国了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jùjué le gōngsī de jiāxīn wǎnliú, háishì chūguó le.
examples.english: He refused the company's raise to keep him and went abroad anyway.

距离.meaning: distance: 距离很远, 保持距离, 学校离家的距离

examples.hanzi: 我家距离学校两公里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā jùlí xuéxiào liǎng gōnglǐ.
examples.english: My home is two kilometers from the school.

距离.meaning: (formal) from (a reference point): 距离考试还有三天 — equivalent of 离

examples.hanzi: 距离考试还有一周, 大家抓紧复习。
examples.pinyin: Jùlí kǎoshì hái yǒu yī zhōu, dàjiā zhuājǐn fùxí.
examples.english: It's one week until the exam — review hard.

举例.meaning: to give an example (举例来说 for example): 老师举例说明, 举个例子 (离合)

examples.hanzi: 老师举例说明了这个词的用法。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǔlì shuōmíng le zhège cí de yòngfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher gave examples to explain this word's usage.

举行.meaning: to hold; to stage (a meeting, ceremony) (formal): 举行会议, 举行婚礼

examples.hanzi: 开幕式在体育馆举行。
examples.pinyin: Kāimùshì zài tǐyùguǎn jǔxíng.
examples.english: The opening ceremony is held at the stadium.

剧院.meaning: theater (building for drama/performance): 一家剧院, 国家大剧院

examples.hanzi: 我们提前半小时到了剧院。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tíqián bàn xiǎoshí dào le jùyuàn.
examples.english: We arrived at the theater half an hour early.

开玩笑.meaning: to joke; to make fun of (离合: 开了个玩笑): 别拿我开玩笑, 我在跟你开玩笑

examples.hanzi: 我在跟你开玩笑, 你别当真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gēn nǐ kāi wánxiào, nǐ bié dàngzhēn.
examples.english: I'm joking with you — don't take it seriously.

near_synonyms.difference: 看法 is a view or judgment about something external (对他的看法); 想法 is what crosses one's mind, an idea or intention (有个新想法)

看法.meaning: view; opinion; way of seeing something: 我的看法, 对这个问题有不同的看法

examples.hanzi: 对这个问题, 每个人都有自己的看法。
examples.pinyin: Duì zhège wèntí, měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.english: Everyone has their own view on this question.

烤.meaning: to roast; to bake; to grill; to toast: 烤肉, 烤面包, 烤鸭

examples.hanzi: 我们在院子里烤肉, 香味飘得很远。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yuànzi li kǎo ròu, xiāngwèi piāo de hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: We barbecue in the yard; the aroma drifts far.

考虑.meaning: to consider; to think over: 考虑一下, 考虑周全, 让我考虑考虑

examples.hanzi: 这件事让我考虑考虑再答复你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ kǎolǜ kǎolǜ zài dáfù nǐ.
examples.english: Let me think this over before I reply to you.

考生.meaning: exam candidate; test-taker: 考生们, 高考考生

examples.hanzi: 考生们提前半小时进入了考场。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshēngmen tíqián bàn xiǎoshí jìnrù le kǎochǎng.
examples.english: The candidates entered the exam hall half an hour early.

咳.meaning: to cough: 咳嗽 — standalone 咳 is colloquial short form: 咳了一声

examples.hanzi: 他咳了一晚上, 早上就去看了医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā ké le yī wǎnshang, zǎoshang jiù qù kàn le yīshēng.
examples.english: He coughed all night and saw the doctor in the morning.

咳.meaning: oh dear; alas (sigh of regret or annoyance): 咳, 又忘了!

examples.hanzi: 咳, 又把钥匙忘在家里了!
examples.pinyin: Hāi, yòu bǎ yàoshi wàng zài jiā li le!
examples.english: Oh dear, I left my keys at home again!

克.meaning: gram (unit of weight): 五百克, 一公斤是一千克

examples.hanzi: 这袋面粉重五百克。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dài miànfěn zhòng wǔbǎi kè.
examples.english: This bag of flour weighs 500 grams.

棵.meaning: measure word for plants/trees: 一棵树, 两棵白菜

examples.hanzi: 院子里的那棵樱桃树开花了。
examples.pinyin: Yuànzi li de nà kē yīngtáo shù kāi huā le.
examples.english: The cherry tree in the yard has blossomed.

课程.meaning: course; curriculum: 选课程, 网上课程, 课程表

examples.hanzi: 这学期的课程安排得很满。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī de kèchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn.
examples.english: This term's course schedule is packed.

科技.meaning: science and technology: 科技发展, 高科技, 科技公司

examples.hanzi: 科技让生活变得更方便了。
examples.pinyin: Kējì ràng shēnghuó biàn de gèng fāngbiàn le.
examples.english: Technology has made life more convenient.

肯定.meaning: to affirm; to confirm; to be sure: 我肯定他来了, 肯定一下时间

examples.hanzi: 我肯定他把钥匙落在教室了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěndìng tā bǎ yàoshi là zài jiàoshì le.
examples.english: I'm sure he left his keys in the classroom.

肯定.meaning: certainly; definite(ly); for sure: 肯定会成功, 给个肯定的答复

examples.hanzi: 别担心, 肯定能赶上车。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, kěndìng néng gǎn shang chē.
examples.english: Don't worry — we'll definitely make the bus.

肯定.meaning: positive (attitude/praise): 老师肯定了我的进步 — recognize/approve sense

examples.hanzi: 老师肯定了他这学期的进步。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī kěndìng le tā zhè xuéqī de jìnbù.
examples.english: The teacher affirmed his progress this term.

客气.meaning: polite; courteous: 别客气 (you're welcome / don't be so polite), 太客气了

examples.hanzi: 主人客气地请客人多吃一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔrén kèqi de qǐng kèrén duō chī yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: The host politely urged the guests to eat more.

客气.meaning: to stand on ceremony; to be over-polite: 咱们都是老朋友, 你就别客气了

examples.hanzi: 都是老朋友了, 你就别客气了。
examples.pinyin: Dōu shì lǎo péngyou le, nǐ jiù bié kèqi le.
examples.english: We're old friends — don't stand on ceremony.

咳嗽.meaning: to cough: 咳嗽了一声, 他感冒了, 一直咳嗽

examples.hanzi: 他感冒了, 咳嗽得很厉害。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǎnmào le, késou de hěn lìhai.
examples.english: He caught a cold and coughs badly.

课堂.meaning: classroom (as a place of instruction, more abstract than 教室): 课堂上, 课外与课堂

examples.hanzi: 课堂上要积极思考, 敢于提问。
examples.pinyin: Kètáng shang yào jījí sīkǎo, gǎnyú tíwèn.
examples.english: In class you should think actively and dare to ask questions.

客厅.meaning: living room; sitting room: 客厅里, 大客厅

examples.hanzi: 客厅里摆着一套新沙发。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng li bǎizhe yī tào xīn shāfā.
examples.english: A new sofa set is arranged in the living room.

可惜.meaning: a pity; a shame; unfortunately: 真可惜, 可惜没赶上

examples.hanzi: 今天的音乐会我没能去, 真可惜。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de yīnyuèhuì wǒ méi néng qù, zhēn kěxī.
examples.english: I couldn't go to today's concert — what a pity.

可惜.meaning: what a pity!: 可惜! 差一点就赢了

examples.hanzi: 可惜! 就差一分及格。
examples.pinyin: Kěxī! Jiù chà yī fēn jígé.
examples.english: What a pity — one point short of passing.

科学.meaning: science: 自然科学, 社会科学, 科学家

examples.hanzi: 这道题要用科学的方法来解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yào yòng kēxué de fāngfǎ lái jiějué.
examples.english: This problem should be solved with a scientific method.

科学.meaning: scientific; methodical: 很科学的方法, 科学管理

examples.hanzi: 他从小喜欢科学, 想当科学家。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xǐhuan kēxué, xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.
examples.english: He's loved science since childhood and wants to be a scientist.

空.meaning: free; unoccupied (of time or space): 有空, 空出一间房, 抽空

examples.hanzi: 今天下午我有空, 可以帮你搬家。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ yǒu kòng, kěyǐ bāng nǐ bān jiā.
examples.english: I'm free this afternoon and can help you move.

空.meaning: empty; hollow: 空箱子, 房间空了

examples.hanzi: 房间空了, 人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān kōng le, rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: The room is empty; everyone has moved out.

空.meaning: sky; air (short for 空间/天空 — mainly compounds): 太空, 航空

examples.hanzi: 考试要求把空填对。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì yāoqiú bǎ kòng tián duì.
examples.english: The test requires filling the blanks correctly.

空.meaning: free time; gap (填空 fill in the blank): 没空儿 — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 下班后我没什么空儿, 周末才有。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān hòu wǒ méi shénme kòngr, zhōumò cái yǒu.
examples.english: After work I have little free time; only weekends.

恐怕.meaning: I'm afraid; presumably (softened judgment or worry): 恐怕来不及了, 他恐怕不会同意

examples.hanzi: 这么晚了, 恐怕他不会来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, kǒngpà tā bù huì lái le.
examples.english: It's so late — I'm afraid he won't come.

空气.meaning: air; atmosphere: 空气新鲜, 空气污染

examples.hanzi: 雨后的空气特别新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de kōngqì tèbié xīnxiān.
examples.english: The air after rain is especially fresh.

口语.meaning: spoken language; oral speech (as a skill): 练习口语, 口语考试, 英语口语

examples.hanzi: 她的英语口语进步很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngyǔ kǒuyǔ jìnbù hěn kuài.
examples.english: Her spoken English is improving fast.

苦.meaning: bitter (taste): 这药很苦, 苦瓜

examples.hanzi: 这种中药很苦, 但效果不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhōngyào hěn kǔ, dàn xiàoguǒ búcuò.
examples.english: This herbal medicine is bitter but works well.

苦.meaning: suffering; hard (life): 吃苦, 苦日子, 生活很苦

examples.hanzi: 小时候家里穷, 吃了不少苦。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou jiā li qióng, chī le bùshǎo kǔ.
examples.english: When young the family was poor and I suffered a lot.

苦.meaning: painful; distressed (feeling): 苦恼, 辛苦 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 这份工作虽然辛苦, 但是很有意义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán xīnkǔ, dànshì hěn yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: This work is toilsome but very meaningful.

快餐.meaning: fast food: 快餐店, 吃快餐

examples.hanzi: 中午太忙, 他只吃了个快餐。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ tài máng, tā zhǐ chī le ge kuàicān.
examples.english: Too busy at noon, he just had some fast food.

快递.meaning: express delivery; courier: 收快递, 寄快递, 快递员

examples.hanzi: 你的快递到了, 放在门口了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de kuàidì dào le, fàng zài ménkǒu le.
examples.english: Your delivery has arrived; it's at the door.

快递.meaning: to send by courier: 把文件快递过去

examples.hanzi: 把这份文件快递到上海。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn kuàidì dào Shànghǎi.
examples.english: Courier this document to Shanghai.

快速.meaning: fast; rapid; high-speed: 快速发展, 快速列车, 快速反应

examples.hanzi: 高铁的快速发展改变了人们的出行方式。
examples.pinyin: Gāotiě de kuàisù fāzhǎn gǎibiàn le rénmen de chūxíng fāngshì.
examples.english: The rapid development of high-speed rail has changed how people travel.

困.meaning: sleepy; drowsy: 我困了, 困得睁不开眼

examples.hanzi: 午饭后他很困, 趴在桌上睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Wǔfàn hòu tā hěn kùn, pā zài zhuō shang shuìzháo le.
examples.english: After lunch he was so sleepy he fell asleep at his desk.

困.meaning: to be stranded; to trap; to surround (困难, 困住): 困在机场

examples.hanzi: 大雪把整个村子困了一天。
examples.pinyin: Dà xuě bǎ zhěngge cūnzi kùn le yī tiān.
examples.english: Heavy snow left the whole village stranded for a day.

困难.meaning: difficulty; hardship: 遇到困难, 克服困难

examples.hanzi: 遇到困难不要怕, 我们一起想办法。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào kùnnan búyào pà, wǒmen yīqǐ xiǎng bànfǎ.
examples.english: Don't fear difficulties — we'll figure it out together.

困难.meaning: difficult; hard (situation): 这段时间很困难, 困难户

examples.hanzi: 那几年家里很困难, 但大家都挺过来了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jǐ nián jiā li hěn kùnnan, dàn dàjiā dōu tǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: Those years the family was hard up, but everyone pulled through.

辣.meaning: spicy; hot (of food): 四川菜很辣, 怕辣

examples.hanzi: 四川人不怕辣, 顿顿都要吃辣。
examples.pinyin: Sìchuān rén bù pà là, dùndùn dōu yào chī là.
examples.english: Sichuan people aren't afraid of spice — every meal has chili.

拉.meaning: to pull; to drag (vs 推 push): 拉门, 拉车, 拉住他

examples.hanzi: 他拉着行李箱走进了车站。
examples.pinyin: Tā lāzhe xíngli xiāng zǒu jìn le chēzhàn.
examples.english: He pulled his suitcase into the station.

拉.meaning: to play (a bowed string instrument): 拉小提琴, 拉二胡

examples.hanzi: 她拉小提琴已经十年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lā xiǎotíqín yǐjīng shí nián le.
examples.english: She has played violin for ten years.

examples.hanzi: 这辆小车是拉货用的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng xiǎo chē shì lā huò yòng de.
examples.english: This little cart is for hauling goods.

拉.meaning: to defecate (crude): 拉肚子 have diarrhea

examples.hanzi: 他昨天吃坏了肚子, 拉了一晚上。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān chī huài le dùzi, lā le yī wǎnshang.
examples.english: He ate something bad and had diarrhea all night.

来不及.meaning: there's no time to; to be too late to (来不及 + verb): 来不及了, 来不及吃早饭

examples.hanzi: 飞机马上起飞了, 现在去机场来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng qǐfēi le, xiànzài qù jīchǎng láibuji le.
examples.english: The plane takes off soon — there's no time to get to the airport now.

来得及.meaning: there's still time to (来得及 + verb): 现在报名还来得及

examples.hanzi: 还有半小时, 来得及吃个早饭。
examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu bàn xiǎoshí, láidejí chī ge zǎofàn.
examples.english: There's still half an hour — time enough for breakfast.
