垃圾.meaning: garbage; trash; rubbish: 扔垃圾, 垃圾桶, 垃圾分类

examples.hanzi: 出门时顺手把垃圾带下去扔了。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén shí shùnshǒu bǎ lājī dài xiàqu rēng le.
examples.english: On the way out, take the garbage down and throw it away.

懒.meaning: lazy: 他很懒, 懒得动 (can't be bothered)

examples.hanzi: 他懒得很, 房间几个星期都不打扫。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎn de hěn, fángjiān jǐ ge xīngqī dōu bù dǎsǎo.
examples.english: He's so lazy his room goes weeks without cleaning.

浪费.meaning: to waste; to squander: 浪费时间, 浪费粮食

examples.hanzi: 别忘了关灯, 别浪费电。
examples.pinyin: Bié wàng le guān dēng, bié làngfèi diàn.
examples.english: Don't forget to turn off the lights — don't waste electricity.

浪费.meaning: waste: 造成浪费, 减少浪费

examples.hanzi: 不必要的浪费完全可以避免。
examples.pinyin: Bú bìyào de làngfèi wánquán kěyǐ bìmiǎn.
examples.english: Unnecessary waste can be entirely avoided.

浪漫.meaning: romantic: 浪漫的晚餐, 很浪漫

examples.hanzi: 他在海边准备了一个浪漫的求婚。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎibiān zhǔnbèi le yī ge làngmàn de qiúhūn.
examples.english: He prepared a romantic seaside proposal.

examples.hanzi: 动物园里的老虎正在睡午觉。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán li de lǎohǔ zhèngzài shuì wǔjiào.
examples.english: The tiger at the zoo is taking its midday nap.

老家.meaning: one's original family home/hometown: 回老家过年, 老家来人

examples.hanzi: 春节前, 千万在外地的人都回老家了。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, qiānwàn zài wàidì de rén dōu huí lǎojiā le.
examples.english: Before Spring Festival, migrant workers all returned to their hometowns.

老年.meaning: old age; elderly (as a life stage): 老年人, 进入老年

examples.hanzi: 老年人更喜欢清静的生活环境。
examples.pinyin: Lǎonián rén gèng xǐhuan qīngjìng de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: The elderly prefer a quiet living environment.

老是.meaning: always (of something annoying, colloquial): 他老是迟到, 老是忘记

examples.hanzi: 他上课老是走神, 成绩越来越差。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng kè lǎoshì zǒushén, chéngjì yuè lái yuè chà.
examples.english: He keeps zoning out in class and his grades keep slipping.

冷静.meaning: calm; cool-headed: 保持冷静, 头脑冷静, 冷静一下

examples.hanzi: 遇到突发情况, 首先要冷静。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào tūfā qíngkuàng, shǒuxiān yào lěngjìng.
examples.english: In an emergency, the first thing is to stay calm.

俩.meaning: two (of people, colloquial fusion of 两个 — must be followed directly by a noun, no measure word): 咱俩, 俩人, 父子俩

examples.hanzi: 咱俩去看看新开的电影院吧。
examples.pinyin: Zán liǎ qù kànkan xīn kāi de diànyǐngyuàn ba.
examples.english: Let's the two of us go check out the new cinema.

连.meaning: even (emphasis, 连…都/也…): 连他都不知道, 连饭都没吃

examples.hanzi: 忙得连饭都没时间吃。
examples.pinyin: Máng de lián fàn dōu méi shíjiān chī.
examples.english: So busy there wasn't even time to eat.

连.meaning: to link; to join; to connect (including 连接): 两条路连在一起; 连上网

examples.hanzi: 这两条路在山顶连在了一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo lù zài shāndǐng lián zài le yīqǐ.
examples.english: These two paths join together at the summit.

连.meaning: continuously; including (连看三场比赛 one after another)

examples.hanzi: 他连看三场比赛, 眼睛都累了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lián kàn sān chǎng bǐsài, yǎnjing dōu lèi le.
examples.english: He watched three matches in a row; even his eyes got tired.

凉.meaning: cool (pleasantly): 凉水, 凉快, 这水真凉

examples.hanzi: 天凉了, 出门记得加件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tiān liáng le, chūmén jìde jiā jiàn yīfu.
examples.english: It's turned cool — remember to add a layer when going out.

凉.meaning: to let cool (of hot food/tea): 把粥凉一凉 — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 粥太烫了, 先凉一凉再喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu tài tàng le, xiān liáng yī liáng zài hē.
examples.english: The porridge is too hot — let it cool a bit first.

凉.meaning: to be left out/dumped (of a plan or person): 这事被凉在一边 — slang extension

examples.hanzi: 他提的建议没人理, 人也凉在一边了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tí de jiànyì méi rén lǐ, rén yě liáng zài yībiān le.
examples.english: His proposals got no attention and he himself was left out in the cold.

量.meaning: quantity; amount; capacity (数量, 力量, 饭量 — bound): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这次活动的饭量要按人数准备。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng de fànliàng yào àn rénshù zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: The amount of food for this event must be based on headcount.

量.meaning: to measure: 量体温, 量尺寸

examples.hanzi: 护士每天给病人量体温。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi měitiān gěi bìngrén liáng tǐwēn.
examples.english: The nurse takes the patients' temperature every day.

量.meaning: to estimate; to deliberate (商量, 思量): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 这件事你得好好思量一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ děi hǎohao sīliáng yīxià.
examples.english: You'd better deliberate carefully on this matter.

亮.meaning: bright: 屋子里很亮, 明亮, 亮晶晶

examples.hanzi: 天亮了, 小鸟在窗外叫。
examples.pinyin: Tiān liàng le, xiǎoniǎo zài chuāng wài jiào.
examples.english: It's light out; birds chirp outside the window.

亮.meaning: to light up; to shine: 天亮了, 灯亮着, 打开灯照亮

examples.hanzi: 教室的灯还亮着。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì de dēng hái liàngzhe.
examples.english: The classroom lights are still on.

两2.meaning: the tael/liang, a traditional unit of weight (50 grams): 半斤八两, 一两银子 — mostly in set phrases now

examples.hanzi: 半斤八两, 两个人的水平差不多。
examples.pinyin: Bàn jīn bā liǎng, liǎng ge rén de shuǐpíng chàbuduō.
examples.english: Six of one, half a dozen of the other — the two are about the same level.

联系.meaning: to contact; to get in touch with: 联系我, 保持联系, 联系方式

examples.hanzi: 到了学校记得跟我联系。
examples.pinyin: Dào le xuéxiào jìde gēn wǒ liánxì.
examples.english: Remember to contact me once you're at school.

联系.meaning: connection; link: 失去联系, 有密切联系

examples.hanzi: 换了号码后, 我们失去了联系。
examples.pinyin: Huàn le hàomǎ hòu, wǒmen shīqù le liánxì.
examples.english: After changing numbers, we lost touch.

列.meaning: measure word for trains and rows of things: 一列火车

examples.hanzi: 一列火车缓缓驶出车站。
examples.pinyin: Yī liè huǒchē huǎnhuǎn shǐ chū chēzhàn.
examples.english: A train slowly pulled out of the station.

列.meaning: to list; to line up; to arrange: 列出理由, 排列, 列队

examples.hanzi: 请在表格中列出你的获奖经历。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé zhōng liè chū nǐ de huòjiǎng jīnglì.
examples.english: Please list your awards in the form.

列.meaning: row; column (series, sequence): 系列 — mainly compounds

examples.hanzi: 把选项按重要性排成一系列。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ xuǎnxiàng àn zhòngyàoxìng pái chéng yī xìliè.
examples.english: Arrange the options into a series by importance.

理发.meaning: to get/have a haircut (离合: 理了个发): 去理发, 理发店

examples.hanzi: 他每个月去理发一次。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè qù lǐfà yī cì.
examples.english: He goes for a haircut once a month.

厉害.meaning: formidable; awesome; fierce; intense: 他汉语说得很厉害; 头疼得厉害 (intensely); 好厉害!

examples.hanzi: 他汉语说得太厉害了, 外国人都以为他是中国人。
examples.pinyin: Tā Hànyǔ shuō de tài lìhai le, wàiguórén dōu yǐwéi tā shì Zhōngguó rén.
examples.english: His Chinese is so good that foreigners take him for a Chinese.

理解.meaning: to understand; to comprehend (ideas, feelings — deeper than 明白): 理解能力, 我理解你的心情

examples.hanzi: 我完全理解你现在的心情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wánquán lǐjiě nǐ xiànzài de xīnqíng.
examples.english: I completely understand how you feel now.

examples.hanzi: 朋友之间需要相互的理解。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou zhījiān xūyào xiānghù de lǐjiě.
examples.english: Friends need mutual understanding.

礼貌.meaning: courtesy; politeness: 有礼貌, 没礼貌, 讲礼貌

examples.hanzi: 这孩子见了长辈就问好, 很有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè háizi jiàn le zhǎngbèi jiù wènhǎo, hěn yǒu lǐmào.
examples.english: This child greets elders and is very polite.

礼貌.meaning: polite (of behavior): 很礼貌的说法

examples.hanzi: 很礼貌地说'不'也是一种能力。
examples.pinyin: Hěn lǐmào de shuō 'bù' yě shì yī zhǒng nénglì.
examples.english: Saying no politely is also a skill.

另.meaning: other; another; separately: 另一个人, 另一方面, 另当别论

examples.hanzi: 这个问题我们另找时间讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen lìng zhǎo shíjiān tǎolùn.
examples.english: We'll discuss this question another time.

零下.meaning: below zero (temperature): 零下五度 minus five degrees

examples.hanzi: 北方冬天常常零下十几度。
examples.pinyin: Běifāng dōngtiān chángcháng língxià shí jǐ dù.
examples.english: Northern winters are often ten-some degrees below zero.

零花钱.meaning: pocket money; allowance: 给零花钱, 省零花钱

examples.hanzi: 他每周的零花钱都用来买书。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu de línghuāqián dōu yòng lái mǎi shū.
examples.english: His weekly pocket money all goes to books.

零钱.meaning: small change; coins: 换点儿零钱, 一把零钱

examples.hanzi: 我身上没带零钱, 只有整钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēn shang méi dài língqián, zhǐyǒu zhěngqián.
examples.english: I have no small change on me, only large bills.

零食.meaning: snacks (between meals): 吃零食, 买零食

examples.hanzi: 他一边看电影一边吃零食。
examples.pinyin: Tā yībiān kàn diànyǐng yībiān chī língshí.
examples.english: He eats snacks while watching the movie.

另外.meaning: other; another; additional: 另外一件事, 另外的办法

examples.hanzi: 这件事很重要, 另外我们再谈谈费用问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, lìngwài wǒmen zài tántan fèiyòng wèntí.
examples.english: This matters a lot; besides, let's talk about costs.

另外.meaning: besides; in addition; separately: 另外, 我还想说一点; 这些另外算

examples.hanzi: 这些文件另外放, 别混在一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wénjiàn lìngwài fàng, bié hùn zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: Put these documents separately — don't mix them up.

力气.meaning: physical strength: 有力气, 费力气, 力气大

examples.hanzi: 他力气很大, 一个人搬起了桌子。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìqi hěn dà, yī ge rén bān qǐ le zhuōzi.
examples.english: He's very strong and lifted the table alone.

例如.meaning: for example; for instance (introducing examples, formal): 很多运动, 例如跑步和游泳

examples.hanzi: 很多水果, 例如苹果和香蕉, 都对身体好。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō shuǐguǒ, lìrú píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo, dōu duì shēntǐ hǎo.
examples.english: Many fruits, for example apples and bananas, are good for you.

留.meaning: to stay; to remain: 留在国内, 留下, 他留了三次级

examples.hanzi: 毕业后他留在了北京工作。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu tā liú zài le Běijīng gōngzuò.
examples.english: After graduating he stayed to work in Beijing.

留.meaning: to keep; to reserve; to save (for someone): 留个座位, 给他留点儿饭

examples.hanzi: 妈妈给他留了一份饭。
examples.pinyin: Māma gěi tā liú le yī fèn fàn.
examples.english: Mom saved a portion of food for him.

留.meaning: to leave (a message, hair length): 留言, 留长头发, 留胡子

examples.hanzi: 他去美国前留了邮箱, 方便联系。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Měiguó qián liú le yóuxiāng, fāngbiàn liánxì.
examples.english: Before going to the US he left his email to keep in touch.

留.meaning: to let/ask someone stay: 留他吃晚饭

examples.hanzi: 客人非要留他吃晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén fēi yào liú tā chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: The guest insisted he stay for dinner.

流.meaning: to flow (liquid): 河水流进海里, 流汗, 流眼泪

examples.hanzi: 跑了五公里, 汗一直往下流。
examples.pinyin: Pǎo le wǔ gōnglǐ, hàn yīzhí wǎng xià liú.
examples.english: After the 5k, sweat kept streaming down.

流.meaning: to spread; to circulate (流行 sense): 流传下来 — literary compound use

examples.hanzi: 这些民间故事流传了上百年。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē mínjiān gùshi liúchuán le shàng bǎi nián.
examples.english: These folk tales have circulated for over a hundred years.

流利.meaning: fluent (speech): 汉语说得很流利, 流利的英语

examples.hanzi: 她用流利的中文做了自我介绍。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng liúlì de Zhōngwén zuò le zìwǒ jièshào.
examples.english: She introduced herself in fluent Chinese.

留下.meaning: to stay behind; to remain: 留下干活儿, 他留下了

examples.hanzi: 其他人都走了, 只有他留下了。
examples.pinyin: Qítā rén dōu zǒu le, zhǐyǒu tā liú xià le.
examples.english: Everyone else left; only he stayed behind.

留下.meaning: to leave behind (an impression, name, thing): 留下了深刻的印象, 留下电话号码

examples.hanzi: 这座城市给他留下了深刻的印象。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì gěi tā liú xià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: This city left a deep impression on him.

流行.meaning: popular; fashionable; prevalent: 流行歌曲, 今年很流行

examples.hanzi: 这首歌今年特别流行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē jīnnián tèbié liúxíng.
examples.english: This song is especially popular this year.

理想.meaning: ideal; aspiration; dream: 远大的理想, 实现理想

examples.hanzi: 他从小就有当医生的职业理想。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu dāng yīshēng de zhíyè lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Since childhood he's dreamed of being a doctor.

理想.meaning: ideal; satisfactory: 不太理想的结果, 条件很理想

examples.hanzi: 这次考试的结果不太理想。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de jiéguǒ bù tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: This exam's result was less than ideal.

例子.meaning: example; instance: 举个例子, 举了很多例子

examples.hanzi: 老师用了很多例子来解释这个语法。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng le hěn duō lìzi lái jiěshì zhège yǔfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher used many examples to explain this grammar.

乱.meaning: messy; disorderly; untidy: 房间很乱, 头发乱了

examples.hanzi: 他的房间里乱得没地方下脚。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān li luàn de méi dìfang xià jiǎo.
examples.english: His room is so messy there's nowhere to step.

乱.meaning: chaotic; confused; at random: 乱说, 乱七八糟, 心里很乱

examples.hanzi: 别乱动别人的东西。
examples.pinyin: Bié luàn dòng biérén de dōngxi.
examples.english: Don't randomly touch other people's things.

旅馆.meaning: hotel (smaller/older term vs 酒店): 一家旅馆, 住旅馆

examples.hanzi: 我们在景点附近找了一家小旅馆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jǐngdiǎn fùjìn zhǎo le yī jiā xiǎo lǚguǎn.
examples.english: We found a small hotel near the sights.

路过.meaning: to pass by; to stop by en route: 路过商店, 正好路过你家

examples.hanzi: 路过面包店, 顺便买了个蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Lùguò miànbāodiàn, shùnbiàn mǎi le ge dàngāo.
examples.english: Passing the bakery, I bought a cake while at it.

旅客.meaning: traveler; passenger (formal, e.g. station announcements): 各位旅客请注意

examples.hanzi: 各位旅客, 列车马上进站了。
examples.pinyin: Gè wèi lǚkè, lièchē mǎshàng jìn zhàn le.
examples.english: Passengers, the train is about to enter the station.

落.meaning: to fall; to drop; to settle: 落叶, 太阳落山了, 落地

examples.hanzi: 秋天的落叶铺满了小路。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de luòyè pū mǎn le xiǎolù.
examples.english: Autumn leaves blanket the path.

落.meaning: to fall behind; to lag (落后): 落在别人后面, 落下功课

examples.hanzi: 他因为贪玩, 学习落在了别人后面。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi tānwán, xuéxí luò zài le biérén hòumiàn.
examples.english: Because of too much play, his studies fell behind.

落.meaning: to leave out; to be missing: 落了一个字, 别落下东西

examples.hanzi: 抄课文时落了一个字。
examples.pinyin: Chāo kèwén shí là le yī ge zì.
examples.english: I left out a character when copying the text.

落.meaning: variant of là in 落枕, 落炕 — dialectal

examples.hanzi: 昨天睡觉落枕了, 脖子不能转。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān shuìjiào làozhěn le, bózi bù néng zhuàn.
examples.english: I slept wrong on my neck and now can't turn it.

律师.meaning: lawyer; attorney: 一位律师, 请律师

examples.hanzi: 他请律师处理合同纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng lǜshī chǔlǐ hétong jiūfēn.
examples.english: He hired a lawyer to handle the contract dispute.

旅行.meaning: to travel; to make a trip: 去欧洲旅行, 旅行了一个星期

examples.hanzi: 退休后, 他们每年都去国外旅行。
examples.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu, tāmen měinián dōu qù guówài lǚxíng.
examples.english: After retiring they travel abroad every year.

旅行.meaning: travel; trip: 旅行计划, 自助旅行

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行我们花了不到一万块。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng wǒmen huā le bù dào yī wàn kuài.
examples.english: This trip cost us under 10,000 yuan.

麻烦.meaning: troublesome; inconvenient: 这件事很麻烦, 麻烦的问题

examples.hanzi: 换三次车才能到, 太麻烦了。
examples.pinyin: Huàn sān cì chē cái néng dào, tài máfan le.
examples.english: You have to transfer three times to get there — too much hassle.

麻烦.meaning: trouble; bother: 给你添麻烦了, 怕麻烦

examples.hanzi: 自己做饭虽然好吃, 但也很麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò fàn suīrán hǎochī, dàn yě hěn máfan.
examples.english: Cooking for yourself is tasty but also a bother.

麻烦.meaning: to trouble someone (politely): 麻烦你帮我看一下行李

examples.hanzi: 麻烦您帮我看一下行李。
examples.pinyin: Máfan nín bāng wǒ kàn yīxià xíngli.
examples.english: May I trouble you to watch my luggage?

麻烦.meaning: sorry to bother you (opening formula): 麻烦您让一下

examples.hanzi: 麻烦您让一下, 我过不去。
examples.pinyin: Máfan nín ràng yīxià, wǒ guò bu qù.
examples.english: Excuse me, could you step aside — I can't get through.

满.meaning: full; filled: 杯子满了, 挤满了人, 满意

examples.hanzi: 地铁里挤满了上班的人。
examples.pinyin: Dìtiě li jǐ mǎn le shàngbān de rén.
examples.english: The metro is packed with commuters.

满.meaning: fully; completely; a full (period): 满一年, 满怀信心 — formal

examples.hanzi: 他在国外工作满十年才回国。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài gōngzuò mǎn shí nián cái huí guó.
examples.english: He worked abroad a full ten years before returning home.

满.meaning: to expire (of a fixed term): 会员卡满了一年

examples.hanzi: 会员卡满一年后可以免费换新。
examples.pinyin: Huìyuán kǎ mǎn yī nián hòu kěyǐ miǎnfèi huàn xīn.
examples.english: Membership cards can be renewed free after a full year.

馒头.meaning: steamed bun: 一个馒头, 蒸馒头

examples.hanzi: 北方人早饭常吃馒头和粥。
examples.pinyin: Běifāng rén zǎofàn cháng chī mántou hé zhōu.
examples.english: Northerners often eat steamed buns and porridge for breakfast.

毛巾.meaning: towel: 一条毛巾, 擦毛巾

examples.hanzi: 洗完脸用毛巾擦干。
examples.pinyin: Xǐ wán liǎn yòng máojīn cā gān.
examples.english: After washing, dry your face with a towel.

毛衣.meaning: sweater: 一件毛衣, 织毛衣

examples.hanzi: 天冷了, 她给孩子们织了两件毛衣。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, tā gěi háizimen zhī le liǎng jiàn máoyī.
examples.english: It's cold; she knitted two sweaters for the kids.

帽子.meaning: hat; cap: 一顶帽子, 戴帽子

examples.hanzi: 出门时别忘了戴帽子防晒。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén shí bié wàng le dài màozi fángshài.
examples.english: Don't forget a hat for sun protection when out.

美.meaning: beautiful; pretty (written/short form of 美丽): 风景很美, 美中不足

examples.hanzi: 夕阳下的西湖美得像一幅画。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng xià de Xī Hú měi de xiàng yī fú huà.
examples.english: West Lake at sunset is beautiful as a painting.

美.meaning: satisfying; gratifying (formal compliments): 赞美, 完美 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 这份礼物虽轻, 情意却很美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn lǐwù suī qīng, qíngyì què hěn měi.
examples.english: This gift is light, yet the goodwill is lovely.

美好.meaning: fine; wonderful; beautiful (of life, future, wishes): 美好的未来, 美好生活

examples.hanzi: 全家人一起吃饭是最美好的时光。
examples.pinyin: Quán jiā rén yīqǐ chī fàn shì zuì měihǎo de shíguāng.
examples.english: The whole family eating together is the loveliest time.

美景.meaning: beautiful scenery: 欣赏美景, 一路美景

examples.hanzi: 站在山顶可以欣赏周围的美景。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shāndǐng kěyǐ xīnshǎng zhōuwéi de měijǐng.
examples.english: From the summit you can enjoy the beautiful scenery around.

美丽.meaning: beautiful (formal, of scenery/appearance): 美丽的城市, 美丽的风景

examples.hanzi: 秋天的香山红叶特别美丽。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de Xiāng Shān hóngyè tèbié měilì.
examples.english: The red leaves of Fragrant Hills in autumn are especially beautiful.

美食.meaning: delicious food; gourmet food: 品尝美食, 美食节

examples.hanzi: 成都是有名的美食之都。
examples.pinyin: Chéngdū shì yǒumíng de měishí zhī dū.
examples.english: Chengdu is a famous capital of good food.

梦.meaning: dream (while asleep); dream (aspiration): 做梦, 梦见, 梦想

examples.hanzi: 他昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó wǎn zuò le yī ge qíguài de mèng.
examples.english: He had a strange dream last night.

梦想.meaning: dream; aspiration: 实现梦想, 我的梦想是当医生

examples.hanzi: 他的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì chéngwéi yī míng fēixíngyuán.
examples.english: His dream is to become a pilot.

梦想.meaning: to dream of; to aspire to: 梦想有一天去月球

examples.hanzi: 她一直梦想着去南极看看。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí mèngxiǎngzhe qù Nánjí kànkan.
examples.english: She has always dreamed of seeing Antarctica.

面对.meaning: to face; to confront (a problem, reality, difficulty): 面对困难, 面对现实

examples.hanzi: 我们要勇敢地面对困难。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒnggǎn de miànduì kùnnan.
examples.english: We must face difficulties bravely.

免费.meaning: free (of charge): 免费停车, 免费的饮料

examples.hanzi: 博物馆每月有一天免费开放。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn měi yuè yǒu yī tiān miǎnfèi kāifàng.
examples.english: The museum is free one day each month.

免费.meaning: for free: 免费提供, 免费参加

examples.hanzi: 住酒店早餐免费提供。
examples.pinyin: Zhù jiǔdiàn zǎocān miǎnfèi tígōng.
examples.english: At the hotel, breakfast is provided free.

面试.meaning: job interview: 参加面试, 面试官

examples.hanzi: 她明天要去公司面试。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào qù gōngsī miànshì.
examples.english: She has a job interview at the company tomorrow.

面试.meaning: to interview (a candidate): 公司面试了二十个人

examples.hanzi: 公司面试了二十多个候选人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī miànshì le èrshí duō ge hòuxuǎnrén.
examples.english: The company interviewed over twenty candidates.

秒.meaning: second (unit of time): 十秒, 倒计时三十秒

examples.hanzi: 红灯还有三十秒。
examples.pinyin: Hóngdēng hái yǒu sānshí miǎo.
examples.english: The red light has thirty seconds left.

密码.meaning: password; secret code: 输入密码, 忘记密码

examples.hanzi: 密码我忘了, 只好重置。
examples.pinyin: Mìmǎ wǒ wàng le, zhǐhǎo chóngzhì.
examples.english: I forgot the password and had to reset it.

民族.meaning: ethnic group; nationality; nation: 汉族是一个民族, 五十六个民族, 民族文化

examples.hanzi: 中国有五十六个民族。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu wǔshíliù ge mínzú.
examples.english: China has fifty-six ethnic groups.

末.meaning: end; last part (of a period): 周末, 月末, 末班车 — bound

examples.hanzi: 周末我们去了郊区的古镇。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù le jiāoqū de gǔ zhèn.
examples.english: We went to the ancient town in the suburbs this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 古人把墨磨成粉末写字。
examples.pinyin: Gǔrén bǎ mò mó chéng fěnmò xiě zì.
examples.english: The ancients ground ink into powder to write.

目标.meaning: goal; target; objective: 达到目标, 学习目标, 明确的目标

examples.hanzi: 今年的目标是存下两万块。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de mùbiāo shì cún xià liǎng wàn kuài.
examples.english: This year's goal is to save 20,000 yuan.

目的.meaning: purpose; aim; goal: 达到目的, 出于什么目的, 教育的目的

examples.hanzi: 他学汉语的目的是在中国工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué Hànyǔ de mùdì shì zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò.
examples.english: His purpose in learning Chinese is to work in China.

目的地.meaning: destination: 到达目的地, 目的地是上海

examples.hanzi: 导航显示还有二十分钟到目的地。
examples.pinyin: Dǎoháng xiǎnshì hái yǒu èrshí fēnzhōng dào mùdìdì.
examples.english: Navigation says twenty minutes to the destination.

母女.meaning: mother and daughter: 母女俩, 母女关系

examples.english: The mother and daughter look like sisters.

目前.meaning: at present; currently (formal, vs 现在): 目前的情况, 目前为止

examples.hanzi: 目前他还在犹豫去不去。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián tā hái zài yóuyù qù bu qù.
examples.english: At the moment he's still hesitating whether to go.

母亲.meaning: mother (formal, vs 妈妈): 我的母亲, 母亲节

examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn de shǒuyì shì quán jiā de xìngfú.
examples.english: Mother's cooking is the whole family's happiness.

母子.meaning: mother and son: 母子俩, 母子平安

examples.pinyin: Chēzhàn li mǔzǐ liǎ gàobié, yǎnjing dōu hóng le.
examples.english: At the station mother and son said goodbye with red eyes.

耐心.meaning: patience: 有耐心, 没有耐心, 耐心地解释

examples.hanzi: 教小孩子画画需要很大的耐心。
examples.pinyin: Jiāo xiǎo háizi huàhuà xūyào hěn dà de nàixīn.
examples.english: Teaching little kids to draw takes great patience.

耐心.meaning: patient: 老师很耐心, 耐心指导

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn de huídá le měi ge wèntí.

examples.english: Typhoons mainly affect China's southern coast.

examples.pinyin: Nándào nǐ wàng le tā bāng guo wǒmen duōshǎo cì ma?

男士.meaning: man; gentleman (polite/public contexts): 男士们女士们, 男士洗手间

examples.english: The men's version of this coat is on the second floor.

难受.meaning: uncomfortable; unwell; feeling bad (physical or emotional): 身体难受, 心里很难受

难忘.meaning: unforgettable; memorable: 难忘的经历, 令人难忘

examples.pinyin: Nà shì yī cì nánwàng de bìyè lǚxíng.

内.meaning: inside; within (formal; colloquial is 里/里面): 室内, 国内, 一周内 — bound

examples.english: Please complete registration within three days.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng bǐ fēngmiàn yǒuyìsi duō le.
examples.english: This book's content is far more interesting than its cover.

内心.meaning: inner heart; innermost feelings: 内心深处, 发自内心

examples.pinyin: Tā zuǐ shang bù shuō, nèixīn qíshí hěn gǎnxiè dàjiā.

能够.meaning: can; to be able to: 能够独立完成, 能够坚持下去

examples.pinyin: Jiānchí sān ge yuè, nǐ jiù nénggòu kàn dào biànhuà.

能力.meaning: ability; capability: 有能力, 能力强, 学习能力, 工作能力

examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò xūyào hěn qiáng de gōutōng nénglì.
examples.english: This job requires strong communication skills.

嗯.meaning: mm; hmm; yes (assenting or thinking sound, often prolonged): 嗯, 我知道了; 嗯…让我想想

examples.english: Mm, got it — coming right away.

年底.meaning: the end of the year: 到年底, 年底总结

年龄.meaning: age (formal/neutral vs 岁): 年龄段, 年龄相同

弄.meaning: to play with; to fiddle with: 别弄我的电脑

examples.pinyin: Bié luàn nòng wǒ de móxíng, nà shì pīn le sān tiān de.
examples.english: Don't fiddle with my model — it took three days to build.

暖和.meaning: warm (weather, room, clothing): 天气暖和了, 屋里很暖和

examples.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, tiānqì nuǎnhuo qǐlai le.
examples.english: Spring is here and the weather is warming up.

女性.meaning: female (formal/statistical term): 女性朋友, 女性顾客

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yī bàn de gōngchéngshī shì nǚxìng.

偶尔.meaning: occasionally; once in a while: 偶尔喝茶, 偶尔去一次电影院

排.meaning: to line up; to arrange: 排队, 排节目单, 排好队

排.meaning: row; rank: 一排椅子, 第一排, 前排

牌.meaning: brand; trademark (牌子): 什么牌子的?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì shénme páizi de shǒujī?

牌.meaning: plate; tablet; sign: 车牌, 门牌, 指示牌, 广告牌

牌.meaning: cards; dominoes (牌类): 打牌, 玩牌

examples.english: He patted my shoulder to encourage me.

拍.meaning: to take (a photo); to shoot (a film): 拍照片, 拍电影, 拍了一下视频

拍.meaning: to send (colloquial, of sending money/images): 拍给我 — e-commerce register

examples.english: How much for this figure? I'll take it — consider it bought.

排队.meaning: to stand in line; to queue up (离合: 排了三次队): 排队买票, 请排队

排球.meaning: volleyball: 打排球, 排球队

examples.english: The Chinese women's team is one of the world's best volleyball teams.

牌子.meaning: brand: 什么牌子, 名牌子的鞋

examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de suānnǎi zuì chàngxiāo.

判断.meaning: to judge; to decide; to determine: 判断正误, 很难判断
