examples.hanzi: 感冒了, 每天吃三次药片。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnmào le, měitiān chī sān cì yàopiàn.
examples.english: Caught a cold — take tablets three times a day.

片.meaning: short video clip (colloquial, 儿化): 拍了个小片儿 — newer usage

examples.hanzi: 他用手机拍了个小片儿发到网上。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒujī pāi le ge xiǎo piānr fā dào wǎng shang.
examples.english: He shot a short video on his phone and posted it online.

篇.meaning: measure word for articles, essays, papers: 一篇课文, 两篇论文

examples.hanzi: 他这篇作文被当作范文朗读。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè piān zuòwén bèi dàng zuò fànwén lǎngdú.
examples.english: His essay was read aloud as a model composition.

皮肤.meaning: skin: 皮肤很白, 皮肤病, 保护皮肤

examples.hanzi: 海边紫外线强, 要注意保护皮肤。
examples.pinyin: Hǎibiān zǐwàixiàn qiáng, yào zhùyì bǎohù pífū.
examples.english: UV at the seaside is strong; mind your skin.

平常.meaning: ordinary; common: 平常的事情, 很平常

examples.hanzi: 对他来说, 加班是很平常的事。
examples.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, jiābān shì hěn píngcháng de shì.
examples.english: For him, working overtime is an ordinary thing.

平常.meaning: usually; ordinarily (= 平时): 他平常很忙, 平常不多说话

examples.hanzi: 她平常坐地铁上班, 下雨天打车。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngcháng zuò dìtiě shàngbān, xià yǔ tiān dǎ chē.
examples.english: Usually she takes the metro to work; on rainy days a taxi.

乒乓球.meaning: table tennis; ping-pong: 打乒乓球, 乒乓球比赛

examples.hanzi: 乒乓球是中国的国球。
examples.pinyin: Pīngpāngqiú shì Zhōngguó de guó qiú.
examples.english: Table tennis is China's national sport.

批评.meaning: to criticize (typically superior-to-subordinate): 受到批评, 批评他两句

examples.hanzi: 他因为迟到受到了老师的批评。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chídào shòudào le lǎoshī de pīpíng.
examples.english: He was criticized by the teacher for being late.

examples.hanzi: 面对批评, 他虚心接受了。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng, tā xūxīn jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Faced with the criticism, he accepted it open-mindedly.

脾气.meaning: temper; disposition: 脾气好, 发脾气, 他脾气很大

examples.hanzi: 他脾气好, 从来不跟人吵架。
examples.pinyin: Tā píqi hǎo, cónglái bù gēn rén chǎojià.
examples.english: He has a good temper and never quarrels with anyone.

皮鞋.meaning: leather shoes: 一双皮鞋, 擦皮鞋

examples.hanzi: 面试那天他特意穿了一双新皮鞋。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì nà tiān tā tèyì chuān le yī shuāng xīn píxié.
examples.english: For the interview he specially wore new leather shoes.

破.meaning: worn-out; broken; tattered: 破衣服, 鞋破了

examples.hanzi: 这些书虽然旧了, 但一本都没破。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū suīrán jiù le, dàn yī běn dōu méi pò.
examples.english: These books are old but not one is damaged.

破.meaning: to break; to tear; to be damaged: 衣服破了个洞, 破了纪录

examples.hanzi: 他不小心摔破了一个杯子。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāi pò le yī ge bēizi.
examples.english: He carelessly broke a cup.

普遍.meaning: widespread; universal; general: 普遍现象, 普遍存在, 普遍认为

examples.hanzi: 网上支付在中国已经相当普遍。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshang zhīfù zài Zhōngguó yǐjīng xiāngdāng pǔbiàn.
examples.english: Online payment is already quite widespread in China.

葡萄.meaning: grape(s): 一串葡萄, 葡萄园

examples.hanzi: 新疆的葡萄又甜又便宜。
examples.pinyin: Xīnjiāng de pútao yòu tián yòu piányi.
examples.english: Xinjiang grapes are sweet and cheap.

葡萄酒.meaning: (grape) wine: 一杯葡萄酒, 红葡萄酒

examples.hanzi: 他每晚睡前喝一小杯红葡萄酒。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi wǎn shuì qián hē yī xiǎo bēi hóng pútaojiǔ.
examples.english: He drinks a small glass of red wine before bed each night.

普通.meaning: ordinary; common; average: 普通人, 普通火车, 普通的一天

examples.hanzi: 他虽是明星, 过的却是普通人的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā suī shì míngxīng, guò de què shì pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Though a star, he lives the life of an ordinary person.

普通话.meaning: Mandarin; Standard Chinese (the standard spoken language): 说普通话, 普通话考试

examples.hanzi: 不管来自哪里, 大家都用普通话交流。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn láizì nǎlǐ, dàjiā dōu yòng Pǔtōnghuà jiāoliú.
examples.english: Wherever people come from, they all communicate in Mandarin.

气.meaning: air; gas; breath: 喘气, 空气, 天然气 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 爬山爬得他直喘气。
examples.pinyin: Pá shān pá de tā zhí chuǎn qì.
examples.english: Climbing the mountain left him gasping for breath.

气.meaning: anger; temper: 生他的气, 气得说不出话

examples.hanzi: 他说话不算数, 我气得不想理他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà bù suànshù, wǒ qì de bù xiǎng lǐ tā.
examples.english: He broke his word and I'm too angry to talk to him.

气.meaning: spirit; manner (气质, 志气) — literary compounds

examples.hanzi: 这孩子从小就有一股不服输的志气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè háizi cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu yī gǔ bù fúshū de zhìqì.
examples.english: This kid has had an unyielding spirit since small.

期.meaning: period of time; term; issue (of a publication): 学期, 第三期杂志, 按期

examples.hanzi: 这本杂志每月出一期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì měi yuè chū yī qī.
examples.english: This magazine comes out once a month.

期.meaning: (bound) scheduled time; deadline: 到期, 按期完成

examples.hanzi: 签证下个月就到期了。
examples.pinyin: Qiānzhèng xià ge yuè jiù dàoqī le.
examples.english: The visa expires next month.

前方.meaning: the area ahead; front (formal, also news for battlefront): 前方到站, 前方高能 — internet meme use

examples.hanzi: 前方到站是人民广场。
examples.pinyin: Qiánfāng dào zhàn shì Rénmín Guǎngchǎng.
examples.english: The next station ahead is People's Square.

强.meaning: strong; powerful (vs 弱): 身体强, 能力强, 责任心强

examples.hanzi: 他的英语基础很强。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngyǔ jīchǔ hěn qiáng.
examples.english: His English foundation is strong.

强.meaning: better; superior (comparative use): 他比我强; 一年比一年强

examples.hanzi: 这次的产品比上一代强多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de chǎnpǐn bǐ shàng yī dài qiáng duō le.
examples.english: This product is much better than the last generation.

强.meaning: to force; to strive (强调, 强大 compounds): 强人所难 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 学习不能强求, 要有兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí bù néng qiǎngqiú, yào yǒu xìngqù.
examples.english: Study can't be forced — there must be interest.

强.meaning: stubborn; unyielding (倔强): 倔强的孩子

examples.hanzi: 这孩子性格倔强, 认准的事不改。
examples.pinyin: Zhè háizi xìnggé juéjiàng, rènzhǔn de shì bù gǎi.
examples.english: This kid is stubborn; what he's set on, he won't change.

前后.meaning: around; about (a time/date): 春节前后, 十点前后

examples.hanzi: 我们春节前后要去一趟南方。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen Chūnjié qiánhòu yào qù yī tàng nánfāng.
examples.english: We're going south around Spring Festival.

前后.meaning: from beginning to end (of a period); in succession: 前后花了一年, 前后来了三次

examples.hanzi: 为了这个项目, 他前后忙了半年。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhège xiàngmù, tā qiánhòu máng le bàn nián.
examples.english: For this project he was busy for half a year all told.

前后.meaning: front and back: 房子前后

examples.hanzi: 房子前后都种着菜。
examples.pinyin: Fángzi qiánhòu dōu zhòngzhe cài.
examples.english: Vegetables are planted in front of and behind the house.

千克.meaning: kilogram: 五十千克 = 五十公斤

examples.hanzi: 一个西瓜大约重五千克。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge xīguā dàyuē zhòng wǔ qiānkè.
examples.english: A watermelon weighs about five kilograms.

千万.meaning: ten million: 千万富翁, 几千万人

examples.hanzi: 出门千万要带好身份证。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qiānwàn yào dài hǎo shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: Absolutely do remember to bring your ID when going out.

千万.meaning: (in warnings/requests) be sure to; absolutely must: 千万别忘记, 千万要小心

examples.hanzi: 这个项目投资上千万。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù tóuzī shàng qiānwàn.
examples.english: This project invests tens of millions.

签证.meaning: visa: 申请签证, 工作签证, 签证过期

examples.hanzi: 他的签证还有三个月有效期。
examples.pinyin: Tā de qiānzhèng hái yǒu sān ge yuè yǒuxiàoqī.
examples.english: His visa is still valid for three months.

桥.meaning: bridge: 一座桥, 过桥, 长江大桥

examples.hanzi: 这座古桥有八百年的历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ qiáo yǒu bābǎi nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient bridge has eight hundred years of history.

巧.meaning: opportune; coincidental: 真巧!; 来得早不如来得巧, 恰巧

examples.hanzi: 真巧! 我也去北京, 咱们同路。
examples.pinyin: Zhēn qiǎo! Wǒ yě qù Běijīng, zánmen tónglù.
examples.english: What a coincidence — I'm going to Beijing too; we're on the same route.

巧.meaning: clever; skillful; ingenious: 心灵手巧, 很巧的办法

examples.hanzi: 这个办法很巧, 省了不少时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ hěn qiǎo, shěng le bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: This method is clever and saves a lot of time.

巧.meaning: slyly; on the sly (偷偷地 sense, 巧妙地): mainly compounds

examples.hanzi: 这个计划设计得很巧妙。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà shèjì de hěn qiǎomiào.
examples.english: This plan is ingeniously designed.

敲.meaning: to knock; to tap; to strike: 敲门, 敲键盘, 敲了敲桌子

examples.hanzi: 进门前要先敲门。
examples.pinyin: Jìn mén qián yào xiān qiāo mén.
examples.english: Knock before entering.

巧克力.meaning: chocolate: 一块巧克力, 黑巧克力

examples.hanzi: 她爱吃黑巧克力, 觉得不太甜。
examples.pinyin: Tā ài chī hēi qiǎokèlì, juéde bù tài tián.
examples.english: She loves dark chocolate — finds it not too sweet.

其次.meaning: secondly; next; in the next place (首先…其次…最后): 首先, 要省钱; 其次, 要省时间

examples.hanzi: 首先要有耐心, 其次要有方法。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuxiān yào yǒu nàixīn, qícì yào yǒu fāngfǎ.
examples.english: First you need patience; second, method.

起到.meaning: to play (a role); to have (an effect) (formal collocation with 作用/效果): 起到重要作用

examples.hanzi: 老师的鼓励起到了很大的作用。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de gǔlì qǐdào le hěn dà de zuòyòng.
examples.english: The teacher's encouragement played a big role.

气候.meaning: climate: 气候变化, 温带气候

examples.hanzi: 昆明的气候四季如春。
examples.pinyin: Kūnmíng de qìhòu sì jì rú chūn.
examples.english: Kunming's climate is spring-like all year.

期末.meaning: end of term (school): 期末考试, 期末复习

examples.hanzi: 期末考试安排在下个月十号。
examples.pinyin: Qīmò kǎoshì ānpái zài xià ge yuè shí hào.
examples.english: Final exams are scheduled for the 10th of next month.

琴.meaning: stringed/keyboard instrument in general (钢琴, 小提琴, 弹琴): 学琴 — semi-bound

examples.hanzi: 她每天练琴两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān liàn qín liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: She practices piano two hours a day.

轻.meaning: light (weight, vs 重): 这个包很轻

examples.hanzi: 这个行李箱很轻, 一只手就能提。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xíngli xiāng hěn qīng, yī zhī shǒu jiù néng tí.
examples.english: This suitcase is light — one hand can carry it.

轻.meaning: mild; slight (degree, force): 风很轻, 病得轻, 处分很轻

examples.hanzi: 他只受了轻伤, 休息几天就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ shòu le qīng shāng, xiūxi jǐ tiān jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He was only slightly injured; a few days' rest and he'll be fine.

轻.meaning: to belittle; to take lightly (年轻人): 别把这事儿看轻了 — formal-leaning

examples.hanzi: 别把这事儿看轻了, 后果很严重。
examples.pinyin: Bié bǎ zhè shìr kàn qīng le, hòuguǒ hěn yánzhòng.
examples.english: Don't take this matter lightly — the consequences are serious.

情况.meaning: situation; circumstance; condition: 在这种情况下, 具体情况, 情况如何

examples.hanzi: 路上的情况比我们想的复杂。
examples.pinyin: Lù shang de qíngkuàng bǐ wǒmen xiǎng de fùzá.
examples.english: Road conditions are more complex than we thought.

青年.meaning: young person; youth (roughly 18–35, formal): 青年人, 优秀青年

examples.hanzi: 村里的青年都出去打工了。
examples.pinyin: Cūn li de qīngnián dōu chūqù dǎgōng le.
examples.english: The village's young people have all gone off to work.

轻松.meaning: relaxed; easy; light: 心情轻松, 轻松的工作, 轻松一下

examples.hanzi: 忙完这周, 你就可以轻松一下了。
examples.pinyin: Máng wán zhè zhōu, nǐ jiù kěyǐ qīngsōng yīxià le.
examples.english: After this week you can finally take it easy.

轻松.meaning: to relax; to ease up: 轻松轻松

examples.hanzi: 周末去郊区爬山, 轻松轻松。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò qù jiāoqū pá shān, qīngsōng qīngsōng.
examples.english: Go hiking in the suburbs this weekend and unwind.

庆祝.meaning: to celebrate: 庆祝生日, 庆祝胜利

examples.hanzi: 朋友们聚在一起庆祝他的生日。
examples.pinyin: Péngyoumen jù zài yīqǐ qìngzhù tā de shēngrì.
examples.english: Friends gathered to celebrate his birthday.

亲戚.meaning: relatives (family members outside the immediate family): 走亲戚, 亲戚朋友

examples.hanzi: 过年的亲戚里, 他最想去舅舅家。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de qīnqi li, tā zuì xiǎng qù jiùjiu jiā.
examples.english: Among New Year relatives, he most wants to visit his uncle's.

汽水.meaning: soda (pop); soft drink: 一瓶汽水, 喝汽水

examples.hanzi: 孩子们夏天最爱喝冰汽水。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen xiàtiān zuì ài hē bīng qìshuǐ.
examples.english: Kids love ice-cold soda in summer.

球队.meaning: (ball) team: 足球队, 国家球队, 支持这支球队

examples.hanzi: 这支球队今年有望夺冠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì jīnnián yǒuwàng duóguàn.
examples.english: This team has a shot at the championship this year.

球迷.meaning: sports fan; ball-game fan: 足球迷, 一个铁杆球迷

examples.hanzi: 球迷们早早来到场外等候。
examples.pinyin: Qiúmímen zǎozao lái dào chǎng wài děnghòu.
examples.english: Fans arrived early to wait outside the venue.

气温.meaning: (air) temperature: 气温下降, 最高气温

examples.hanzi: 今天最高气温三十五度。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zuì gāo qìwēn sānshíwǔ dù.
examples.english: Today's high is 35 degrees.

其中.meaning: among them; of these (refers back to a just-mentioned set): 十个人, 其中三个是学生

examples.hanzi: 班里有十个学生, 其中有三个学过法语。
examples.pinyin: Bān li yǒu shí ge xuéshēng, qízhōng yǒu sān ge xué guo Fǎyǔ.
examples.english: The class has ten students, three of whom have studied French.

期中.meaning: midterm (middle of the school term): 期中考试

examples.hanzi: 期中考试后开了家长会。
examples.pinyin: Qīzhōng kǎoshì hòu kāi le jiāzhǎng huì.
examples.english: After midterm exams there was a parents' meeting.

取.meaning: to take; to get; to fetch: 取钱, 取行李, 拿取快递

examples.hanzi: 下班路上顺便取了快递。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān lù shang shùnbiàn qǔ le kuàidì.
examples.english: Picked up the delivery on the way home from work.

取.meaning: to choose; to adopt: 采取, 选取, 取长补短 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 老师教我们取长补短的学习方法。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen qǔ cháng bǔ duǎn de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher taught us to learn from others' strengths to offset weaknesses.

区.meaning: district; area; zone: 市区, 开发区, 朝阳区 (administrative), 时区

examples.hanzi: 他们搬到了朝阳区的一个小区。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bān dào le Cháoyáng qū de yī ge xiǎoqū.
examples.english: They moved to a compound in Chaoyang District.

全.meaning: complete; whole; entire: 全书, 全国, 一天全天

examples.hanzi: 这本书我全看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ quán kàn wán le.
examples.english: I've finished reading this entire book.

全.meaning: entirely; completely: 全忘了, 全都知道

examples.hanzi: 那天太累了, 回家倒在床上全忘了今天的不愉快。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiān tài lèi le, huí jiā dào zài chuáng shang quán wàng le jīntiān de bù yúkuài.
examples.english: That day I was so tired that back home I completely forgot the day's unpleasantness.

全.meaning: complete in range; comprehensive: 货很全, 种类全

examples.hanzi: 这家超市的货最全。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de huò zuì quán.
examples.english: This supermarket has the most complete stock.

全部.meaning: the whole; all; entirety: 全部完成, 把全部的钱都花了

examples.hanzi: 把全部材料交给办公室。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ quánbù cáiliào jiāo gěi bàngōngshì.
examples.english: Hand all the materials to the office.

全都.meaning: all (of them); without exception: 大家全都到了, 全都同意

examples.hanzi: 客人全都在两点前到了。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén quándōu zài liǎng diǎn qián dào le.
examples.english: The guests had all arrived by two.

全球.meaning: the whole world; global: 全球化, 全球气候, 遍布全球

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的产品销往全球。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn xiāo wǎng quánqiú.
examples.english: This company's products sell worldwide.

全身.meaning: the whole body: 全身无力, 全身湿透了

examples.hanzi: 淋了雨, 他全身都湿透了。
examples.pinyin: Lín le yǔ, tā quánshēn dōu shī tòu le.
examples.english: Caught in the rain, he was soaked through.

区别.meaning: difference; distinction: 有什么区别, 两者之间的区别

examples.hanzi: '二'和'两'的区别是什么？
examples.pinyin: 'èr' hé 'liǎng' de qūbié shì shénme?
examples.english: What is the difference between 二 and 两?

区别.meaning: to distinguish; to differentiate: 区别对待, 很难区别开来

examples.hanzi: 双胞胎的性格很容易区别开来。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngbāotāi de xìnggé hěn róngyì qūbié kāilai.
examples.english: The twins' personalities are easy to tell apart.

取得.meaning: to obtain; to achieve (success, progress, a degree — formal collocation): 取得好成绩, 取得进步, 取得资格

examples.hanzi: 经过努力, 他取得了博士学位。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì, tā qǔdé le bóshì xuéwèi.
examples.english: Through effort he obtained his doctorate.

却.meaning: but; yet; however (adverb of contrast within the sentence, after subject): 他很聪明, 却不怎么努力

examples.hanzi: 天气很冷, 他却穿得很单薄。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn lěng, tā què chuān de hěn dānbó.
examples.english: It's very cold, yet he wears thin clothes.

缺.meaning: to lack; to be short of; to be missing: 缺钱, 缺人手, 缺了一页

examples.hanzi: 餐厅正缺人手, 你愿意来吗?
examples.pinyin: Cāntīng zhèng quē rénshǒu, nǐ yuànyì lái ma?
examples.english: The restaurant is short-staffed — would you come?

缺.meaning: deficient (of a flaw): 缺点, 缺陷 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 这款产品的设计还有不少缺陷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn de shèjì hái yǒu bùshǎo quēxiàn.
examples.english: This product's design still has quite a few flaws.

缺点.meaning: shortcoming; weakness; fault: 有很多缺点, 改正缺点

examples.hanzi: 每个人都有缺点, 关键是肯不肯改。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu quēdiǎn, guānjiàn shì kěn bu kěn gǎi.
examples.english: Everyone has faults; the key is whether you'll change.

缺少.meaning: to lack; to be wanting in: 缺少经验, 缺少资金

examples.hanzi: 他的失败主要是因为缺少经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shībài zhǔyào shì yīnwèi quēshǎo jīngyàn.
examples.english: His failure was mainly from lacking experience.

确实.meaning: indeed; really: 确实很难, 他确实来了

examples.hanzi: 这里的环境确实不错, 我没骗你。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng quèshí búcuò, wǒ méi piàn nǐ.
examples.english: The environment here really is nice — I'm not deceiving you.

examples.hanzi: 这个消息确实, 是官方发布的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi quèshí, shì guānfāng fābù de.
examples.english: This news is confirmed — it was officially released.

取消.meaning: to cancel; to call off: 取消会议, 取消航班

examples.hanzi: 因为台风, 今天的航班全部取消了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi táifēng, jīntiān de hángbān quánbù qǔxiāo le.
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, today's flights were all cancelled.

然而.meaning: however; nevertheless (written, sentence-initial contrast): 他很努力, 然而成绩并不好

examples.hanzi: 他做了充分准备, 然而还是失败了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò le chōngfèn zhǔnbèi, rán'ér háishì shībài le.
examples.english: He prepared thoroughly, yet still failed.

热闹.meaning: bustling; lively: 街上很热闹, 热闹的春节

examples.hanzi: 除夕夜的家家户户都很热闹。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī yè de jiājiā hùhù dōu hěn rènao.
examples.english: Every household is bustling on New Year's Eve.

热闹.meaning: to liven up: 凑热闹 join in the fun; 看热闹 watch the excitement

examples.hanzi: 别去凑那个热闹, 好好在家复习。
examples.pinyin: Bié qù còu nàge rènao, hǎohao zài jiā fùxí.
examples.english: Don't go join that excitement — study at home.

仍.meaning: still; yet (formal short form of 仍然): 仍需努力, 仍有问题

examples.hanzi: 问题仍没有解决, 大家都很着急。
examples.pinyin: Wèntí réng méiyǒu jiějué, dàjiā dōu hěn zháojí.
examples.english: The problem still isn't solved and everyone's anxious.

扔.meaning: to throw; to toss: 扔垃圾, 扔掉, 扔给我

examples.hanzi: 垃圾请扔进垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: Lājī qǐng rēng jìn lājī tǒng.
examples.english: Please throw trash into the bin.

扔.meaning: to abandon; to discard (扔下孩子不管)

examples.hanzi: 他扔下家里的一切出国了。
examples.pinyin: Tā rēng xià jiā li de yīqiè chūguó le.
examples.english: He abandoned everything at home and went abroad.

仍然.meaning: still; yet (a bit more formal than 还是): 他仍然记得, 仍然存在问题

examples.hanzi: 十年不见, 他仍然记得我的名字。
examples.pinyin: Shí nián bù jiàn, tā réngrán jìde wǒ de míngzi.
examples.english: After ten years he still remembers my name.

任何.meaning: any; whatever (usually in negatives, questions, or conditionals): 任何问题, 任何人都不能进

examples.hanzi: 任何困难都挡不住他学习的热情。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé kùnnan dōu dǎng bu zhù tā xuéxí de rèqíng.
examples.english: No difficulty can hold back his eagerness to learn.

人生.meaning: life (the course of a human life, philosophical): 人生观, 漫长的人生, 人生经历

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行让他对人生有了新的看法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng tā duì rénshēng yǒu le xīn de kànfǎ.
examples.english: This trip gave him a new outlook on life.

人数.meaning: number of people: 参加人数, 控制人数

examples.hanzi: 参加人数超过了组织者的预期。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā rénshù chāoguò le zǔzhīzhě de yùqī.
examples.english: Participation exceeded the organizers' expectations.

任务.meaning: task; mission; assignment: 完成任务, 一项任务, 工作任务

examples.hanzi: 他提前一天完成了任务。
examples.pinyin: Tā tíqián yī tiān wánchéng le rènwu.
examples.english: He finished the task a day early.

人员.meaning: personnel; staff (collective, formal): 工作人员, 管理人员, 人员安排

examples.hanzi: 非工作人员不能进入机房。
examples.pinyin: Fēi gōngzuò rényuán bù néng jìnrù jīfáng.
examples.english: Non-staff may not enter the server room.

日常.meaning: everyday; daily; day-to-day: 日常生活, 日常工作

examples.hanzi: 汉语已经成了他的日常语言。
examples.pinyin: Hànyǔ yǐjīng chéng le tā de rìcháng yǔyán.
examples.english: Chinese has become his everyday language.

日记.meaning: diary; journal: 写日记, 日记本

examples.hanzi: 她坚持写了十年日记。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiānchí xiě le shí nián rìjì.
examples.english: She has kept a diary for ten years.

日期.meaning: date (on a calendar/document): 具体日期, 出生日期, 日期和地点

examples.hanzi: 请在表格里写清日期和地点。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé li xiě qīng rìqī hé dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Write the date and place clearly in the form.

日子.meaning: day(s); time (in general): 结婚的日子, 这段日子, 日子过得很快

examples.hanzi: 退休后, 老两口的日子过得很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu, lǎo liǎng kǒu de rìzi guò de hěn shūfu.
examples.english: After retiring, the old couple lives comfortably.

日子.meaning: life; livelihood: 日子越过越好, 过日子

examples.hanzi: 这几年家里的日子越过越好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián jiā li de rìzi yuè guò yuè hǎo.
examples.english: These years the family's life keeps getting better.

入.meaning: to enter; to join (formal/bound, vs 进 colloquial): 入学, 入境, 收入, 加入 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 新生九月入学, 请提前准备好材料。
examples.pinyin: Xīnshēng jiǔ yuè rùxué, qǐng tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo cáiliào.
examples.english: New students enroll in September — prepare materials early.

入口.meaning: entrance; entry (vs 出口 exit): 入口在哪边?

examples.hanzi: 入口在建筑的北边。
examples.pinyin: Rùkǒu zài jiànzhù de běi bian.
examples.english: The entrance is on the north side of the building.

入口.meaning: to import; import (trade): 入口商品 — Taiwan/finance usage; Mainland says 进口

examples.hanzi: 这批入口商品经过了严格检验。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī rùkǒu shāngpǐn jīngguò le yángé jiǎnyàn.
examples.english: This batch of imported goods passed strict inspection.

入学.meaning: to enter a school; enrollment: 入学考试, 入学通知, 九月入学

examples.hanzi: 孩子到了入学年龄就该上学了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi dào le rùxué niánlíng jiù gāi shàngxué le.
examples.english: When a child reaches school age, they should start school.

入住.meaning: to check in (to a hotel): 入住时间, 入住酒店

examples.hanzi: 下午三点以后才能办理入住。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐhòu cái néng bànlǐ rùzhù.
examples.english: Check-in is only after 3 p.m.

散步.meaning: to take a walk (离合: 散了会儿步): 去公园散步, 饭后散步

examples.hanzi: 晚饭后, 爷爷去河边散步了。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu, yéye qù hé biān sànbù le.
examples.english: After dinner Grandpa went for a walk by the river.

扫码.meaning: to scan a QR code: 扫码支付, 扫码点餐

examples.hanzi: 请在手机上扫码付款。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài shǒujī shang sǎo mǎ fùkuǎn.
examples.english: Please scan the QR code on your phone to pay.

森林.meaning: forest: 一片森林, 保护森林

examples.hanzi: 大火烧毁了三万亩森林。
examples.pinyin: Dà huǒ shāohuǐ le sān wàn mǔ sēnlín.
examples.english: The fire destroyed thirty thousand mu of forest.

商量.meaning: to discuss; to talk over; to consult: 商量一下, 有事好商量

examples.hanzi: 这件事得和家里人商量一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì děi hé jiā li rén shāngliang yīxià.
examples.english: This matter needs discussing with the family.

上门.meaning: to visit someone's home (to provide a service or make a call): 上门服务, 上门维修

examples.hanzi: 店里提供免费上门维修服务。
examples.pinyin: Diàn li tígōng miǎnfèi shàngmén wéixiū fúwù.
examples.english: The store offers free at-home repair service.

上门.meaning: to shut the door (of a shop) permanently (上门板) — dated

examples.hanzi: 生意不好, 那家老店终于上门了。
examples.pinyin: Shēngyi bù hǎo, nà jiā lǎo diàn zhōngyú shàngmén le.
examples.english: Business was bad and that old shop finally closed for good.

商品.meaning: commodity; goods (merchandise): 商品价格, 出口商品, 网上商品

examples.hanzi: 货架上的商品摆放得整整齐齐。
examples.pinyin: Huòjià shang de shāngpǐn bǎifàng de zhěngzhěng qíqí.
examples.english: Goods on the shelves are arranged neatly.

伤心.meaning: sad; heartbroken: 很伤心, 伤心地哭了

examples.hanzi: 小狗丢了, 妹妹伤心地哭了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu diū le, mèimei shāngxīn de kū le.
examples.english: The puppy was lost and my little sister cried sadly.

稍.meaning: slightly; a little (formal; must precede 稍微-like use: 稍等 wait a moment, 稍微): 稍等一下, 稍微慢一点

examples.hanzi: 请稍等, 我马上就来。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shāo děng, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.english: Please wait a moment — I'll be right there.

少见.meaning: rare; seldom seen: 很少见, 少见的场面

examples.hanzi: 这么大的雪在南方很少见。
examples.pinyin: Zhème dà de xuě zài nánfāng hěn shǎojiàn.
examples.english: Snow this heavy is rare in the south.

少量.meaning: a small amount: 少量的盐, 少量多次

examples.hanzi: 炒这道菜只需要少量的油。
examples.pinyin: Chǎo zhè dào cài zhǐ xūyào shǎoliàng de yóu.
examples.english: This dish needs only a small amount of oil.

少年.meaning: teenager; juvenile (roughly 10–16): 少年儿童, 青少年

examples.hanzi: 少年的他就开始帮家里干活了。
examples.pinyin: Shàonián de tā jiù kāishǐ bāng jiā li gànhuó le.
examples.english: In his early teens he already helped with household work.

少年.meaning: young person (poetic/archaic: 少年壮志): 想起少年时代

examples.hanzi: 提起少年时代, 他总有说不完的话。
examples.pinyin: Tí qǐ shàonián shídài, tā zǒng yǒu shuō bu wán de huà.
examples.english: Mention his boyhood and he has endless stories.

少数.meaning: minority (small number, vs 多数): 少数人, 占少数, 少数民族

examples.hanzi: 只有少数人反对这个计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén fǎnduì zhège jìhuà.
examples.english: Only a minority oppose this plan.

稍微.meaning: slightly; a bit (稍微 + verb/adjective + 一点/一些): 稍微等一下, 稍微贵一点儿

examples.hanzi: 这道菜稍微有点儿辣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shāowēi yǒudiǎnr là.
examples.english: This dish is slightly spicy.

社会.meaning: society: 社会问题, 社会科学, 走向社会

examples.hanzi: 大学生应该多参加社会活动。
examples.pinyin: Dàxuéshēng yīnggāi duō cānjiā shèhuì huódòng.
examples.english: University students should take part in more social activities.

身.meaning: body: 身上, 全身, 身体 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 他身上总是带着一本书。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēn shang zǒng shì dàizhe yī běn shū.
examples.english: He always carries a book on him.

身.meaning: measure word for sets of clothes: 一身新衣服

examples.hanzi: 他换了一身干净的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn le yī shēn gānjìng de yīfu.
examples.english: He changed into a clean set of clothes.

身.meaning: one's personal (status/position): 身份, 出身, 献身 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 他不隐瞒自己的出身。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù yǐnhuì zìjǐ de chūshēn.
examples.english: He doesn't hide his family background.

深.meaning: deep (water, color, meaning): 河水很深, 颜色深, 含义很深

examples.hanzi: 这个湖最深处有五十米。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hú zuì shēn chù yǒu wǔshí mǐ.
examples.english: This lake is fifty meters at its deepest.

深.meaning: deep (feeling, relationship, night): 感情深, 夜深了, 印象深

examples.hanzi: 我们十年的交情很深。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shí nián de jiāoqíng hěn shēn.
examples.english: Our ten-year friendship runs deep.

深.meaning: difficult; profound (高深, 深奥): 道理很深

examples.hanzi: 这本哲学书的道理很深, 我看了三遍才懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhéxué shū de dàolǐ hěn shēn, wǒ kàn le sān biàn cái dǒng.
examples.english: This philosophy book's reasoning is profound — it took me three reads.

身份证.meaning: ID card; identity card: 身份证号, 带身份证

examples.hanzi: 住酒店要出示身份证。
examples.pinyin: Zhù jiǔdiàn yào chūshì shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: You must show your ID card to stay at a hotel.

剩.meaning: to be left over; to remain: 还剩十分钟, 剩下不少菜

examples.hanzi: 聚餐结束后, 桌上剩了不少菜。
examples.pinyin: Jùcān jiéshù hòu, zhuō shang shèng le bùshǎo cài.
examples.english: After the dinner, quite a lot of food was left over.

省1.meaning: province: 广东省, 省会, 全国各省

examples.hanzi: 广东是中国人口最多的省。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngdōng shì Zhōngguó rénkǒu zuì duō de shěng.
examples.english: Guangdong is China's most populous province.

省1.meaning: to save; to economize (省时间, 省钱): 省了不少力气

examples.hanzi: 自己做既省时间又省钱。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò jì shěng shíjiān yòu shěng qián.
examples.english: Doing it yourself saves both time and money.

生1.meaning: to be born: 生于1990年, 生在上海

examples.hanzi: 他生于一个普通的农民家庭。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēng yú yī ge pǔtōng de nóngmín jiātíng.
examples.english: He was born into an ordinary farming family.

生1.meaning: to give birth to: 她生了个孩子, 生病 sense in compounds

examples.hanzi: 她去年生了个女儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián shēng le ge nǚ'ér.
examples.english: She gave birth to a daughter last year.

生1.meaning: to produce; to grow (发生, 产生): compounds

examples.hanzi: 两国之间发生了一件大事。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó zhījiān fāshēng le yī jiàn dàshì.
examples.english: A major event occurred between the two countries.

生1.meaning: raw; unripe; unfamiliar: 生肉, 生词 new word, 陌生人 stranger

examples.hanzi: 我是南方人, 米饭吃不惯生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì nánfāng rén, mǐfàn chī bu guàn shēng de.
examples.english: I'm a southerner; I can't get used to undercooked rice.

生2.meaning: life (性命, 生活 senses — bound: 生命, 一生, 医生, 学生): compounds only

examples.hanzi: 医生的天职是救死扶伤, 珍惜每一个生命。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de tiānzhí shì jiù sǐ fú shāng, zhēnxī měi yī ge shēngmìng.
examples.english: A doctor's calling is to save lives and treasure every life.

生命.meaning: life (vital force, animate existence): 生命危险, 珍惜生命, 生命力

examples.hanzi: 医生把病人从死亡线上抢救回了生命。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng bǎ bìngrén cóng sǐwáng xiàn shang qiǎngjiù huí le shēngmìng.
examples.english: The doctors pulled the patient back from death's door.

生意.meaning: business; trade: 做生意, 生意兴隆, 生意人

examples.hanzi: 这家小店的生意越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de shēngyi yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.english: This little shop's business is getting better and better.

申请.meaning: to apply for: 申请签证, 申请工作

examples.hanzi: 他向三所大学提交了申请。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng sān suǒ dàxué tíjiāo le shēnqǐng.
examples.english: He submitted applications to three universities.

申请.meaning: application: 申请表, 递交申请

examples.hanzi: 申请表要填完整再交。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng biǎo yào tián wánzhěng zài jiāo.
examples.english: Fill the application form completely before submitting.

甚至.meaning: even; so much so that (escalating emphasis): 甚至他的父母也不知道; 甚至于

examples.hanzi: 他忙得甚至连周末都在加班。
examples.pinyin: Tā máng de shènzhì lián zhōumò dōu zài jiābān.
examples.english: He's so busy he even works overtime on weekends.

摄氏度.meaning: degree Celsius (°C): 零下五摄氏度, 三十摄氏度

examples.hanzi: 今天最高气温三十五摄氏度。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zuì gāo qìwēn sānshíwǔ shèshìdù.
examples.english: Today's high is 35 degrees Celsius.

使.meaning: to make; to cause; to enable (使 + object + verb/adjective, formal causative): 使人惊讶, 使大家放心

examples.hanzi: 这部电影使很多人想起了童年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shǐ hěn duō rén xiǎng qǐ le tóngnián.
examples.english: This film made many people think of their childhood.

使.meaning: to use; to employ (使用 sense, formal): 使不上力 — archaic-leaning

examples.hanzi: 这些老工具早使不动了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǎo gōngjù zǎo shǐ bu dòng le.
examples.english: These old tools have long been unusable.

失败.meaning: to fail; to be defeated: 实验失败了, 失败而归

examples.hanzi: 第一次创业失败了, 他又从头开始。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì chuàngyè shībài le, tā yòu cóngtóu kāishǐ.
examples.english: His first startup failed and he started over from scratch.

失败.meaning: failure: 失败是成功之母, 从失败中学习

examples.hanzi: 失败是成功之母。
examples.pinyin: Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ.
examples.english: Failure is the mother of success.

市场.meaning: market (economy); marketplace: 超级市场, 金融市场, 市场经济

examples.hanzi: 清晨的菜市场人声鼎沸。
examples.pinyin: Qīngchén de cài shìchǎng rénshēng dìngfèi.
examples.english: The wet market is buzzing with voices in the early morning.

十分.meaning: very; fully; completely (formal intensifier): 十分感谢, 十分重要

examples.hanzi: 对大家的帮助, 我十分感谢。
examples.pinyin: Duì dàjiā de bāngzhù, wǒ shífēn gǎnxiè.
examples.english: I'm very grateful for everyone's help.

是否.meaning: whether or not (formal, in embedded questions): 是否能来还不确定; 请说明原因

examples.hanzi: 是否能按时完成还不确定。
examples.pinyin: Shìfǒu néng ànshí wánchéng hái bù quèdìng.
examples.english: Whether it can be finished on time is still uncertain.

师傅.meaning: master (of a craft); polite address to a skilled worker/driver: 师傅, 请问去火车站怎么走?

examples.hanzi: 师傅, 麻烦去火车站。
examples.pinyin: Shīfu, máfan qù huǒchēzhàn.
examples.english: Driver, to the train station, please.

使馆.meaning: embassy (short for 大使馆): 英国使馆, 使馆区

examples.hanzi: 他的签证要在驻华使馆办理。
examples.pinyin: Tā de qiānzhèng yào zài zhù Huá shǐguǎn bànlǐ.
examples.english: His visa must be processed at the embassy in China.

near_synonyms.difference: 适合 is a verb taking an object (适合儿童); 合适 is an adjective predicating of the thing (这件衣服很合适)

适合.meaning: to suit; to be suitable for: 适合儿童, 这本书很适合你

examples.hanzi: 这本书很适合初学者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn shìhé chūxuézhě.
examples.english: This book is well suited to beginners.

实际.meaning: reality; practice: 从实际出发, 理论联系实际

examples.hanzi: 这个办法听起来好, 但从实际出发行不通。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ tīng qǐlai hǎo, dàn cóng shíjì chūfā xíng bu tōng.
examples.english: This method sounds good but won't work starting from reality.

实际.meaning: actual; practical; real: 实际情况, 实际行动, 很实际的人

examples.hanzi: 别空想, 要采取实际行动。
examples.pinyin: Bié kōngxiǎng, yào cǎiqǔ shíjì xíngdòng.
examples.english: Stop daydreaming — take practical action.

世纪.meaning: century: 二十一世纪, 上个世纪

examples.hanzi: 这座古城建于十五世纪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ chéng jiàn yú shíwǔ shìjì.
examples.english: This ancient city was built in the fifteenth century.

时间表.meaning: timetable; schedule: 列车时间表, 制定时间表

examples.hanzi: 请按照时间表安排每天的工作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào shíjiānbiǎo ānpái měitiān de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Arrange each day's work according to the timetable.

实际上.meaning: in fact; actually; in reality: 实际上他早就知道了

examples.hanzi: 看起来很贵, 实际上打折后不到一百块。
examples.pinyin: Kàn qǐlai hěn guì, shíjìshang dǎ zhé hòu bù dào yībǎi kuài.
examples.english: It looks expensive, but actually after the discount it's under 100.

食品.meaning: food (as produced/sold goods, formal vs 食物): 食品安全, 绿色食品, 快餐食品

examples.hanzi: 这家店的食品都有安全标志。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shípǐn dōu yǒu ānquān biāozhì.
examples.english: All the food in this shop carries safety marks.

视频.meaning: video: 看视频, 视频通话, 上传视频

examples.hanzi: 他把旅行的视频发到了网上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǚxíng de shìpín fā dào le wǎng shang.
examples.english: He posted his travel videos online.

市区.meaning: city proper; urban district (vs 郊区 suburbs): 住在市区, 市区交通

examples.hanzi: 他从市区搬到郊区, 通勤时间变长了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng shìqū bān dào jiāoqū, tōngqín shíjiān biàn cháng le.
examples.english: He moved from the city proper to the suburbs; his commute got longer.

失去.meaning: to lose; to be deprived of: 失去信心, 失去联系, 失去机会

examples.hanzi: 他因为那次事故失去了左腿。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi nà cì shìgù shīqù le zuǒ tuǐ.
examples.english: He lost his left leg in that accident.

师生.meaning: teachers and students (collective): 师生关系, 全校师生

examples.hanzi: 地震时, 全校师生有序撤离了教学楼。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí, quán xiào shīshēng yǒuxù chèlí le jiàoxué lóu.
examples.english: During the earthquake the whole school's teachers and students evacuated in order.

食堂.meaning: (institutional) dining hall; canteen: 学校食堂, 员工食堂

examples.hanzi: 大学食堂的饭菜既便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué shítáng de fàncài jì piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: University cafeteria food is cheap and tasty.

试题.meaning: exam question; test item: 高考试题, 试题答案

examples.hanzi: 今年的高考试题比去年难。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de gāokǎo shìtí bǐ qùnián nán.
examples.english: This year's gaokao questions were harder than last year's.

失望.meaning: disappointed: 很失望, 令人失望

examples.hanzi: 他又一次让父母失望了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu yī cì ràng fùmǔ shīwàng le.
examples.english: He disappointed his parents once again.

失望.meaning: to be disappointed (at/in): 对他失望, 失望地摇摇头

examples.hanzi: 她对这部电影很失望。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè bù diànyǐng hěn shīwàng.
examples.english: She was very disappointed in this film.

食物.meaning: food (general term for things eaten): 食物中毒, 健康食物, 准备食物

examples.hanzi: 冰箱里的食物要尽快吃完。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng li de shíwù yào jǐnkuài chī wán.
examples.english: The food in the fridge should be eaten soon.

适应.meaning: to adapt to; to adjust to; to suit: 适应环境, 适应气候, 很快适应了

examples.hanzi: 新环境适应了半个月, 他才安下心来。
examples.pinyin: Xīn huánjìng shìyìng le bàn ge yuè, tā cái ān xià xīn lái.
examples.english: It took half a month to adapt to the new environment before he settled.

使用.meaning: to use; to make use of (formal, of tools/equipment): 使用说明, 使用手机支付

examples.hanzi: 图书馆的电脑仅供学习使用。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn de diànnǎo jǐn gòng xuéxí shǐyòng.
examples.english: Library computers are for study use only.

实在.meaning: really; truly (colloquial emphasis): 实在太累了, 实在没办法

examples.hanzi: 今天实在太热了, 一动就出汗。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shízài tài rè le, yī dòng jiù chū hàn.
examples.english: Today is really too hot — any movement brings sweat.

实在.meaning: honest; sincere; dependable: 这个人很实在, 实在话

examples.hanzi: 他是个实在人, 从不说假话。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge shízài rén, cóng bù shuō jiǎ huà.
examples.english: He's an honest man and never lies.

十字路口.meaning: crossroads; intersection: 在十字路口向左转

examples.hanzi: 在十字路口往右转就到了。
examples.pinyin: Zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le.
examples.english: Turn right at the intersection and you're there.

首.meaning: head (body, formal/literary): 首相, 首脑 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 各国的政府首脑出席了会议。
examples.pinyin: Gè guó de zhèngfǔ shǒunǎo chūxí le huìyì.
examples.english: The heads of government of various countries attended the conference.

首.meaning: first (首席, 首先): mainly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他是乐队首席小提琴手。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yuèduì shǒuxí xiǎotíqín shǒu.
examples.english: He is the orchestra's first-chair violinist.

首.meaning: measure word for poems/songs: 一首诗, 两首歌

examples.hanzi: 他会唱二十多首歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng èrshí duō shǒu gē.
examples.english: He can sing twenty-some songs.

受不了.meaning: can't stand; can't bear: 热得受不了, 我受不了他了

examples.hanzi: 夏天的地铁里没有空调, 热得让人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de dìtiě li méiyǒu kōngtiáo, rè de ràng rén shòu bu liǎo.
examples.english: The summer metro without AC is unbearably hot.

首都.meaning: capital (city): 北京是中国的首都

examples.hanzi: 北京是中国的首都。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.
examples.english: Beijing is China's capital.

收费.meaning: to charge a fee: 这个停车场收费, 收费合理

examples.hanzi: 这个停车场每小时收费五块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tíngchēchǎng měi xiǎoshí shōufèi wǔ kuài qián.
examples.english: This parking lot charges five yuan per hour.

收费.meaning: fee-charging (vs 免费 free): 收费服务

examples.hanzi: 这些服务是收费的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē fúwù shì shōufèi de.
examples.english: These services are fee-charging.

examples.hanzi: 售票员提醒大家买票。
examples.pinyin: Shòupiàoyuán tíxǐng dàjiā mǎi piào.
examples.english: The conductor reminded everyone to buy tickets.

收入.meaning: income; revenue: 月收入, 收入很高, 国民收入

examples.hanzi: 他的收入虽然不高, 但生活很充实。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shōurù suīrán bù gāo, dàn shēnghuó hěn chōngshí.
examples.english: His income isn't high, but his life is fulfilling.

收入.meaning: to take in; to include (收入词典 include in a dictionary) — formal

examples.hanzi: 这个词被收入了最新版词典。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí bèi shōurù le zuì xīn bǎn cídiǎn.
examples.english: This word was included in the newest dictionary edition.

受伤.meaning: to be injured; injured: 受伤了, 受伤严重, 腿受了伤

examples.hanzi: 他打篮球时受伤了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ lánqiú shí shòushāng le.
examples.english: He got injured playing basketball.

收拾.meaning: to put in order; to tidy up: 收拾房间, 收拾东西

examples.hanzi: 她花了整个下午收拾房间。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le zhěngge xiàwǔ shōushi fángjiān.
examples.english: She spent the whole afternoon tidying the room.

收拾.meaning: to deal with; to fix (a person/problem) (colloquial): 收拾他, 我来收拾这个局面

examples.hanzi: 这个麻烦就交给我来收拾吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège máfan jiù jiāo gěi wǒ lái shōushi ba.
examples.english: Leave this mess for me to sort out.

收听.meaning: to listen to (radio broadcasts — fixed collocation): 收听广播, 收听新闻

examples.hanzi: 爷爷每天早上收听新闻广播。
examples.pinyin: Yéye měitiān zǎoshang shōutīng xīnwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: Grandpa listens to the news broadcast every morning.

首先.meaning: first; firstly (in enumerations, often paired with 其次/然后): 首先, 我要感谢大家

examples.hanzi: 首先, 我要感谢大家的支持。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒ yào gǎnxiè dàjiā de zhīchí.
examples.english: First of all, I want to thank everyone for their support.

首先.meaning: first of all; above all (priority): 首先要保证安全

examples.hanzi: 学外语首先要过发音关。
examples.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ shǒuxiān yào guò fāyīn guān.
examples.english: In learning a foreign language, first pass the pronunciation hurdle.

数.meaning: number; figure: 人数, 数量, 分数 — semi-bound

examples.hanzi: 这些年出国留学的人数增加了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián chūguó liúxué de rénshù zēngjiā le.
examples.english: The number of people studying abroad has increased in recent years.

数.meaning: to count: 数一数, 数钱, 数了三遍

examples.hanzi: 他数了数, 一共来了三十个人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǔ le shǔ, yīgòng lái le sānshí ge rén.
examples.english: He counted — thirty people came in all.

examples.hanzi: 他上学时数理化都很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngxué shí shù-lǐ-huà dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.english: At school he was good at math, physics and chemistry.

输.meaning: to lose (a game, match): 比赛输了, 输了三场

examples.hanzi: 虽然输了比赛, 但队员们并不气馁。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán shū le bǐsài, dàn duìyuánmen bìng bù qìněi.
examples.english: Though they lost the match, the players weren't discouraged.

输.meaning: to transport; to transmit (输出, 输电, 输血): compounds

examples.hanzi: 西电东输工程把电力送到东部。
examples.pinyin: Xī diàn dōng shū gōngchéng bǎ diànlì sòng dào dōngbù.
examples.english: The West-to-East power transmission project sends electricity east.

熟.meaning: cooked; ripe (vs 生 raw): 饭熟了, 熟香蕉

examples.hanzi: 米饭还没熟, 再等十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Mǐfàn hái méi shú, zài děng shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The rice isn't done yet — ten more minutes.

熟.meaning: familiar; well-known: 熟人, 对这条路很熟, 熟练

examples.hanzi: 这条路我走熟了, 闭着眼都能到家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ zǒu shú le, bìzhe yǎn dōu néng dào jiā.
examples.english: I know this road so well I could get home blindfolded.

熟.meaning: colloquial variant reading of shú in casual speech (熟了): non-standard in writing

examples.hanzi: 饭熟了没有? ——熟了熟了!
examples.pinyin: Fàn shóu le méiyǒu? ——Shóu le shóu le!
examples.english: Is the rice done? — Done, done!

帅.meaning: handsome (of men); cool: 他很帅, 长得帅, 帅哥

examples.hanzi: 他穿上西装显得特别帅。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuān shang xīzhuāng xiǎnde tèbié shuài.
examples.english: He looks especially handsome in a suit.

暑假.meaning: summer vacation: 放暑假, 暑假作业, 暑假去旅行

examples.hanzi: 暑假他打了两个月工, 挣了学费。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià tā dǎ le liǎng ge yuè gōng, zhèng le xuéfèi.
examples.english: Over summer break he worked two months and earned tuition.

数量.meaning: quantity; amount: 数量有限, 数量和质量

examples.hanzi: 报名的数量超过了预期, 加开了一个班。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng de shùliàng chāoguò le yùqī, jiā kāi le yī ge bān.
examples.english: Registrations exceeded expectations, so another class was opened.

树林.meaning: woods; grove: 一片树林, 树林里

examples.hanzi: 清晨的树林里到处是鸟叫声。
examples.pinyin: Qīngchén de shùlín li dàochù shì niǎo jiào shēng.
examples.english: The woods are full of birdsong in the early morning.

顺便.meaning: in passing; conveniently (doing something on the way while at it): 顺便帮我买张票, 顺便说一句

examples.hanzi: 你去超市顺便帮我买瓶酱油。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chāoshì shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi píng jiàngyóu.
examples.english: Since you're going to the store, buy me a bottle of soy sauce while at it.

顺利.meaning: smooth; without a hitch: 一切顺利, 顺利通过考试, 顺利完成

examples.hanzi: 手续办得很顺利, 半小时就搞定了。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuxù bàn de hěn shùnlì, bàn xiǎoshí jiù gǎodìng le.
examples.english: The paperwork went smoothly — done in half an hour.

顺序.meaning: order; sequence: 按顺序排队, 说话的顺序

examples.hanzi: 请大家按顺序上车。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā àn shùnxù shàng chē.
examples.english: Please board in order.

examples.hanzi: 程序按顺序执行每一步。
examples.pinyin: Chéngxù àn shùnxù zhíxíng měi yī bù.
examples.english: The program executes each step in order.

说法.meaning: way of saying something; formulation; version (of a story): 有不同的说法, 这种说法不对

examples.hanzi: 关于这件事有几种不同的说法。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú zhè jiàn shì yǒu jǐ zhǒng bùtóng de shuōfǎ.
examples.english: There are several different versions of this matter.

说法.meaning: argument; claim (民间有很多说法): variant tone, colloquial

examples.hanzi: 民间有很多关于这座桥的传说和说法。
examples.pinyin: Mínjiān yǒu hěn duō guānyú zhè zuò qiáo de chuánshuō hé shuōfa.
examples.english: There are many folk legends and claims about this bridge.

说明.meaning: to explain; to illustrate; to show: 说明理由, 充分说明, 说明问题

examples.hanzi: 这张图说明了地铁线路的走向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tú shuōmíng le dìtiě xiànlù de zǒuxiàng.
examples.english: This diagram explains the metro lines' routes.

说明.meaning: explanation; statement; manual: 产品说明, 使用说明书

examples.hanzi: 使用前请仔细阅读说明书。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng qián qǐng zǐxì yuèdú shuōmíngshū.
examples.english: Read the manual carefully before use.

说明书.meaning: (instruction) manual; user guide: 药品说明书, 看说明书

examples.hanzi: 药盒里有详细的说明书。
examples.pinyin: Yàohé li yǒu xiángxì de shuōmíngshū.
examples.english: There's a detailed instructions sheet inside the medicine box.

硕士.meaning: master's degree (holder): 硕士研究生, 读硕士, 硕士学位

examples.hanzi: 读完硕士, 她想接着读博士。
examples.pinyin: Dú wán shuòshì, tā xiǎng jiēzhe dú bóshì.
examples.english: After finishing her master's, she wants to go on to a PhD.

熟悉.meaning: to know well; to be familiar with: 熟悉环境, 熟悉业务

examples.hanzi: 他很快就熟悉了新工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù shúxī le xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: He quickly became familiar with the new job.

熟悉.meaning: familiar: 熟悉的味道, 对这里很熟悉 — usually 陌生 is the opposite

examples.hanzi: 刚到新城市, 一切都不熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Gāng dào xīn chéngshì, yīqiè dōu bù shúxī.
examples.english: Newly arrived in the city, nothing is familiar yet.

数字.meaning: number; numeral (the written symbol): 阿拉伯数字, 数字4

examples.hanzi: 请把报告里的数字再核对一遍。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bàogào li de shùzì zài héduì yī biàn.
examples.english: Please double-check the figures in the report.

数字.meaning: digital (数字化 digitalization): 数字电视, 数字经济 — modern extension

examples.hanzi: 中国正在大力推进数字经济。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhèngzài dàlì tuījìn shùzì jīngjì.
examples.english: China is vigorously advancing the digital economy.

死.meaning: to die: 死了很多人, 他爷爷去年死了

examples.hanzi: 那场大火中死了很多消防员。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng dà huǒ zhōng sǐ le hěn duō xiāofángyuán.
examples.english: Many firefighters died in that great fire.

死.meaning: to death (extreme degree complement): 累死了, 难受死了, 高兴死了 — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 跑完马拉松, 我累死了。
examples.pinyin: Pǎo wán mǎlāsōng, wǒ lèi sǐ le.
examples.english: After the marathon I was dead tired.

死.meaning: dead; lifeless; fixed (死板): 死脑筋

examples.hanzi: 他的脑子太死, 一点儿不会变通。
examples.pinyin: Tā de nǎozi tài sǐ, yīdiǎnr bù huì biàntōng.
examples.english: His mind is too rigid — no flexibility at all.

算.meaning: to calculate; to compute: 算一算, 心算, 算账

examples.hanzi: 他心算很快, 不用计算器。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīnsuàn hěn kuài, bù yòng jìsuànqì.
examples.english: He calculates fast in his head — no calculator needed.

算.meaning: to count as; to be considered: 算你赢, 这不算什么, 他算是我的老师

examples.hanzi: 别吵了, 就算你说得对。
examples.pinyin: Bié chǎo le, jiù suàn nǐ shuō de duì.
examples.english: Stop arguing — fine, you're right.

算.meaning: (算了的 short use) forget it; let it go: 算了, 不去了

examples.hanzi: 算了, 这次就原谅他。
examples.pinyin: Suàn le, zhè cì jiù yuánliàng tā.
examples.english: Forget it — forgive him this time.

算.meaning: to plan; to suppose (打算, 就算 even if): mainly compounds

examples.hanzi: 就算下雨, 比赛也照常进行。
examples.pinyin: Jiù suàn xià yǔ, bǐsài yě zhàocháng jìnxíng.
examples.english: Even if it rains, the match goes on as usual.

酸.meaning: sour: 柠檬很酸, 酸甜

examples.hanzi: 柠檬太酸了, 我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Níngméng tài suān le, wǒ shòu bu liǎo.
examples.english: The lemon is too sour — I can't take it.

酸.meaning: aching; sore (muscles): 腿酸, 走得浑身酸痛

examples.hanzi: 爬完山, 腿酸了一个星期。
examples.pinyin: Pá wán shān, tuǐ suān le yī ge xīngqī.
examples.english: After the hike my legs ached for a week.

examples.hanzi: 想起那些年的辛苦, 她心里一酸。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐ nàxiē nián de xīnkǔ, tā xīnli yī suān.
examples.english: Remembering those hard years, her heart ached.

酸奶.meaning: yogurt: 一盒酸奶, 喝酸奶

examples.hanzi: 饭后一杯酸奶有助于消化。
examples.pinyin: Fàn hòu yī bēi suānnǎi yǒuzhù yú xiāohuà.
examples.english: A cup of yogurt after meals aids digestion.

速度.meaning: speed; velocity; rate: 速度很快, 提高速度, 车速速度限制

examples.hanzi: 他的阅读速度是每分钟三百字。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yuèdú sùdù shì měi fēnzhōng sānbǎi zì.
examples.english: His reading speed is 300 characters a minute.

随便.meaning: casual; informal; as one wishes: 随便聊聊, 穿得很随便

examples.hanzi: 都是自家做的菜, 随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Dōu shì zì jiā zuò de cài, suíbiàn chī.
examples.english: It's all home cooking — help yourself.

随便.meaning: as you like; feel free: 想吃什么随便点; 随便你

examples.hanzi: 周末想干什么随便你。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò xiǎng gàn shénme suíbiàn nǐ.
examples.english: On the weekend, do whatever you like.

随便.meaning: whatever; suit yourself (dismissive): ——去哪儿吃? ——随便

examples.hanzi: ——去哪儿吃? ——随便。
examples.pinyin: ——Qù nǎr chī? ——Suíbiàn.
examples.english: —Where shall we eat? —Whatever.

随着.meaning: along with; as (introduces a changing circumstance): 随着经济的发展, 随着时间的推移

examples.hanzi: 随着经济的发展, 人们的生活越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.english: As the economy develops, people's lives keep improving.

塑料.meaning: plastic: 塑料袋, 塑料瓶子

examples.hanzi: 请少用一次性塑料袋。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shǎo yòng yī cìxìng sùliào dài.
examples.english: Please use fewer disposable plastic bags.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷最疼这个小孙女。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zuì téng zhège xiǎo sūnnǚ.
examples.english: Grandpa dotes on this little granddaughter most.

examples.hanzi: 孙子一放假就往爷爷家跑。
examples.pinyin: Sūnzi yī fàngjià jiù wǎng yéye jiā pǎo.
examples.english: The grandson runs off to grandpa's as soon as vacation starts.

孙子.meaning: Sun Tzu (孙子兵法 The Art of War) — the ancient military strategist

examples.hanzi: 《孙子兵法》至今仍被广泛研究。
examples.pinyin: 《Sūnzǐ Bīngfǎ》 zhìjīn réng bèi guǎngfàn yánjiū.
examples.english: The Art of War is still widely studied today.

所有.meaning: all (modifying a noun: 所有人, 所有时间)

examples.hanzi: 所有的座位都坐满了。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu de zuòwèi dōu zuò mǎn le.
examples.english: All the seats are full.

所有.meaning: possession; ownership (所有权): 归国家所有

examples.hanzi: 这些资源归国家所有。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīyuán guī guójiā suǒyǒu.
examples.english: These resources are owned by the state.

台.meaning: measure word for machines, devices, performances: 一台电脑, 一台手术, 一台晚会

examples.hanzi: 他给家里买了一台新电视。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi jiā li mǎi le yī tái xīn diànshì.
examples.english: He bought a new TV for the family.

台.meaning: platform; stage; stand: 舞台, 站台, 讲台, 阳台 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 演员们在后台等着上台。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnyuánmen zài hòutái děngzhe shàng tái.
examples.english: The performers wait backstage to go on.

台.meaning: Taiwan (abbr.): 台风 typhoon; 台商

examples.hanzi: 台风每年夏天都影响东南沿海。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng měinián xiàtiān dōu yǐngxiǎng dōngnán yánhǎi.
examples.english: Typhoons affect the southeast coast every summer.

抬.meaning: to lift; to raise (head, hand, heavy things with others): 抬头, 抬手, 一起抬桌子

examples.hanzi: 大家一起把桌子抬进了教室。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yīqǐ bǎ zhuōzi tái jìn le jiàoshì.
examples.english: Together we carried the table into the classroom.

抬.meaning: to carry (two or more people): 两个人抬一个大箱子

examples.hanzi: 两个人才抬得动这个大箱子。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén cái tái de dòng zhège dà xiāngzi.
examples.english: It takes two people to carry this big box.

态度.meaning: attitude; manner (toward people or things): 服务态度好, 对学习的态度

examples.hanzi: 他对顾客的态度特别好。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gùkè de tàidù tèbié hǎo.
examples.english: His attitude toward customers is especially good.

抬头.meaning: to raise one's head: 抬头看了看天

examples.hanzi: 他抬头看了看天花板, 想了半天。
examples.pinyin: Tā táitóu kàn le kàn tiānhuābǎn, xiǎng le bàntiān.
examples.english: He looked up at the ceiling and thought for a long while.

抬头.meaning: (of the economy, prices) to rise;抬头 (inflation抬头): 通货膨胀抬头

examples.hanzi: 物价又有抬头的趋势。
examples.pinyin: Wùjià yòu yǒu táitóu de qūshì.
examples.english: Prices are showing an upward trend again.

弹.meaning: to play (a stringed or keyboard instrument): 弹钢琴, 弹吉他

examples.hanzi: 她会弹钢琴, 也会弹古筝。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tán gāngqín, yě huì tán gǔzhēng.
examples.english: She can play the piano and also the guzheng.

弹.meaning: bullet; ball; pellet: 子弹, 弹弓 — also bomb (导弹)

examples.hanzi: 战士们的子弹用完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhànshìmen de zǐdàn yòng wán le.
examples.english: The soldiers ran out of bullets.

谈.meaning: to talk; to discuss: 谈问题, 好好谈谈

examples.hanzi: 我们找个时间好好谈谈。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǎo ge shíjiān hǎohao tántán.
examples.english: Let's find time to have a good talk.

谈.meaning: to chat about; to have (a conversation/relationship): 谈了两个小时, 谈恋爱

examples.hanzi: 这两个年轻人已经谈了三年恋爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge niánqīngrén yǐjīng tán le sān nián liàn'ài.
examples.english: These two have been dating for three years.

趟.meaning: measure word for trips (round trips/visits): 去了一趟北京, 跑三趟

examples.hanzi: 为了这件事, 我跑了三趟。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhè jiàn shì, wǒ pǎo le sān tàng.
examples.english: For this matter I made three trips.

躺.meaning: to lie down; to recline (vs 躺 on back etc.): 躺在床上, 躺了一会儿

examples.hanzi: 他躺在床上看手机。
examples.pinyin: Tā tǎng zài chuáng shang kàn shǒujī.
examples.english: He lies on the bed looking at his phone.

汤.meaning: soup: 一碗汤, 做汤, 鸡汤

examples.hanzi: 妈妈做了一锅鸡汤。
examples.pinyin: Māma zuò le yī guō jī tāng.
examples.english: Mom made a pot of chicken soup.

讨论.meaning: to discuss: 讨论问题, 讨论了半天

examples.hanzi: 大家讨论了两个小时也没结果。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā tǎolùn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí yě méi jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Everyone discussed for two hours with no result.

examples.hanzi: 会议记录里写满了大家的讨论。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì jìlù li xiě mǎn le dàjiā de tǎolùn.
examples.english: The meeting minutes are full of everyone's discussion.

讨厌.meaning: to dislike; to be sick of: 讨厌下雨天, 我讨厌等车

examples.hanzi: 我最讨厌等人, 太浪费时间了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn děng rén, tài làngfèi shíjiān le.
examples.english: I hate waiting for people — such a waste of time.

讨厌.meaning: annoying; disagreeable: 真讨厌!; 讨厌的人

examples.hanzi: 蚊子真讨厌, 嗡嗡叫个不停。
examples.pinyin: Wénzi zhēn tǎoyàn, wēngwēng jiào ge bù tíng.
examples.english: Mosquitoes are so annoying, buzzing nonstop.

特点.meaning: characteristic; distinguishing feature: 中国菜的特点, 各有特点

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的特点是菜里不放味精。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tèdiǎn shì cài li bù fàng wèijīng.
examples.english: This restaurant's characteristic is no MSG in the food.

提.meaning: to lift; to carry (in hand): 提着一个袋子, 提起精神

examples.hanzi: 他提着两个大箱子出了门。
examples.pinyin: Tā tízhe liǎng ge dà xiāngzi chū le mén.
examples.english: He went out carrying two big suitcases.

提.meaning: to raise (a matter, question, opinion): 提意见, 提问题

examples.hanzi: 会上有人提了不同意见。
examples.pinyin: Huì shang yǒu rén tí le bùtóng yìjiàn.
examples.english: At the meeting someone raised a different opinion.

提.meaning: to mention (提到/提起): 别跟他提这件事

examples.hanzi: 别跟他提考试的事。
examples.pinyin: Bié gēn tā tí kǎoshì de shì.
examples.english: Don't mention the exam to him.

填写.meaning: to fill in (a form): 填写表格, 填写姓名

examples.hanzi: 请用黑色笔填写表格。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng yòng hēisè bǐ tiánxiě biǎogé.
examples.english: Please fill in the form with black pen.

条件.meaning: condition; requirement; qualification: 符合条件, 招聘条件

examples.hanzi: 这个工作的条件很不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò de tiáojiàn hěn búcuò.
examples.english: This job's conditions are quite good.

条件.meaning: circumstances; living conditions: 生活条件好, 条件有限

examples.hanzi: 山区的教学条件还很艰苦。
examples.pinyin: Shānqū de jiàoxué tiáojiàn hái hěn jiānkǔ.
examples.english: Teaching conditions in the mountains are still hard.

examples.hanzi: 英语老师讲解了条件从句的用法。
examples.pinyin: Yīngyǔ lǎoshī jiǎngjiě le tiáojiàn cóngjù de yòngfǎ.
examples.english: The English teacher explained the use of conditional clauses.

提出.meaning: to put forward; to raise (a proposal, question, opinion): 提出建议, 提出问题, 提出申请

examples.hanzi: 他向公司提出了辞职。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng gōngsī tí chū le cízhí.
examples.english: He submitted his resignation to the company.

提到.meaning: to mention; to bring up (also to rise to, of water levels): 他提到了你, 提到过几次

examples.hanzi: 他在报告中提到了这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàogào zhōng tídào le zhège wèntí.
examples.english: He mentioned this problem in the report.

提供.meaning: to provide; to offer; to supply: 提供帮助, 免费提供早餐

examples.hanzi: 酒店为客人提供免费早餐。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn wèi kèrén tígōng miǎnfèi zǎocān.
examples.english: The hotel provides guests free breakfast.

体检.meaning: (medical) checkup: 做体检, 入职体检, 每年体检一次

examples.hanzi: 公司每年组织员工体检。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měinián zǔzhī yuángōng tǐjiǎn.
examples.english: The company organizes staff checkups every year.

停.meaning: to stop; to halt: 停车, 停下来, 雨停了

examples.hanzi: 到了一站, 火车停了两分钟。
examples.pinyin: Dào le yī zhàn, huǒchē tíng le liǎng fēnzhōng.
examples.english: At one stop the train paused two minutes.

停.meaning: to park: 把车停在路边, 停一天

examples.hanzi: 他把车停在路边买了瓶水。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ chē tíng zài lù biān mǎi le píng shuǐ.
examples.english: He parked by the roadside and bought a bottle of water.

停.meaning: to stay; to settle (停学, 停留): compounds

examples.hanzi: 他在上海停留了三天。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Shànghǎi tíngliú le sān tiān.
examples.english: He stayed in Shanghai for three days.

停车.meaning: to park (a car); parking: 此处禁止停车, 停车场

examples.hanzi: 这里禁止停车。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jìnzhǐ tíngchē.
examples.english: No parking here.

停车场.meaning: parking lot; car park: 一个停车场, 地下停车场

examples.hanzi: 商场停车场的入口在东侧。
examples.pinyin: Shāngchǎng tíngchēchǎng de rùkǒu zài dōng cè.
examples.english: The mall parking lot entrance is on the east side.

听力.meaning: listening (comprehension skill, in language learning): 听力考试, 练习听力

examples.hanzi: 每天听广播可以练习听力。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān tīng guǎngbō kěyǐ liànxí tīnglì.
examples.english: Listening to the radio daily trains your listening.

停止.meaning: to stop; to cease (more formal than 停): 停止营业, 停止哭泣, 停止工作

examples.hanzi: 演出因大雨被迫停止。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchū yīn dà yǔ bèipò tíngzhǐ.
examples.english: The performance was forced to stop due to heavy rain.

听众.meaning: audience (of a broadcast); listeners: 听众来信, 吸引听众

examples.hanzi: 这档节目拥有千万听众。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dàng jiémù yōngyǒu qiānwàn tīngzhòng.
examples.english: This program has tens of millions of listeners.

提前.meaning: in advance; ahead of time: 提前完成, 提前三天

examples.hanzi: 他提前完成了任务。
examples.pinyin: Tā tíqián wánchéng le rènwu.
examples.english: He finished the task ahead of schedule.

提前.meaning: to move up (a schedule): 把会议提前到周一

examples.hanzi: 会议提前到了周一。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì tíqián dào le zhōuyī.
examples.english: The meeting was moved up to Monday.

体温.meaning: body temperature: 量体温, 体温升高

examples.hanzi: 护士给他量了体温。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi gěi tā liáng le tǐwēn.
examples.english: The nurse took his temperature.

提醒.meaning: to remind: 提醒我一下, 提醒大家注意

examples.hanzi: 谢谢你的提醒, 差点忘了。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de tíxǐng, chàdiǎnr wàng le.
examples.english: Thanks for the reminder — I nearly forgot.

体重.meaning: (body) weight: 体重增加, 减体重

examples.hanzi: 三个月的锻炼让他的体重减了五公斤。
examples.pinyin: Sān ge yuè de duànliàn ràng tā de tǐzhòng jiǎn le wǔ gōngjīn.
examples.english: Three months of exercise took five kilos off his weight.

痛.meaning: painful; sore: 头很痛, 伤口痛

examples.hanzi: 他的头很痛, 吃了片药就睡了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóu hěn tòng, chī le piàn yào jiù shuì le.
examples.english: His head hurt badly; he took a tablet and slept.

痛.meaning: bitterly; severely (痛哭, 痛改前非): compounds — formal

examples.hanzi: 听到消息, 她痛哭了一场。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào xiāoxi, tā tòngkū le yī chǎng.
examples.english: Hearing the news, she cried bitterly.

桶.meaning: bucket; barrel; pail (measure word too): 一桶水, 一个垃圾桶

examples.hanzi: 他提着一桶水去浇花。
examples.pinyin: Tā tízhe yī tǒng shuǐ qù jiāo huā.
examples.english: He carried a bucket of water to water the flowers.

通.meaning: to lead to; to go through: 这条路通向山顶; 通过, 交通

examples.hanzi: 这条隧道通车后, 两地距离缩短了一半。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo suìdào tōngchē hòu, liǎng dì jùlí suōduǎn le yī bàn.
examples.english: After the tunnel opened, the distance between the two places halved.

通.meaning: logical; smooth; open: 说得通, 不通情理 — formal uses

examples.hanzi: 你的解释说不通。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de jiěshì shuō bu tōng.
examples.english: Your explanation doesn't hold water.

通.meaning: measure word for phone calls, languages, actions: 打了一个电话…通电话; 英文精通几通 — mainly 电话 use

examples.hanzi: 今晚我们通了三次电话。
examples.pinyin: Jīn wǎn wǒmen tōng le sān cì diànhuà.
examples.english: We talked on the phone three times tonight.

通.meaning: (of counting actions) times through (通宵) — archaic

examples.hanzi: 为了赶工期, 他们连着通宵了两天。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎn gōngqī, tāmen liánzhe tōngxiāo le liǎng tiān.
examples.english: To meet the deadline they pulled all-nighters two days running.

通过.meaning: to pass (an exam, a resolution): 通过考试, 方案通过了

examples.hanzi: 他通过了驾照考试。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò le jiàzhào kǎoshì.
examples.english: He passed the driving test.

通过.meaning: by means of; through (a channel/method): 通过网络学习, 通过朋友介绍

examples.hanzi: 通过网络, 我们随时都能上课。
examples.pinyin: Tōngguò wǎngluò, wǒmen suíshí dōu néng shàng kè.
examples.english: Through the Internet we can attend class anytime.

童年.meaning: childhood: 童年的回忆, 快乐的童年

examples.hanzi: 童年的记忆总是最深刻的。
examples.pinyin: Tóngnián de jìyì zǒngshì zuì shēnkè de.
examples.english: Childhood memories are always the deepest.

同时.meaning: at the same time; simultaneously: 同时进行, 同时到达

examples.hanzi: 他一边工作一边读书, 同时干两件事。
examples.pinyin: Tā yībiān gōngzuò yībiān dúshū, tóngshí gàn liǎng jiàn shì.
examples.english: He works and studies — doing two things at the same time.

同时.meaning: moreover; at the same time (sentence-initial, formal): 同时, 我们也要注意安全

examples.hanzi: 我们要抓生产; 同时, 也要注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhuā shēngchǎn; tóngshí, yě yào zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: We must focus on production; at the same time, mind safety.

同样.meaning: same; equal: 同样的问题, 同样的道理

examples.hanzi: 同样的错误不要再犯第二次。
examples.pinyin: Tóngyàng de cuòwù búyào zài fàn dì èr cì.
examples.english: Don't make the same mistake a second time.

同样.meaning: likewise; in the same way: 同样重要, 他同样很努力

examples.hanzi: 这件事对他同样重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì duì tā tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: This matter is likewise important to him.

通知.meaning: to notify; to inform: 通知大家开会, 提前通知

examples.hanzi: 学校通知明天停课一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào tōngzhī míngtiān tíngkè yī tiān.
examples.english: The school notified that classes are cancelled tomorrow.

通知.meaning: notice; notification: 发通知, 收到通知

examples.hanzi: 通知贴在公告栏上。
examples.pinyin: Tōngzhī tiē zài gōnggào lán shang.
examples.english: The notice is posted on the bulletin board.

头痛.meaning: headache: 有点儿头痛, 患头痛

examples.hanzi: 他熬夜太多, 头痛得厉害。
examples.pinyin: Tā áoyè tài duō, tóutòng de lìhai.
examples.english: He stayed up too much and has a bad headache.

头痛.meaning: thorny; vexing (让人头痛的问题) — figurative

examples.hanzi: 孩子的教育问题真让人头痛。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de jiàoyù wèntí zhēn ràng rén tóutòng.
examples.english: The kids' education is truly a headache.

图.meaning: picture; drawing; chart: 地图, 图画, 看图说话

examples.hanzi: 老师在黑板上画了一张图。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shang huà le yī zhāng tú.
examples.english: The teacher drew a diagram on the blackboard.

图.meaning: to plan; to seek (贪图, 企图): 图个方便 — colloquial formula

examples.hanzi: 买这块地主要是图个清净。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi zhè kuài dì zhǔyào shì tú ge qīngjìng.
examples.english: Buying this land is mainly for the peace and quiet.

土.meaning: soil; earth: 泥土, 土地, 种在土里

examples.hanzi: 院子里的土很肥, 种什么都长。
examples.pinyin: Yuànzi li de tǔ hěn féi, zhòng shénme dōu zhǎng.
examples.english: The soil in the yard is fertile — everything grows.

土.meaning: unfashionable; rustic (colloquial, 土办法, 他穿得很土)

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服的颜色有点土。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè yǒudiǎn tǔ.
examples.english: This clothing's color is a bit unfashionable.

推.meaning: to push (vs 拉 pull): 推门, 推车

examples.hanzi: 门是推开的, 不是拉开的。
examples.pinyin: Mén shì tuī kāi de, bù shì lā kāi de.
examples.english: The door pushes open; it doesn't pull.

推.meaning: to shirk; to push away (推辞, 推责任): 推了两次 — colloquial extensions

examples.hanzi: 他身体不舒服, 推了今天的聚会。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēntǐ bù shūfu, tuī le jīntiān de jùhuì.
examples.english: He wasn't feeling well and begged off today's gathering.

推.meaning: to recommend; to promote (推荐, 推广): compounds

examples.hanzi: 这部影片获得了奥斯卡最佳影片的推荐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù yǐngpiàn huòdé le àosīkǎ zuìjiā yǐngpiàn de tuījiàn.
examples.english: This film received an Oscar best-picture recommendation.

推迟.meaning: to postpone; to put off: 推迟会议, 比赛推迟到下周

examples.hanzi: 因为下雨, 比赛推迟到下周。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, bǐsài tuīchí dào xià zhōu.
examples.english: Because of rain the match was postponed to next week.

推出.meaning: to launch; to release (a product, policy, service): 推出新手机, 推出优惠政策

examples.hanzi: 公司下月将推出三款新手机。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xià yuè jiāng tuīchū sān kuǎn xīn shǒujī.
examples.english: The company will launch three new phones next month.

脱.meaning: to take off (clothes, shoes, hat — vs 穿/戴): 脱鞋, 脱下外套

examples.hanzi: 进屋请脱鞋。
examples.pinyin: Jìn wū qǐng tuō xié.
examples.english: Please take off your shoes when entering.

图片.meaning: picture; image: 发图片, 图片说明

examples.hanzi: 这篇文章配了十几张图片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng pèi le shí jǐ zhāng túpiàn.
examples.english: This article is illustrated with a dozen-odd pictures.

外出.meaning: to go out; to leave home (on an errand/trip): 外出旅行, 外出就餐

examples.hanzi: 外出时记得锁门。
examples.pinyin: Wàichū shí jìde suǒ mén.
examples.english: Remember to lock the door when going out.

外套.meaning: coat; jacket (outer garment): 一件外套, 穿外套

examples.hanzi: 进屋后把外套挂在门后。
examples.pinyin: Jìn wū hòu bǎ wàitào guà zài mén hòu.
examples.english: After coming in, hang your coat behind the door.

晚安.meaning: good night: 晚安, 明天见

examples.hanzi: 睡觉前, 他对妈妈说了声晚安。
examples.pinyin: Shuìjiào qián, tā duì māma shuō le shēng wǎn'ān.
examples.english: Before bed he said good night to Mom.

晚餐.meaning: dinner; evening meal (formal vs 晚饭): 准备晚餐, 晚餐时间

examples.hanzi: 全家人围坐在一起吃晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Quán jiārén wéi zuò zài yīqǐ chī wǎncān.
examples.english: The whole family sits together for dinner.

网购.meaning: to shop online; online shopping: 网购商品, 喜欢网购

examples.hanzi: 她的大部分生活用品都是网购的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de dà bùfen shēnghuó yòngpǐn dōu shì wǎnggòu de.
examples.english: Most of her daily necessities are bought online.

往往.meaning: often; frequently (of a general tendency, needs a condition/context, not single events): 冬天往往很冷, 他往往加班到深夜

examples.hanzi: 冬天感冒的人往往比夏天多。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān gǎnmào de rén wǎngwǎng bǐ xiàtiān duō.
examples.english: People with colds in winter are often more than in summer.

网页.meaning: web page: 打开网页, 浏览网页

examples.hanzi: 这个网页打不开, 换个浏览器试试。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngyè dǎ bu kāi, huàn ge liúlǎnqì shìshi.
examples.english: This page won't load — try another browser.

网友.meaning: netizen; online friend: 和网友聊天, 网友评论

examples.hanzi: 这条消息发出后, 网友们纷纷留言。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi fā chū hòu, wǎngyǒumen fēnfēn liúyán.
examples.english: After this post went out, netizens left comments one after another.

网址.meaning: website address; URL: 输入网址, 发我网址

examples.hanzi: 把网址发给我, 我看看内容。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ wǎngzhǐ fā gěi wǒ, wǒ kànkan nèiróng.
examples.english: Send me the URL and I'll check the content.

完全.meaning: complete; whole: 完全不同, 完全正确 — used adverbially with 不/相同 etc.

examples.hanzi: 他说的话我完全同意。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà wǒ wánquán tóngyì.
examples.english: I completely agree with what he said.

完全.meaning: completely; entirely: 完全同意, 完全忘了

examples.hanzi: 车祸之后, 他完全忘了那段时间的事。
examples.pinyin: Chēhuò zhīhòu, tā wánquán wàng le nà duàn shíjiān de shì.
examples.english: After the crash he completely forgot that period.

袜子.meaning: socks; stockings: 一双袜子, 穿袜子

examples.hanzi: 这双袜子破了, 扔了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng wàzi pò le, rēng le ba.
examples.english: These socks are worn out — toss them.

为1.meaning: for; for the sake of (purpose/beneficiary): 为人民服务, 为他高兴

examples.hanzi: 他一生都在为孩子们的教育奔忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīshēng dōu zài wèi háizimen de jiàoyù bēnmáng.
examples.english: His whole life he labored for the children's education.

为1.meaning: because of; for (reason): 因为 sense in compounds/为何

examples.hanzi: 他为何突然辞职, 大家都很奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèihé tūrán cízhí, dàjiā dōu hěn qíguài.
examples.english: Why did he suddenly resign? Everyone wondered.

为1.meaning: to be; to act as (formal copula in names/patterns): 成为, 认为, 以为, 为人 — bound

examples.hanzi: 大家一致认为他是合适的人选。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yīzhì rènwéi tā shì héshì de rénxuǎn.
examples.english: Everyone unanimously regarded him as the right choice.

味.meaning: taste; flavor: 味道, 甜味, 没味儿 — semi-bound

examples.hanzi: 厨房里飘出一股香味。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng li piāo chū yī gǔ xiāngwèi.
examples.english: A delicious smell drifts from the kitchen.

味.meaning: measure word for doses of medicine: 一味药 — traditional medicine register

examples.hanzi: 中医方子里一共有十二味药。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyī fāngzi li yīgòng yǒu shí'èr wèi yào.
examples.english: The TCM prescription contains twelve ingredients.

味道.meaning: taste; flavor: 味道很好, 有家乡的味道 (figurative too)

examples.hanzi: 妈妈做的菜有家乡的味道。
examples.pinyin: Māma zuò de cài yǒu jiāxiāng de wèidao.
examples.english: Mom's cooking has the taste of home.

卫生.meaning: hygienic; sanitary: 很卫生, 讲卫生

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的卫生条件很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de wèishēng tiáojiàn hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This restaurant's hygiene is very good.

卫生.meaning: health; hygiene (as a field/service): 卫生部, 个人卫生

examples.hanzi: 病人要注意个人卫生。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén yào zhùyì gèrén wèishēng.
examples.english: Patients should mind personal hygiene.

危险.meaning: dangerous: 很危险, 危险的工作

examples.hanzi: 孩子一个人在河边玩很危险。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yī ge rén zài hé biān wán hěn wēixiǎn.
examples.english: A child playing alone by the river is dangerous.

危险.meaning: danger: 有危险, 冒着危险, 危险性

examples.hanzi: 抽烟危害健康, 远离危险。
examples.pinyin: Chōu yān wēihài jiànkāng, yuǎnlí wēixiǎn.
examples.english: Smoking harms health — stay away from danger.

闻.meaning: to smell; to sniff at: 闻一闻, 闻到香味

examples.hanzi: 我在楼下就闻到了饭菜的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóuxià jiù wén dào le fàncài de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: I smelled the food's aroma from downstairs.

闻.meaning: to hear (of) (新闻, 闻名) — classical

examples.hanzi: 杭州以西湖闻名于世。
examples.pinyin: Hángzhōu yǐ Xī Hú wénmíng yú shì.
examples.english: Hangzhou is world-famous for West Lake.

温度.meaning: temperature: 温度下降, 室内温度

examples.hanzi: 发酵要在合适的温度下进行。
examples.pinyin: Fājiào yào zài héshì de wēndù xià jìnxíng.
examples.english: Fermentation must proceed at the right temperature.

文件.meaning: document; file: 发送文件, 打印文件, 电脑文件

examples.hanzi: 他把文件保存在电脑里了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn bǎocún zài diànnǎo li le.
examples.english: He saved the file on the computer.

文章.meaning: article; essay: 写文章, 一篇文章, 读了一篇文章

examples.hanzi: 他花了一晚上写完这篇文章。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le yī wǎnshang xiě wán zhè piān wénzhāng.
examples.english: He spent an entire evening finishing this article.

文字.meaning: writing; characters; script: 汉字是一种文字, 文字信息

examples.hanzi: 汉字是世界上最古老的文字之一。
examples.pinyin: Hànzì shì shìjiè shang zuì gǔlǎo de wénzì zhī yī.
examples.english: Chinese characters are among the world's oldest scripts.

文字.meaning: writing (as composition): 文字表达 — formal

examples.hanzi: 报告要求用简洁的文字说明问题。
examples.pinyin: Bàogào yāoqiú yòng jiǎnjié de wénzì shuōmíng wèntí.
examples.english: The report requires explaining the issue in concise writing.

无.meaning: not to have; without (formal negative, = 没有): 无关, 无声, 无数 — bound to compounds

examples.hanzi: 此事与我们无关。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ shì yǔ wǒmen wúguān.
examples.english: This matter has nothing to do with us.

午餐.meaning: lunch; midday meal (formal vs 午饭): 吃午餐, 午餐时间

examples.hanzi: 公司的午餐是自助式的。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shì zìzhù shì de.
examples.english: The company lunch is buffet-style.

无法.meaning: to be unable to; no way to (无法 + verb): 无法理解, 无法接受

examples.hanzi: 问题太复杂, 我无法理解。
examples.pinyin: Wèntí tài fùzá, wǒ wúfǎ lǐjiě.
examples.english: The problem is too complex — I can't understand it.

误会.meaning: to misunderstand: 你误会了, 误会了我的意思

examples.hanzi: 你误会了, 我不是那个意思。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wùhuì le, wǒ bù shì nàge yìsi.
examples.english: You misunderstood — that's not what I meant.

误会.meaning: misunderstanding: 一场误会, 消除误会

examples.hanzi: 这只是一场误会, 说清楚就好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì yī chǎng wùhuì, shuō qīngchu jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: It's just a misunderstanding — clear it up and it's fine.

无聊.meaning: boring; dull; bored: 很无聊, 无聊的电影, 在家待得无聊

examples.hanzi: 下雨天出不去, 在家无聊得很。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān chū bu qù, zài jiā wúliáo de hěn.
examples.english: Can't go out in the rain — bored to death at home.

无论.meaning: no matter how/what/who (无论…都/也; takes alternative or question words): 无论多难都要坚持; 无论你去不去

examples.hanzi: 无论多晚, 妈妈都等他回来吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn duō wǎn, māma dōu děng tā huílai chī fàn.
examples.english: No matter how late, Mom waits for him to come home to eat.

污染.meaning: to pollute; to contaminate: 污染环境, 污染空气

examples.hanzi: 工厂的废水污染了河流。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng de fèishuǐ wūrǎn le héliú.
examples.english: The factory's wastewater polluted the river.

污染.meaning: pollution: 空气污染, 水污染

examples.hanzi: 空气污染已成为城市的严重问题。
examples.pinyin: Kōngqì wūrǎn yǐ chéngwéi chéngshì de yánzhòng wèntí.
examples.english: Air pollution has become a serious urban problem.

细.meaning: thin; fine (diameter, vs 粗): 这根线很细, 细雨

examples.hanzi: 这根线太细, 容易断。
examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn xiàn tài xì, róngyì duàn.
examples.english: This thread is too thin and breaks easily.

细.meaning: careful; attentive to detail; fine-grained: 细心, 仔细, 细节

examples.hanzi: 她是个细心的孩子, 观察得很细。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge xìxīn de háizi, guānchá de hěn xì.
examples.english: She's an attentive child and observes finely.

吸.meaning: to inhale; to suck; to absorb: 吸气, 吸烟, 吸收营养

examples.hanzi: 他深吸了一口气, 跳进了水里。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēn xī le yī kǒu qì, tiào jìn le shuǐ li.
examples.english: He took a deep breath and jumped into the water.

吸.meaning: to attract (吸引): 吸引游客 — compounds

examples.hanzi: 这幅名画吸引了无数观众。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú mínghuà xīyǐn le wúshù guānzhòng.
examples.english: This famous painting has attracted countless viewers.

下降.meaning: to drop; to fall; to decline (numbers, levels): 温度下降, 质量下降

examples.hanzi: 冬天气温明显下降。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān qìwēn míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
examples.english: In winter temperatures drop markedly.

咸.meaning: salty: 这个菜太咸了, 咸盐

examples.hanzi: 这个菜咸得没法吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài xián de méi fǎ chī.
examples.english: This dish is too salty to eat.

鲜.meaning: fresh (food); delicious: 鲜鱼, 味道很鲜, 海鲜

examples.hanzi: 早上的鱼最新鲜, 大家都抢着买。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang de yú zuì xīnxiān, dàjiā dōu qiǎngzhe mǎi.
examples.english: The morning fish is freshest and everyone rushes to buy.

examples.hanzi: 节日的广场上飘着鲜艳的红旗。
examples.pinyin: Jiérì de guǎngchǎng shang piāozhe xiānyàn de hóng qí.
examples.english: Bright red flags fly on the festival square.

鲜.meaning: rare; few (鲜为人知 little known): literary

examples.hanzi: 这段历史鲜为人知。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lìshǐ xiǎn wéi rén zhī.
examples.english: This piece of history is little known.

项.meaning: measure word for items, projects, tasks: 一项任务, 三项规定, 一项研究

examples.hanzi: 今年公司有三项重要任务。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián gōngsī yǒu sān xiàng zhòngyào rènwu.
examples.english: The company has three important tasks this year.

项.meaning: item; clause (事项, 项目): compounds

examples.hanzi: 会议逐项讨论了各项事项。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zhú xiàng tǎolùn le gè xiàng shìxiàng.
examples.english: The meeting discussed each item one by one.

examples.hanzi: 望着老师的项背, 他想起了父亲。
examples.pinyin: Wàngzhe lǎoshī de xiàngbèi, tā xiǎng qǐ le fùqīn.
examples.english: Gazing at the teacher's back, he thought of his father.

响.meaning: to make a sound; to ring: 铃响了, 电话响了

examples.hanzi: 下课铃响了, 孩子们跑出教室。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè líng xiǎng le, háizimen pǎo chū jiàoshì.
examples.english: The bell rang and the children ran out of the classroom.

响.meaning: loud: 声音很响, 响亮的歌声

examples.hanzi: 他的歌声响亮, 传得很远。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gēshēng xiǎngliàng, chuán de hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: His singing voice is loud and carries far.

香.meaning: fragrant; good-smelling (of food especially): 饭很香, 花很香

examples.hanzi: 公园里的桂花开了, 特别香。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán li de guìhuā kāi le, tèbié xiāng.
examples.english: The osmanthus in the park has bloomed — wonderfully fragrant.

香.meaning: appetizing/tasty (eats well): 睡得香, 吃得香 — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 孩子睡得正香, 别吵醒他。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shuì de zhèng xiāng, bié chǎoxǐng tā.
examples.english: The child is sleeping soundly — don't wake him.

examples.hanzi: 清明时节, 人们烧香祭祖。
examples.pinyin: Qīngmíng shíjié, rénmen shāo xiāng jì zǔ.
examples.english: At Qingming people burn incense to honor ancestors.

相比.meaning: to compare with (与/和…相比 compared to): 和去年相比, 今年天气更热

examples.hanzi: 和去年相比, 今年雨水多得多。
examples.pinyin: Hé qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián yǔshuǐ duō de duō.
examples.english: Compared with last year, this year has far more rain.

想法.meaning: idea; opinion; thought: 你的想法, 有个新想法, 改变想法

examples.hanzi: 他把创业的想法告诉了父母。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ chuàngyè de xiǎngfǎ gàosù le fùmǔ.
examples.english: He told his parents his idea of starting a business.

相反.meaning: opposite; contrary: 相反的意见, 恰恰相反

examples.hanzi: 我本来以为他会反对, 相反, 他很支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā huì fǎnduì, xiāngfǎn, tā hěn zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought he'd oppose it; on the contrary, he was supportive.

相反.meaning: on the contrary; conversely: 他没生气, 相反, 他很高兴

examples.hanzi: 他没生气; 相反, 他觉得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Tā méi shēngqì; xiāngfǎn, tā juéde hěn yǒu yìsi.
