样子.meaning: (in this/that) manner (这个样子): 装出可怜的样子

examples.hanzi: 他装出一副可怜的样子求我们帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuāng chū yī fù kělián de yàngzi qiú wǒmen bāngmáng.
examples.english: He put on a pitiful look begging us to help.

眼镜.meaning: glasses; spectacles: 一副眼镜, 戴眼镜

examples.hanzi: 他近视了, 配了一副眼镜。
examples.pinyin: Tā jìnshì le, pèi le yī fù yǎnjìng.
examples.english: He became nearsighted and got a pair of glasses.

研究.meaning: to study; to research: 研究问题, 研究了十年

examples.hanzi: 他花十年时间研究了这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā shí nián shíjiān yánjiū le zhège wèntí.
examples.english: He spent ten years researching this question.

研究.meaning: research; study: 科学研究, 研究生

examples.hanzi: 这项科学研究持续了五年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēxué yánjiū chíxù le wǔ nián.
examples.english: This scientific research lasted five years.

研究生.meaning: graduate student (master's or doctoral): 读研究生, 研究生毕业

examples.hanzi: 她研究生毕业后留校当了老师。
examples.pinyin: Tā yánjiūshēng bìyè hòu liú xiào dàng le lǎoshī.
examples.english: After graduate school she stayed on as a teacher.

眼前.meaning: before one's eyes; at the moment: 眼前一亮, 眼前的困难

examples.hanzi: 眼前的困难只是暂时的。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnqián de kùnnan zhǐ shì zànshí de.
examples.english: The difficulty before us is only temporary.

演员.meaning: actor; actress; performer: 一位演员, 电影演员

examples.hanzi: 这位演员的表演十分自然。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán de biǎoyǎn shífēn zìrán.
examples.english: This actor's performance is very natural.

严重.meaning: serious; severe; grave: 病得很严重, 后果严重, 严重的错误

examples.hanzi: 他的伤势严重, 需要马上手术。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shāngshì yánzhòng, xūyào mǎshàng shǒushù.
examples.english: His injuries are severe and need immediate surgery.

严重.meaning: severely: 严重缺水, 供应严重不足

examples.hanzi: 这个地区严重缺水。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yánzhòng quē shuǐ.
examples.english: This region is severely short of water.

邀请.meaning: to invite: 邀请我们吃饭, 受到邀请

examples.hanzi: 他邀请我们去他家过春节。
examples.pinyin: Tā yāoqǐng wǒmen qù tā jiā guò Chūnjié.
examples.english: He invited us to spend Spring Festival at his home.

邀请.meaning: invitation: 收到邀请, 接受邀请

examples.hanzi: 收到请柬后请尽快回复邀请。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào qǐngjiǎn hòu qǐng jǐnkuài huífù yāoqǐng.
examples.english: Please reply to the invitation promptly upon receiving it.

要是.meaning: if (colloquial equivalent of 如果): 要是明天下雨, 就不去了

examples.hanzi: 要是明天天气好, 我们就去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù pá shān.
examples.english: If the weather's good tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

钥匙.meaning: key (to a lock): 一把钥匙, 忘带钥匙

examples.hanzi: 门钥匙在抽屉里。
examples.pinyin: Mén yàoshi zài chōuti li.
examples.english: The door key is in the drawer.

亚洲.meaning: Asia: 亚洲国家, 东南亚亚洲

examples.hanzi: 亚洲是世界上人口最多的大洲。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu shì shìjiè shang rénkǒu zuì duō de dàzhōu.
examples.english: Asia is the world's most populous continent.

夜.meaning: night (formal/bound, vs 晚上 colloquial): 夜里, 深夜, 过夜, 夜班

examples.hanzi: 他工作到深夜才休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò dào shēnyè cái xiūxi.
examples.english: He worked until late at night before resting.

夜晚.meaning: night; nighttime (written): 美丽的夜晚, 夜晚安静

examples.hanzi: 乡村的夜晚安静得能听见虫叫。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngcūn de yèwǎn ānjìng de néng tīngjiàn chóng jiào.
examples.english: The village night is so quiet you can hear insects.

也许.meaning: maybe; perhaps: 也许他忘了, 也许会下雨

examples.hanzi: 他没来上课, 也许生病了。
examples.pinyin: Tā méi lái shàng kè, yěxǔ shēngbìng le.
examples.english: He didn't come to class — maybe he's sick.

叶子.meaning: leaf (of a plant): 树叶子, 一片叶子

examples.hanzi: 秋风吹落了一地黄叶子。
examples.pinyin: Qiūfēng chuī luò le yī dì huáng yèzi.
examples.english: The autumn wind blew a ground full of yellow leaves.

已.meaning: already (formal single-character equivalent of 已经): 已完成, 时间已过 — mainly written

examples.hanzi: 报名日期已过, 不能再报了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng rìqī yǐ guò, bù néng zài bào le.
examples.english: The registration deadline has passed — no more sign-ups.

意见.meaning: opinion; suggestion; objection: 提意见, 听取意见, 有意见吗?

examples.hanzi: 大家对这个方案有什么意见?
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhège fāng'àn yǒu shénme yìjiàn?
examples.english: Does anyone have views on this plan?

因此.meaning: therefore; for that reason (formal, links cause to result): 他病了, 因此没来上课

examples.hanzi: 他经常锻炼; 因此, 身体一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng duànliàn; yīncǐ, shēntǐ yīzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He exercises regularly; therefore, his health is always good.

以内.meaning: within (a limit, after a quantity): 三天以内, 50元以内

examples.hanzi: 请在三天以内完成。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài sān tiān yǐnèi wánchéng.
examples.english: Please complete it within three days.

赢.meaning: to win (a game, match): 赢了比赛, 赢了很多钱

examples.hanzi: 我们队赢了这场比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duì yíng le zhè chǎng bǐsài.
examples.english: Our team won this match.

赢得.meaning: to win (something abstract: respect, time, support) (formal): 赢得尊重, 赢得时间

examples.hanzi: 他的真诚赢得了大家的信任。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhēnchéng yíngdé le dàjiā de xìnren.
examples.english: His sincerity won everyone's trust.

应聘.meaning: to apply for a job position; to answer a job ad: 应聘这个职位, 去公司应聘

examples.hanzi: 他从五十个应聘者中被选中了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng wǔshí ge yìngpìnzhě zhōng bèi xuǎnzhòng le.
examples.english: He was chosen from among fifty applicants.

引起.meaning: to cause; to give rise to; to attract (attention): 引起注意, 引起讨论, 引起火灾

examples.hanzi: 这场大火引起了对消防安全的讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà huǒ yǐnqǐ le duì xiāofáng ānquán de tǎolùn.
examples.english: The fire sparked discussion of fire safety.

印象.meaning: impression: 印象很深, 第一印象, 给他留下好印象

examples.hanzi: 这个城市给我留下了很好的印象。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn hǎo de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: This city left a very good impression on me.

一切.meaning: everything; all: 一切顺利, 一切问题, 感谢你所做的一切

examples.hanzi: 为了孩子, 父母可以放弃一切。
examples.pinyin: Wèile háizi, fùmǔ kěyǐ fàngqì yīqiè.
examples.english: For their children, parents can give up everything.

一生.meaning: all one's life; lifetime: 一生的努力, 忙碌的一生

examples.hanzi: 爷爷当了一辈子农民, 忙碌的一生。
examples.pinyin: Yéye dàng le yībèizi nóngmín, mánglù de yīshēng.
examples.english: Grandpa was a farmer all his life — a busy lifetime.

艺术.meaning: art: 艺术家, 艺术作品, 传统艺术

examples.hanzi: 中国书法是一门独特的艺术。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó shūfǎ shì yī mén dútè de yìshù.
examples.english: Chinese calligraphy is a unique art.

勇敢.meaning: brave; courageous: 勇敢的孩子, 勇敢地面对

examples.hanzi: 消防员勇敢地冲进了火场。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán yǒnggǎn de chōng jìn le huǒchǎng.
examples.english: The firefighters bravely charged into the blaze.

用来.meaning: to be used to/for (introduces purpose): 这笔钱用来交学费; 用来做研究

examples.hanzi: 这笔钱用来交房租。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián yòng lái jiāo fángzū.
examples.english: This money is used to pay rent.

用于.meaning: to be used in/for (formal): 经费用于科研

examples.hanzi: 这笔基金用于资助贫困学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jījīn yòngyú zīzhù pínkùn xuéshēng.
examples.english: This fund is used to aid poor students.

永远.meaning: forever; always; for good: 永远记住, 我永远爱你

examples.hanzi: 我永远记得老师对我说的那句话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn jìde lǎoshī duì wǒ shuō de nà jù huà.
examples.english: I'll forever remember what the teacher said to me.

由.meaning: by (agent in a passive-like frame); from (a source): 由老师负责, 由北京出发

examples.hanzi: 这次活动由学生会负责。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng yóu xuéshēnghuì fùzé.
examples.english: This event is the student union's responsibility.

由.meaning: to let; to allow (任由, 由他去): formal compounds

examples.hanzi: 孩子要出去玩, 就由他去吧。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yào chūqù wán, jiù yóu tā qù ba.
examples.english: The kid wants to go out to play — let him.

油.meaning: oil; fat; grease: 食用油, 加油(给车) fuel, 油腻

examples.hanzi: 锅里的油热了, 可以下菜了。
examples.pinyin: Guō li de yóu rè le, kěyǐ xià cài le.
examples.english: The oil in the wok is hot — in with the vegetables.

优点.meaning: strong point; merit; advantage (vs 缺点): 他的优点, 发现别人的优点

examples.hanzi: 每个人都有优点, 也都有缺点。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yōudiǎn, yě dōu yǒu quēdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone has strengths and everyone has faults.

友好.meaning: friendly; amicable: 对人友好, 友好的气氛

examples.hanzi: 这里的人们对外国游客很友好。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénmen duì wàiguó yóukè hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.english: People here are friendly to foreign tourists.

友好.meaning: friendly (relations between groups/countries): 友好城市, 友好访问

examples.hanzi: 两市结成了友好城市。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng shì jié chéng le yǒuhǎo chéngshì.
examples.english: The two cities became sister cities.

幽默.meaning: humorous; humorous/witty: 幽默的人, 很幽默, 幽默感

examples.hanzi: 王老师很幽默, 课上经常有笑声。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī hěn yōumò, kè shang jīngcháng yǒu xiàoshēng.
examples.english: Teacher Wang is humorous; his classes are often full of laughter.

尤其.meaning: especially; particularly: 喜欢运动, 尤其是篮球; 最近很忙, 尤其这周

examples.hanzi: 他喜欢运动, 尤其是篮球。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yùndòng, yóuqí shì lánqiú.
examples.english: He likes sports, especially basketball.

友情.meaning: friendship (between friends, warm register): 珍惜友情, 深厚的友情

examples.hanzi: 十年的同窗让他们结下了深厚的友情。
examples.pinyin: Shí nián de tóngchuāng ràng tāmen jié xià le shēnhòu de yǒuqíng.
examples.english: Ten years as classmates forged a deep friendship.

有趣.meaning: interesting; fun; amusing: 有趣的故事, 一个人觉得有趣

examples.hanzi: 这本书有趣极了, 我一口气读完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒuqù jí le, wǒ yīkǒuqì dú wán le.
examples.english: This book is so interesting I read it in one go.

游玩.meaning: to go sightseeing; to have fun (out): 去公园游玩, 游玩了一天

examples.hanzi: 他们在西湖边游玩了一天。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài Xī Hú biān yóuwán le yī tiān.
examples.english: They spent a whole day sightseeing around West Lake.

有效.meaning: effective; valid (of a method, ticket, ID): 有效的方法, 签证还有效, 有效地提高

examples.hanzi: 这种止痛药很有效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhǐtòng yào hěn yǒuxiào.
examples.english: This painkiller is very effective.

优秀.meaning: excellent; outstanding: 优秀的学生, 表现优秀, 优秀作品

examples.hanzi: 她每年都被评为优秀员工。
examples.pinyin: Tā měinián dōu bèi píngwéi yōuxiū yuángōng.
examples.english: She is named an outstanding employee every year.

友谊.meaning: friendship (formal, e.g. between nations/groups): 友谊第一, 深化友谊

examples.hanzi: 比赛第二, 友谊第一。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài dì'èr, yǒuyì dì yī.
examples.english: Competition second, friendship first.

由于.meaning: owing to; due to; because of (formal; the cause is usually unwelcome): 由于天气原因, 航班取消了

examples.hanzi: 由于堵车, 他迟到了半个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú dǔchē, tā chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Due to traffic, he was half an hour late.

有着.meaning: to have (formal, linking a subject to a lasting abstract possession): 有着重要的意义, 有着悠久的历史

examples.hanzi: 这座城市有着上千年的历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒuzhe shàng qiān nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This city has over a thousand years of history.

与.meaning: and (formal, joining nouns): 甲与乙, 我与他都去 — = 和 in writing

examples.hanzi: 老师与学生应以诚相与。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yǔ xuéshēng yīng yǐ chéng xiāngyǔ.
examples.english: Teachers and students should treat each other with sincerity.

与.meaning: with (formal): 与此同时; 与会 with the meeting; 与...相比 compared with

examples.hanzi: 与此同时, 我们不能忘记安全问题。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ cǐ tóngshí, wǒmen bù néng wàngjì ānquán wèntí.
examples.english: At the same time, we mustn't forget safety issues.

与.meaning: to take part in (参与, 会与) — formal compounds (与会): mainly bound

examples.hanzi: 他很重视与朋友的交往。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zhòngshì yǔ péngyou de jiāowǎng.
examples.english: He values his associations with friends.

原来.meaning: original; former: 原来的计划, 原来的样子

examples.hanzi: 原来的计划是坐火车, 后来改成了飞机。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái de jìhuà shì zuò huǒchē, hòulái gǎi chéng le fēijī.
examples.english: The original plan was to take the train; later it changed to flying.

原来.meaning: so that's it!; as it turns out (realization): 原来是你啊!; 原来他已经知道了

examples.hanzi: 原来是你! 我还以为是快递员。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì nǐ! Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì kuàidìyuán.
examples.english: So it's you! I thought it was the courier.

远离.meaning: to stay far away from; to be far removed from: 远离垃圾食品, 远离城市

examples.hanzi: 要远离二手烟的环境。
examples.pinyin: Yào yuǎnlí èrshǒu yān de huánjìng.
examples.english: Stay away from secondhand-smoke environments.

原谅.meaning: to forgive; to pardon: 原谅我, 请你原谅他

examples.hanzi: 他还是原谅了朋友的错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā háishì yuánliàng le péngyou de cuòwù.
examples.english: He forgave his friend's mistake after all.

原因.meaning: cause; reason: 什么原因, 主要原因, 由于...的原因

examples.hanzi: 事故的原因还在调查中。
examples.pinyin: Shìgù de yuányīn hái zài diàochá zhōng.
examples.english: The cause of the accident is still under investigation.

院长.meaning: director; dean (of a college, hospital, institute): 医院院长

examples.hanzi: 院长亲自主持了毕业典礼。
examples.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng qīnzì zhǔchí le bìyè diǎnlǐ.
examples.english: The dean personally presided over the graduation ceremony.

院子.meaning: courtyard; yard: 一个院子, 院子里种着花

examples.hanzi: 爷爷在院子里种了很多花。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài yuànzi li zhòng le hěn duō huā.
examples.english: Grandpa planted many flowers in the yard.

约.meaning: approximately; about: 约三十人, 约重五公斤

examples.hanzi: 这本书约三十万字。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yuē sānshí wàn zì.
examples.english: This book is about 300,000 characters.

约.meaning: to make an appointment; to arrange to meet: 约了朋友吃饭, 我们约在车站见

examples.hanzi: 我们约在车站门口见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuē zài chēzhàn ménkǒu jiàn.
examples.english: We arranged to meet at the station entrance.

约.meaning: to restrict; agreement (约定, 制约, 条约): compounds

examples.hanzi: 两国签署了和平条约。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó qiānshǔ le hépíng tiáoyuē.
examples.english: The two countries signed a peace treaty.

月饼.meaning: mooncake (Mid-Autumn Festival pastry): 吃月饼, 一块月饼

examples.hanzi: 中秋节一家人坐在一起吃月饼。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié yī jiārén zuò zài yīqǐ chī yuèbǐng.
examples.english: At Mid-Autumn the family sits together eating mooncakes.

阅读.meaning: to read (formal, of reading material): 阅读文章, 阅读能力

examples.hanzi: 他每天睡前阅读半小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān shuì qián yuèdú bàn xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He reads for half an hour before bed every day.

阅读.meaning: reading (as an activity/skill): 课外阅读

examples.hanzi: 老师建议我们多做课外阅读。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒmen duō zuò kèwài yuèdú.
examples.english: The teacher advises more extracurricular reading.

月份.meaning: month (which month of the year, vs 月 the month): 哪个月份, 七月份出生

examples.hanzi: 七八月份是旅游旺季。
examples.pinyin: Qī-bā yuèfèn shì lǚyóu wàngjì.
examples.english: July and August are peak travel months.

约会.meaning: date; appointment (romantic or arranged meeting): 有个约会, 去约会

examples.hanzi: 他第一次和女朋友约会, 紧张极了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì hé nǚpéngyou yuēhuì, jǐnzhāng jí le.
examples.english: He was super nervous on his first date.

约会.meaning: to have a date; to meet by appointment: 和他约会

examples.hanzi: 他们每个月约会一次, 聊聊近况。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen měi ge yuè yuēhuì yī cì, liáoliao jìnkuàng.
examples.english: They meet once a month to catch up.

语法.meaning: grammar: 语法错误, 学语法, 语法点

examples.hanzi: 这个语法点他讲了三遍, 大家才懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǔfǎ diǎn tā jiǎng le sān biàn, dàjiā cái dǒng.
examples.english: He explained this grammar point three times before everyone got it.

愉快.meaning: happy; pleasant; cheerful (formal vs 开心): 愉快的心情, 祝你旅途愉快

examples.hanzi: 祝大家旅途愉快!
examples.pinyin: Zhù dàjiā lǚtú yúkuài!
examples.english: Wish everyone a pleasant journey!

云.meaning: cloud: 天上有云, 乌云, 云彩

examples.hanzi: 天上的云像棉花一样白。
examples.pinyin: Tiān shang de yún xiàng miánhuā yīyàng bái.
examples.english: The clouds in the sky are white as cotton.

允许.meaning: to allow; to permit; to let (formal): 不允许吸烟, 得到允许

examples.hanzi: 图书馆内不允许吃东西。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn nèi bù yǔnxǔ chī dōngxi.
examples.english: Eating is not allowed in the library.

于是.meaning: thereupon; so; as a result (links sequential events): 他饿了, 于是自己去做了饭

examples.hanzi: 雨突然大了, 于是我们跑进了路边的商店。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tūrán dà le, yúshì wǒmen pǎo jìn le lù biān de shāngdiàn.
examples.english: The rain suddenly got heavy, so we dashed into a roadside shop.

预习.meaning: to preview (study material before class): 预习课文, 提前预习

examples.hanzi: 明天的课文请提前预习。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de kèwén qǐng tíqián yùxí.
examples.english: Please preview tomorrow's text in advance.

再次.meaning: once again (formal): 再次感谢, 再次提醒

examples.hanzi: 再次感谢大家的支持。
examples.pinyin: Zàicì gǎnxiè dàjiā de zhīchí.
examples.english: Once again, thank you all for your support.

再说.meaning: besides; what's more (adds a reason, colloquial): 我没时间, 再说, 也没钱

examples.hanzi: 我没时间去; 再说, 票也太贵了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi shíjiān qù; zàishuō, piào yě tài guì le.
examples.english: I've no time to go; besides, the tickets are too expensive.

再说.meaning: to discuss later; leave it for now: 这事以后再说

examples.hanzi: 这个问题以后再说吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǐhòu zàishuō ba.
examples.english: Let's deal with this question later.

暂时.meaning: temporarily; for the time being: 暂时不能来, 暂时的办法

examples.hanzi: 工程暂时停了下来。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéng zànshí tíng le xiàlai.
examples.english: Work on the project has temporarily stopped.

暂停.meaning: to suspend; to pause temporarily: 暂停营业, 比赛暂停

examples.hanzi: 比赛因大雨暂停了十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài yīn dà yǔ zàntíng le shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The match was suspended ten minutes for heavy rain.

早餐.meaning: breakfast (formal vs 早饭): 吃早餐, 早餐店

examples.hanzi: 他习惯在上班路上买早餐。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài shàngbān lù shang mǎi zǎocān.
examples.english: He's used to buying breakfast on the way to work.

早晨.meaning: (early) morning: 早晨六点, 早晨锻炼

examples.hanzi: 早晨的空气最新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Zǎochén de kōngqì zuì xīnxiān.
examples.english: The morning air is freshest.

杂志.meaning: magazine: 一本杂志, 看杂志

examples.hanzi: 候诊室里摆着几本旧杂志。
examples.pinyin: Hòuzhěnshì li bǎizhe jǐ běn jiù zázhì.
examples.english: A few old magazines sit in the waiting room.

增加.meaning: to increase; to add (numbers, amounts): 增加收入, 人数增加了

examples.hanzi: 今年公司增加了两个新岗位。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián gōngsī zēngjiā le liǎng ge xīn gǎngwèi.
examples.english: This year the company added two new positions.

增长.meaning: to grow; to increase (economics, knowledge): 经济增长, 增长知识

examples.hanzi: 今年的游客数量增长了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de yóukè shùliàng zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.
examples.english: Visitor numbers grew twenty percent this year.

examples.hanzi: 经济的快速增长带来了更多就业。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì de kuàisù zēngzhǎng dàilái le gèng duō jiùyè.
examples.english: Rapid economic growth brought more jobs.

责任.meaning: responsibility; duty: 有责任感, 承担责任, 负责任

examples.hanzi: 保护环境是每个人的责任。
examples.pinyin: Bǎohù huánjìng shì měi ge rén de zérèn.
examples.english: Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility.

着.meaning: (aspect particle after a verb) ongoing state or accompanying action: 吃着饭看电视, 门开着, 灯还亮着

examples.hanzi: 他吃着饭看手机。
examples.pinyin: Tā chīzhe fàn kàn shǒujī.
examples.english: He eats while looking at his phone.

着.meaning: (result complement) to catch; to succeed; to reach: 睡不着, 找不着, 猜着了

examples.hanzi: 孩子半夜还睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bànyè hái shuì bu zháo.
examples.english: The child still can't fall asleep at midnight.

着.meaning: to touch; to burn (着火, 着凉): compounds/collocations

examples.hanzi: 天冷了, 小心着凉。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, xiǎoxīn zháoliáng.
examples.english: It's cold — careful not to catch a chill.

着.meaning: to wear (着装, 穿着); to apply (着手) — literary compounds

examples.hanzi: 演员们着装整齐地走上舞台。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnyuánmen zhuózhuāng zhěngqí de zǒu shang wǔtái.
examples.english: The performers walked on stage in neat attire.

着.meaning: move; trick (绝着, 高着/高招): colloquial/chess

examples.hanzi: 下象棋时, 他总能想出妙着。
examples.pinyin: Xià xiàngqí shí, tā zǒng néng xiǎng chū miào zhāo.
examples.english: Playing chess, he always comes up with clever moves.

着火.meaning: to catch fire: 房子着火了

examples.hanzi: 楼下的垃圾箱着火了。
examples.pinyin: Lóu xià de lājīxiāng zháohuǒ le.
examples.english: The trash bin downstairs caught fire.

招聘.meaning: to recruit; to hire (an employer seeking staff): 招聘广告, 招聘工程师

examples.hanzi: 公司在网上发布了招聘广告。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zài wǎng shang fābù le zhāopìn guǎnggào.
examples.english: The company posted a job ad online.

者.meaning: nominalizing suffix '-er/-one who' (作者 author, 记者 reporter, 患者 patient, 消费者 consumer): bound suffix

examples.hanzi: 作者是这本书的灵魂。
examples.pinyin: Zuòzhě shì zhè běn shū de línghún.
examples.english: The author is the soul of this book.

证.meaning: certificate; proof; credentials (学生证, 证: mainly in compounds — evidence, verification (证明, 证实): bound

examples.hanzi: 学生证丢了要及时补办。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēngzhèng diū le yào jíshí bǔbàn.
examples.english: If you lose your student ID, get a replacement promptly.

整.meaning: whole; entire; exactly (a round number): 整天, 整整一年, 整八点

examples.hanzi: 他在国外整整工作了十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài zhěngzhěng gōngzuò le shí nián.
examples.english: He worked abroad for ten whole years.

整.meaning: to put in order; to fix; to tidy (整理, 修整): 整了整衣服 — formal compounds

examples.hanzi: 出门前他整了整领带。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā zhěng le zhěng lǐngdài.
examples.english: Before going out he straightened his tie.

正常.meaning: normal; regular: 一切正常, 不太正常

examples.hanzi: 手术后他的体温恢复正常。
examples.pinyin: Shǒushù hòu tā de tǐwēn huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: After surgery his temperature returned to normal.

整个.meaning: whole; entire: 整个城市, 整个下午

examples.hanzi: 整个下午他都在图书馆学习。
examples.pinyin: Zhěngge xiàwǔ tā dōu zài túshūguǎn xuéxí.
examples.english: He studied in the library the whole afternoon.

正好.meaning: just right; exactly; as it happens: 你来得正好, 正好十点

examples.hanzi: 你来得正好, 一起吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, yīqǐ chī fàn ba.
examples.english: You've come at just the right time — join us for dinner.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋不大不小, 正好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié bù dà bù xiǎo, zhènghǎo.
examples.english: These shoes are neither big nor small — just right.

证件.meaning: credentials; identity papers (ID, passport): 出示证件, 带好证件

examples.hanzi: 出国前检查好所有证件。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó qián jiǎnchá hǎo suǒyǒu zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: Check all your documents before going abroad.

整理.meaning: to sort out; to tidy up; to organize: 整理房间, 整理资料

examples.hanzi: 周末他把书架整理了一遍。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā bǎ shūjià zhěnglǐ le yī biàn.
examples.english: Over the weekend he sorted out the bookshelf.

证明.meaning: to prove; to certify: 证明自己是清白的, 充分证明

examples.hanzi: 事实证明他的判断是对的。
examples.pinyin: Shìshí zhèngmíng tā de pànduàn shì duì de.
examples.english: Facts proved his judgment correct.

证明.meaning: proof; certificate: 开一份证明, 收入证明

examples.hanzi: 开学的证明要盖章才有效。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué de zhèngmíng yào gàizhāng cái yǒuxiào.
examples.english: The enrollment certificate needs a stamp to be valid.

正确.meaning: correct; right: 正确答案, 作出正确的选择

examples.hanzi: 经过讨论, 大家选出了正确的答案。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò tǎolùn, dàjiā xuǎn chū le zhèngquè de dá'àn.
examples.english: After discussion, everyone picked the correct answer.

正式.meaning: formal; official: 正式场合, 正式员工, 正式开始

examples.hanzi: 下周他将正式成为公司员工。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōu tā jiāng zhèngshì chéngwéi gōngsī yuángōng.
examples.english: Next week he'll officially become a company employee.

正式.meaning: officially; formally: 正式宣布, 正式生效

examples.hanzi: 两国正式签署了合作协议。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó zhèngshì qiānshǔ le hézuò xiéyì.
examples.english: The two countries formally signed a cooperation agreement.

真正.meaning: true; real; genuine: 真正的朋友, 真正的原因

examples.hanzi: 真正的朋友会在困难时帮你。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zài kùnnan shí bāng nǐ.
examples.english: A true friend helps you in hard times.

真正.meaning: truly; really: 真正关心你的人

examples.hanzi: 他才是真正关心你的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā cái shì zhēnzhèng guānxīn nǐ de rén.
examples.english: He is the one who truly cares about you.

值.meaning: to be worth (值一百块, 值得): 这顿饭值!

examples.hanzi: 排三个小时的队看这个展览, 值!
examples.pinyin: Pái sān ge xiǎoshí de duì kàn zhège zhǎnlǎn, zhí!
examples.english: Queueing three hours for this exhibition — worth it!

值.meaning: to be on duty: 值班, 今晚他值班

examples.hanzi: 今晚轮到他值班。
examples.pinyin: Jīn wǎn lún dào tā zhíbān.
examples.english: It's his turn to be on duty tonight.

值.meaning: value (数值, 产值) — technical compounds

examples.hanzi: 统计表上列出了每个数值。
examples.pinyin: Tǒngjì biǎo shang liè chū le měi ge shùzhí.
examples.english: The statistics table lists each value.

指.meaning: to point at; to point to: 指着地图, 手指的方向

examples.hanzi: 他指着地图说明路线。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe dìtú shuōmíng lùxiàn.
examples.english: He pointed at the map explaining the route.

指.meaning: to refer to; to mean: 他指的是谁?

examples.hanzi: 我说的'他'指的是小李。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuō de 'tā' zhǐ de shì Xiǎo Lǐ.
examples.english: The 'he' I mentioned refers to Xiao Li.

指.meaning: to depend on; to count on (指望): 指望不上 — colloquial

examples.hanzi: 家里的活儿全指望妈妈一个人。
examples.pinyin: Jiā li de huór quán zhǐwàng māma yī ge rén.
examples.english: All the household work depends on Mom alone.

之1.meaning: (classical structural particle replacing 的, formal): 三分之一, 目的之一, 其中之一

examples.hanzi: 他是我们班跑得最快的人之一。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen bān pǎo de zuì kuài de rén zhī yī.
examples.english: He is one of the fastest runners in our class.

之1.meaning: it; him/her (classical pronoun in fixed phrases: 取之不尽, 求之不得)

examples.hanzi: 这样的机会难得, 真是求之不得。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de jīhuì nándé, zhēn shì qiú zhī bù dé.
examples.english: Such an opportunity is rare — truly a godsend.

之1.meaning: to go; to arrive (之所以): 之所以…是因为 construction — bound

examples.hanzi: 他之所以迟到, 是因为路上堵车。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒyǐ chídào, shì yīnwèi lù shang dǔchē.
examples.english: The reason he was late is that traffic was jammed.

支持.meaning: to support; to back: 支持我的决定, 大力支持

examples.hanzi: 无论你做什么决定, 我都支持你。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ zuò shénme juédìng, wǒ dōu zhīchí nǐ.
examples.english: Whatever you decide, I'll support you.

examples.hanzi: 你的行动给了我们道义上的支持。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xíngdòng gěi le wǒmen dàoyì shang de zhīchí.
examples.english: Your action gave us moral support.

指出.meaning: to point out; to indicate (a problem, error — formal): 指出问题, 指出不足

examples.hanzi: 老师指出了我发言中的两个问题。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐ chū le wǒ fāyán zhōng de liǎng ge wèntí.
examples.english: The teacher pointed out two problems in my speech.

值得.meaning: to be worth (doing); to deserve: 值得一看, 值得学习, 这本书值得买

examples.hanzi: 这本书值得认真读一遍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhídé rènzhēn dú yī biàn.
examples.english: This book is worth a careful read.

支付.meaning: to pay (formal, of bills/amounts): 支付宝 mobile payment app, 网上支付

examples.hanzi: 现在很多人用手机支付。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén yòng shǒujī zhīfù.
examples.english: Nowadays many people pay by phone.

只好.meaning: to have no choice but to; to be compelled to: 下雨了, 只好取消了

examples.hanzi: 末班车没了, 我们只好打车回去。
examples.pinyin: Mòbānchē méi le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo dǎchē huíqù.
examples.english: The last bus was gone; we had to taxi home.

之后.meaning: after; afterwards (formal equivalent of 以后): 吃饭之后, 三天之后

examples.hanzi: 下课之后我们去图书馆。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè zhīhòu wǒmen qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: After class we're going to the library.

之间.meaning: between; among (two parties/places): 朋友之间, 两站之间

examples.hanzi: 两家超市之间有一条小街。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā chāoshì zhījiān yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo jiē.
examples.english: There's a small street between the two supermarkets.

直接.meaning: direct; straightforward: 直接的原因, 直接回答

examples.hanzi: 有问题直接找我, 别客气。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí zhíjiē zhǎo wǒ, bié kèqi.
examples.english: If there's a problem come straight to me — don't be polite.

直接.meaning: directly: 直接影响, 直接去找他

examples.hanzi: 飞机直接飞到了纽约。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī zhíjiē fēi dào le Niǔyuē.
examples.english: The plane flew direct to New York.

纸巾.meaning: tissue (paper); paper napkin: 一包纸巾, 抽纸巾

examples.hanzi: 桌上放着一包纸巾。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō shang fàngzhe yī bāo zhǐjīn.
examples.english: A pack of tissues sits on the table.

质量.meaning: quality (of goods, work): 质量很好, 提高质量

examples.hanzi: 这家店的东西质量很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This shop's goods are of fine quality.

之前.meaning: before; prior to (formal equivalent of 以前): 十点之前, 毕业之前

examples.hanzi: 睡觉之前他看了半小时书。
examples.pinyin: Shuìjiào zhīqián tā kàn le bàn xiǎoshí shū.
examples.english: Before sleeping he read for half an hour.

至少.meaning: at least; at the minimum: 至少三次, 至少要十分钟

examples.hanzi: 从这里到机场至少要四十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng zhìshǎo yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: From here to the airport takes at least forty minutes.

知识.meaning: knowledge: 知识分子, 学到知识, 丰富的知识

examples.hanzi: 知识改变命运。
examples.pinyin: Zhīshi gǎibiàn mìngyùn.
examples.english: Knowledge changes destiny.

植物.meaning: plant (botany): 植物园, 植物生长

examples.hanzi: 这些植物一周浇一次水就够了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhíwù yī zhōu jiāo yī cì shuǐ jiù gòu le.
examples.english: These plants need watering only once a week.

职业.meaning: occupation; profession; career: 职业是老师, 选择职业

examples.hanzi: 教师是他最喜欢的职业。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshī shì tā zuì xǐhuan de zhíyè.
examples.english: Teaching is his favorite profession.

职业.meaning: professional (vs amateur): 职业球员, 职业病

examples.hanzi: 他是一名职业篮球运动员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī míng zhíyè lánqiú yùndòngyuán.
examples.english: He is a professional basketball player.

之中.meaning: in; inside; among (formal, after a noun or pronoun): 在众人之中, 讨论之中

examples.hanzi: 讨论之中, 大家提出了不少好办法。
examples.pinyin: Tǎolùn zhī zhōng, dàjiā tí chū le bùshǎo hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: During the discussion, people came up with many good ideas.

种.meaning: measure word for kinds/types: 一种方法, 各种各样, 这种人

examples.hanzi: 秋天有一种说不出的美。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān yǒu yī zhǒng shuō bu chū de měi.
examples.english: Autumn has an indescribable beauty.

种.meaning: to plant; to grow (crops): 种花, 种树, 种地

examples.hanzi: 爷爷在后院种了很多蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài hòuyuàn zhòng le hěn duō shūcài.
examples.english: Grandpa planted many vegetables in the back yard.

种.meaning: kind; type; race (种类, 种族): compounds

examples.hanzi: 公园里种植着上百种植物。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán li zhòngzhí zhe shàngbǎi zhǒng zhíwù.
examples.english: Over a hundred species of plants grow in the park.

中餐.meaning: Chinese food/meal (vs 西餐 Western food): 中餐厅, 吃中餐

examples.hanzi: 他来中国三年, 已经爱上中餐了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái Zhōngguó sān nián, yǐjīng ài shang zhōngcān le.
examples.english: After three years in China he's fallen in love with Chinese food.

重点.meaning: key point; emphasis; focus: 考试重点, 抓住重点

examples.hanzi: 复习要抓住重点, 不要面面俱到。
examples.pinyin: Fùxí yào zhuāzhù zhòngdiǎn, búyào miànmiàn jù dào.
examples.english: Review should grasp the key points, not everything at once.

重点.meaning: key; major; priority: 重点大学, 重点项目

examples.hanzi: 这所重点大学每年录取上千名学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ zhòngdiǎn dàxué měinián lùqǔ shàng qiān míng xuéshēng.
examples.english: This key university admits over a thousand students a year.

中年.meaning: middle age (roughly 40–60): 中年人, 到了中年

examples.hanzi: 人到中年, 他更加注意健康了。
examples.pinyin: Rén dào zhōngnián, tā gèngjiā zhùyì jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Reaching middle age, he pays more attention to health.

重视.meaning: to attach importance to; to value; to take seriously (formal): 重视教育, 受到重视

examples.hanzi: 学校越来越重视学生的心理健康。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yuè lái yuè zhòngshì xuéshēng de xīnlǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Schools increasingly value students' mental health.

周围.meaning: surroundings; around: 周围的环境, 房子周围

examples.hanzi: 学校周围开了很多小吃店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi kāi le hěn duō xiǎochī diàn.
examples.english: Many snack shops have opened around the school.

祝.meaning: to wish (formulas: 祝你生日快乐, 祝旅途愉快): 祝你成功

examples.hanzi: 祝大家新年快乐!
examples.pinyin: Zhù dàjiā Xīnnián kuàilè!
examples.english: Wishing everyone a happy New Year!

赚.meaning: to earn (money); to make a profit: 赚钱, 赚了不少, 赚差价

examples.hanzi: 他业余时间做设计赚外快。
examples.pinyin: Tā yèyú shíjiān zuò shèjì zhuàn wàikuài.
examples.english: He does design on the side to earn extra money.

转.meaning: to turn; to rotate; to change direction: 转身, 向左转, 转了一个弯

examples.hanzi: 汽车在前面的路口向左转。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē zài qiánmiàn de lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.
examples.english: The car turns left at the intersection ahead.

转.meaning: to change; to shift (转移, 转变): 转话题, 转专业

examples.hanzi: 话题一转, 他开始聊起了旅行。
examples.pinyin: Huàtí yī zhuǎn, tā kāishǐ liáo qǐ le lǚxíng.
examples.english: Changing the subject, he began to chat about travel.

转.meaning: to revolve; to spin rapidly: 转圈, 头晕得转; 机器转得很快

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在院子里转圈玩。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài yuànzi li zhuàn quānr wán.
examples.english: The children play spinning in circles in the yard.

转.meaning: to pass on; to forward (转交, 转给): 把文件转给他

examples.hanzi: 收到文件后请转给主管。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào wénjiàn hòu qǐng zhuǎn gěi zhǔguǎn.
examples.english: After receiving the document please forward it to the supervisor.

转发.meaning: to forward; to repost/reshare (a message, post): 转发邮件, 转发到朋友圈

examples.hanzi: 这条消息被转发了上万次。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi bèi zhuǎnfā le shàng wàn cì.
examples.english: This post was forwarded tens of thousands of times.

装.meaning: to load; to pack; to fill: 装行李, 装满, 把书装进包里

examples.hanzi: 他把书装进背包。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū zhuāng jìn bēibāo.
examples.english: He packed the books into his backpack.

装.meaning: to install; to assemble (安装): 装空调, 装软件

examples.hanzi: 师傅正在装空调。
examples.pinyin: Shīfu zhèngzài zhuāng kōngtiáo.
examples.english: The technician is installing the air conditioner.

装.meaning: to pretend; to feign: 装睡, 装作不知道, 别装了

examples.hanzi: 他明明醒着, 却装睡。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngmíng xǐngzhe, què zhuāng shuì.
examples.english: He was clearly awake but pretended to sleep.

转机1.meaning: a turn for the better; favorable turn (of events/situation): 出现转机, 迎来转机

examples.hanzi: 经过调解, 谈判出现了转机。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò tiáojiě, tánpàn chūxiàn le zhuǎnjī.
examples.english: After mediation, the negotiations took a turn for the better.

专门.meaning: special(ly); dedicated (purpose): 专门跑一趟, 专门人才, 专门为我做的

examples.hanzi: 他专门去了一趟上海看展览。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuānmén qù le yī tàng Shànghǎi kàn zhǎnlǎn.
examples.english: He made a special trip to Shanghai for the exhibition.

专业.meaning: major; field of study (at university); specialty: 什么专业, 计算机专业, 专业对口

examples.hanzi: 她大学的专业是国际贸易。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué de zhuānyè shì guójì màoyì.
examples.english: Her university major was international trade.

专业.meaning: professional; specialized: 很专业, 专业水平, 专业人员

examples.hanzi: 他的翻译非常专业。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fānyì fēicháng zhuānyè.
examples.english: His translation is thoroughly professional.

祝贺.meaning: to congratulate (formal): 祝贺你取得好成绩, 表示祝贺

examples.hanzi: 祝贺你考上理想的大学!
examples.pinyin: Zhùhè nǐ kǎoshang lǐxiǎng de dàxué!
examples.english: Congratulations on getting into your dream university!

著名.meaning: famous; well-known (formal vs 有名): 著名的景点, 著名作家

examples.hanzi: 杭州以西湖著名。
examples.pinyin: Hángzhōu yǐ Xī Hú zhùmíng.
examples.english: Hangzhou is famous for West Lake.

准.meaning: to allow; to permit (准许, 批准): 准了 — compounds/formal

examples.hanzi: 上级批准了这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Shàngjí pīzhǔn le zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Higher-ups approved this project.

准.meaning: accurate; exact (准确): 打得很准, 看得准

examples.hanzi: 他扔石头百发百准。
examples.pinyin: Tā rēng shítou bǎi fā bǎi zhǔn.
examples.english: His stone throws hit every time.

准.meaning: definitely; assuredly (colloquial): 他准来, 准没错

examples.hanzi: 别担心, 他准来。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, tā zhǔn lái.
examples.english: Don't worry — he's sure to come.

准确.meaning: accurate; exact; precise: 准确的答案, 发音很准确

examples.hanzi: 他的发音准确无误。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fāyīn zhǔnquè wú wù.
examples.english: His pronunciation is accurate without error.

准时.meaning: punctual(ly); on time: 准时到达, 他很准时

examples.hanzi: 他每天准时七点出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zhǔnshí qī diǎn chūmén.
examples.english: He leaves home at seven on the dot every day.

主意.meaning: idea; plan; decision: 好主意, 改变主意, 拿不定主意

examples.hanzi: 周末去爬山, 这个主意不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò qù pá shān, zhège zhǔyi búcuò.
examples.english: Going hiking this weekend — that's a good idea.

自.meaning: self; oneself (自己 short form; 自费, 自学 — bound): compounds

examples.hanzi: 他自费出版了自己的诗集。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìfèi chūbǎn le zìjǐ de shījí.
examples.english: He published his own poetry collection at his own expense.

自.meaning: from (自行车 from…; 自古以来 since ancient times): formal

examples.hanzi: 博物馆的文物自古而来。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de wénwù zì gǔ ér lái.
examples.english: The museum's artifacts come down from ancient times.

资料.meaning: materials; data; information (for study/work): 查资料, 收集资料, 参考资料

examples.hanzi: 写论文前要收集足够的资料。
examples.pinyin: Xiě lùnwén qián yào shōují zúgòu de zīliào.
examples.english: Before writing a thesis, gather sufficient materials.

自然.meaning: nature; the natural world: 大自然, 自然规律

examples.hanzi: 我们要保护自然。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù zìrán.
examples.english: We should protect nature.

自然.meaning: natural; unaffected: 表现得很自然, 自然的语气

examples.hanzi: 他的表演很自然。
examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn zìrán.
examples.english: His performance is very natural.

自然.meaning: naturally; of course: 有了兴趣, 自然就学得好

examples.hanzi: 只要努力, 成绩自然会提高。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, chéngjì zìrán huì tígāo.
examples.english: As long as you work hard, grades will naturally improve.

自习.meaning: to study on one's own (supervised study period): 上自习, 自习课, 在教室自习

examples.hanzi: 晚自习后宿舍十点熄灯。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn zìxí hòu sùshè shí diǎn xīdēng.
examples.english: After evening self-study, dorm lights out at ten.

仔细.meaning: careful; attentive: 检查得很仔细, 仔细的孩子

examples.hanzi: 他仔细检查了一遍答案。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǐxì jiǎnchá le yī biàn dá'àn.
examples.english: He carefully checked the answers once through.

仔细.meaning: carefully: 仔细看, 仔细听

examples.hanzi: 仔细看, 这两幅画有区别。
examples.pinyin: Zǐxì kàn, zhè liǎng fú huà yǒu qūbié.
examples.english: Look carefully — the two paintings differ.

自信.meaning: self-confident; confidence: 很自信, 充满自信, 自信心

examples.hanzi: 她自信地走上舞台发言。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìxìn de zǒu shang wǔtái fāyán.
examples.english: She walked onto the stage confidently to speak.

自学.meaning: to study on one's own (without a teacher): 自学汉语, 自学成才

examples.hanzi: 他靠自学通过了日语考试。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìxué tōngguò le Rìyǔ kǎoshì.
examples.english: He passed the Japanese exam through self-study.

总结.meaning: to summarize; to sum up: 总结经验, 做个总结

examples.hanzi: 项目结束后要写一份总结。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngmù jiéshù hòu yào xiě yī fèn zǒngjié.
examples.english: After the project ends, write a summary.

总结.meaning: summary: 年终总结, 写一份总结

examples.hanzi: 年终总结里列出了明年的计划。
examples.pinyin: Niánzhōng zǒngjié li liè chū le míngnián de jìhuà.
examples.english: The year-end summary lists next year's plans.

组.meaning: group; team: 一个小组, 组长, 第一组

examples.hanzi: 全班分成了四个小组。
examples.pinyin: Quán bān fēn chéng le sì ge xiǎozǔ.
examples.english: The class split into four groups.

组.meaning: to organize; to form (组成, 组队): 组了个乐队

examples.hanzi: 他们组了一个乐队。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zǔ le yī ge yuèduì.
examples.english: They formed a band.

组.meaning: measure word for sets/groups: 一组数据, 一组照片

examples.hanzi: 这组照片记录了城市的变迁。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zǔ zhàopiàn jìlù le chéngshì de biànqiān.
examples.english: This set of photos records the city's changes.

租.meaning: to rent; to lease (from either side, often the tenant side): 租房子, 租了一辆车

examples.hanzi: 他在公司附近租了一间房。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī fùjìn zū le yī jiān fáng.
examples.english: He rented a room near the company.

租.meaning: to rent out (出租 sense): 房东把房子租给学生

examples.hanzi: 房东把空房子租给了学生。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng bǎ kòng fángzi zū gěi le xuéshēng.
examples.english: The landlord rented the empty flat to students.

最终.meaning: finally; ultimate(ly) (formal): 最终决定, 最终成功了

examples.hanzi: 经过反复讨论, 方案最终确定了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù tǎolùn, fāng'àn zuìzhōng quèdìng le.
examples.english: After repeated discussion the plan was finally settled.

尊重.meaning: to respect; to esteem: 尊重老人, 受到尊重, 互相尊重

examples.hanzi: 要尊重别人的习惯和选择。
examples.pinyin: Yào zūnzhòng biérén de xíguàn hé xuǎnzé.
examples.english: Respect other people's habits and choices.

examples.hanzi: 他赢得了所有人的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíngdé le suǒyǒu rén de zūnzhòng.
examples.english: He won everyone's respect.

座.meaning: measure word for mountains, buildings, bridges, cities: 一座山, 两座桥

examples.hanzi: 河上新建了一座大桥。
examples.pinyin: Hé shang xīn jiàn le yī zuò dàqiáo.
examples.english: A new bridge was built over the river.

座.meaning: seat (座位的 short: 请入座, 对号入座); stand/base (底座) — formal set phrases

examples.hanzi: 演出开始了, 请大家入座。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchū kāishǐ le, qǐng dàjiā rù zuò.
examples.english: The show is starting — please take your seats.

做法.meaning: way of doing something; practice; method: 不同的做法, 这种做法不对

examples.hanzi: 这种做法容易让人误会。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ róngyì ràng rén wùhuì.
examples.english: This practice is easy to misunderstand.

作家.meaning: writer; author (professional): 一位作家, 著名作家

examples.hanzi: 他从小就想当作家。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xiǎng dàng zuòjiā.
examples.english: Since childhood he's wanted to be a writer.

做梦.meaning: to dream (while asleep) (离合: 做了一个梦): 昨晚做梦了; fig. daydream: 你做梦! (in your dreams)

examples.hanzi: 他昨晚做梦, 梦见了老同学。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó wǎn zuòmèng, mèng jiàn le lǎo tóngxué.
examples.english: Last night he dreamed of an old classmate.

作品.meaning: work (of art/literature); opus: 艺术作品, 一部作品, 代表作品

examples.hanzi: 这幅作品在比赛中得了一等奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú zuòpǐn zài bǐsài zhōng dé le yī děng jiǎng.
examples.english: This work won first prize in the competition.

作为1.meaning: to serve as; to be (in a role): 作为老师, 我应该…; 作为一个中国人

examples.hanzi: 作为一名老师, 他深受学生喜爱。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng lǎoshī, tā shēn shòu xuéshēng xǐ'ài.
examples.english: As a teacher, he is dearly loved by students.

作为1.meaning: as for; in the capacity of (introducing a topic): 作为朋友, 我得提醒你

examples.hanzi: 作为朋友, 我必须提醒你。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi péngyou, wǒ bìxū tíxǐng nǐ.
examples.english: As a friend, I have to remind you.

作为1.meaning: conduct; behavior (有所作为 accomplish something): formal set phrases

examples.hanzi: 年轻人要在工作中有所作为。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yào zài gōngzuò zhōng yǒu suǒ zuòwéi.
examples.english: Young people should accomplish something in their work.

座位.meaning: seat: 一个座位, 预订座位, 请系好安全带坐回座位

examples.hanzi: 电影院的座位很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐngyuàn de zuòwèi hěn shūfu.
examples.english: The cinema seats are comfortable.

作文.meaning: composition; essay (school writing): 写作文, 一篇作文

examples.hanzi: 老师把他的作文当范文读了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ tā de zuòwén dàng fànwén dú le.
examples.english: The teacher read his essay as a model.

作用.meaning: function; role; effect: 起到重要作用, 药的作用, 副作用

examples.hanzi: 运动对身体有很大的作用。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn dà de zuòyòng.
examples.english: Exercise does the body a great deal of good.

左右.meaning: left and right (directions): 左右两边, 左右手

examples.hanzi: 请十点左右到我家。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shí diǎn zuǒyòu dào wǒ jiā.
examples.english: Please come to my place around ten o'clock.

左右.meaning: (after a number) approximately; or so: 五十个人左右, 十点左右

examples.hanzi: 房子左右两边各有一棵树。
examples.pinyin: Fángzi zuǒyòu liǎng biān gè yǒu yī kē shù.
examples.english: There's a tree on each side of the house.

左右.meaning: to control; to influence (左右局势): formal

examples.hanzi: 媒体的报道左右了公众的看法。
examples.pinyin: Méitǐ de bàodào zuǒyòu le gōngzhòng de kànfǎ.
examples.english: Media coverage swayed public opinion.

作者.meaning: author; writer (of a specific work): 这本书的作者

examples.hanzi: 这本书的作者是一位中学老师。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì yī wèi zhōngxué lǎoshī.
examples.english: The author of this book is a middle-school teacher.
